ekegusii: Omomalaika o kane akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio ensemo ya gatato y’erioba egaakwa, na ensemo ya gatato y’omotienyi, na ensemo ya gatato ye ching’enang’eni boigo. Igo ensemo yabo ya gatato ekabekwa omosunte, erinde ensemo ya gatato y’omobaso tobara, nonya nobotuko boigo.
english: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi omoruoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?
english: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD, and he said: "Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ntokore buna gwatebire. Omonene nabe kirori ase egati yaito.”
english: The elders of Gilead replied, "The LORD is our witness; we will certainly do as you say."

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotebana ase amang’ana aya. Nase ki inche omoruoti ndanyore emechando?”
english: Be careful not to neglect this matter. Why let this threat grow, to the detriment of the royal interests?

ekegusii: Bakaba bagokwana nere rituko ase rituko ng’a aigwere ogochika koria, korende tabete ogotegerera amang’ana abo. Ere nigo abatebetie ng’a n’Omoyahudi are. Ase ayio abasomba baria bagatebia Hamani, erinde barore gose amang’ana a Moredekai nancherwe.
english: Day after day they spoke to him but he refused to comply. Therefore they told Haman about it to see whether Mordecai's behavior would be tolerated, for he had told them he was a Jew.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia agatebia Zedekia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye korerue ase amaboko ay’abakogamba inse y’omoruoti o Babeli, notigwe obe moyo, na omochie oyo togosambwa nomorero; aye amo nabanto b’eamate yao namotigwe mobe moyo.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, "This is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'If you surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, your life will be spared and this city will not be burned down; you and your family will live.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.
english: Jesus replied, "If anyone loves me, he will obey my teaching. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

ekegusii: Ekero moraroisie omogati korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kw’endagera, namoyorente ase Omonene obe okoruegwa kw’ogotongora buna mokomoruera endagera korwa ase ekeooreri kiaino.
english: Present a cake from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.

ekegusii: Echio chire chindeu, timori gochibeka chinguru, na echire chindwaire, timori gochigwenia, na echibunegete, timori gochiboera ebitete, na echiaserebekanire, timori gochiirania asende, na echiasirire, timori gochirigia; mwabeire mogochigambera ase ogochibetereria more nobotindi.
english: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.
english: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

ekegusii: Korende gese twatigete gosamba ubani na koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa ase Eting’ana ya Igoro, twabeire tokoremerwa kera egento, naende twabeire togosirigwa ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara.”
english: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine."

ekegusii: Moite abarwani babo b’esegi banga buna chieri, mobaite bonsi pi. Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwabo riachire, eyio nengaki yabo y’okonyora egesusuro.
english: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.

ekegusii: Akabaa chinse chi’abanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa nebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.
english: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for--

ekegusii: Yoabu agakwania Amasa, “Mbuya ore oyominto?” Erio akamobwata chinderu nokoboko gw’okorio buna nigo arigetie komonyunyunta.
english: Joab said to Amasa, "How are you, my brother?" Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

ekegusii: Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto araoroke.
english: "It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

ekegusii: Na ekero Yehosafati na abanto baye bagendete koira ebisakorwa korwa ase emeganda eria bakanyora chinibo ne chitugo chinyinge, na ebinto bie rigori rinene; bakabibogoria na kobiira, goika bagasinywa koira goetania. Ase amatuko atato bakagenderera kobiira, ekiagera biarenge ebinge mono.
english: So Jehoshaphat and his men went to carry off their plunder, and they found among them a great amount of equipment and clothing and also articles of value-- more than they could take away. There was so much plunder that it took three days to collect it.

ekegusii: Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete.
english: teaching you true and reliable words, so that you can give sound answers to him who sent you?

ekegusii: Obotenenku na obonda mbibe ase enyomba yaye, na oboronge bwaye mbogenderere kobao botambe.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

ekegusii: "Then our father said, 'Go back and buy a little more food.'
english: Na ekero tata atotebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,

ekegusii: Ebibe bi’abanto bande nigo bire maiso marore, biatang’anire gochia ase ekina, korende ebi’abande nigo bikobatunyana korwa nyuma.
english: The sins of some men are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa okorera kw’omwana, na omomalaika o Nyasae akarangeria Hagari korwa igoro, akamotebia, “Hagari, inki okorera? Tibwoboa, ekiagera Nyasae oigure okorera kw’omwana agwo ase araire.
english: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.
english: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokorera omotaka bore nigo agochaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ime yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae bwaorokigwe korwa okwegena goika okwegena, buna erikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”
english: For in the gospel a righteousness from God is revealed, a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: "The righteous will live by faith."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria, “Ning’o oyio ore ase egoora?” Ekaba ng’a Hamani nere orenge gosoa ase egoora isiko y’enyomba y’omoruoti, akwane nomoruoti, erinde achie gotonga Moredekai ase orobambo roria amosimiseretie.
english: The king said, "Who is in the court?" Now Haman had just entered the outer court of the palace to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows he had erected for him.

ekegusii: Abanto abange beruete korika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.
english: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

ekegusii: Omoyo bw’omokori amabe nigo okogania gokora ebibe, na omonto oyio tari kororera omonto onde amabera.
english: The wicked man craves evil; his neighbor gets no mercy from him.

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Abanto mbare aiga ase aba bateneine, barabwo bataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake goika barore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase oboruoti bwaye.”
english: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."

ekegusii: Omonto ogotomana nomokungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chisemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.
english: But a man who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.

ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto kararemererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.
english: For it is commendable if a man bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God.

ekegusii: Na ekero amoimogetie akamoira ase ng’ina, na omwana oria agaikaransa ase amaru a ng’ina goika mobaso gati, erio agakwa.
english: After the servant had lifted him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tirimboka gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda, okwane amang’ana aya:
english: This is what the LORD says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:

ekegusii: Ekero Atalia aigwete amariogi ’abarendi na ay’abanto bonsi, agasoa enyomba y’Omonene ase abanto basangererekanete.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio ekanisa ekanyora omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi, na Galili, na Samaria. Ekagenderera koagachwa ase okoiroka kw’Omonene, na ase okoremia kw’Omoika Omochenu ekamentekana.
english: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace. It was strengthened; and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it grew in numbers, living in the fear of the Lord.

ekegusii: Ere agasokia bonsi gochia isiko, akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateba, “Omwana, imoka!”
english: But he took her by the hand and said, "My child, get up!"

ekegusii: Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.
english: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.

ekegusii: Naki buna omobere otari nomoika nigo okwete, naboigo nokwegena gotari nogokora nigo gokwete.
english: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima chingunchara chi’abakori amabe, korende echi’abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.
english: I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.

ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.
english: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.

ekegusii: Naende twechanderane intwe ase intwe, na kobekana chinguru ase obwanchani, na ase ogokora okuya.
english: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds.

ekegusii: Mariamu Magidalena akagenda, agatebia aborokigwa amang’ana ng’a, “Narorire Omonene”, naende ng’a omotebirie aya.
english: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.

ekegusii: Tinyegachereti inche bweka oboronge bwao ase enkoro yane ime; korende nararirie obwegenwa bwao, na ogotooreka kwao. Timbiseti obuya bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, korwa ase omosangererekano omonene.
english: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and salvation. I do not conceal your love and your truth from the great assembly.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Naki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”
english: His disciples answered, "But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?"

ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chie ching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora.
english: He tends his flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart; he gently leads those that have young.

ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi amagana abere, na ikomi na babere (212) nigo bachoretwe bakaba abarendi b’ebisoero bi’ebiita. Bakabarwa na korikwa ase chinderia chiabo. Daudi na Samweli omorori bakababeka ase emeremo, ekiagera babegenete.
english: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koonchorana oboronge, gose gwanchereria abanto, gose timoegwa riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria amaiso ’abang’aini, naende nigo rikoonchorana na korina abanyaboronge oboronge bwabo.
english: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.
english: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

ekegusii: Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.”
english: because I so feared the crowd and so dreaded the contempt of the clans that I kept silent and would not go outside

ekegusii: Na obonene bw’abanto b’ebisaku na ogosika kwabo nigo birarentwe imeo.
english: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.

ekegusii: goika omonto oria omokoro bw’amatuko amange agacha, na abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono bakaegwa oboronge bwabo, na engaki egaika ekero abachenu bairete oboruoti boria.
english: until the Ancient of Days came and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came when they possessed the kingdom.

ekegusii: They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
english: Bakarua Harada, bakagenda bagaika Makeloti, bagatoora aroro.

ekegusii: na omonto oyio atakerenteti ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokerua asende, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: and does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD-- that man must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo Yusufu baroche ng’a ise okure, bagatebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”
english: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"

ekegusii: Ahabu akaboria, “Ngoetera ase ng’o?” Omobani oria akamoiraneria, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ngoetera ase abasomba abamura b’abagambi be chingongo chiabo.” Naende Ahabu akaboria, “Ning’o orachake esegi?” Omobani oria akairaneria, “Naye.”
english: "But who will do this?" asked Ahab. The prophet replied, "This is what the LORD says: 'The young officers of the provincial commanders will do it.'" "And who will start the battle?" he asked. The prophet answered, "You will."

ekegusii: Ekero Yosia aonchogete, akarora chimbeera chiarenge ase ekegoro igoro, agatoma abanto bakarenta amauga korwa ase chimbeera chiria ime, erio akayasambera ase egesasimero, na ekio gekaba egetachenegeti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene riararetigwe nomonto o Nyasae, oria obanete igoro ase ebinto ebio.
english: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.

ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogoko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogoko.
english: There was a man all alone; he had neither son nor brother. There was no end to his toil, yet his eyes were not content with his wealth. "For whom am I toiling," he asked, "and why am I depriving myself of enjoyment?" This too is meaningless-- a miserable business!

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Yeroboamu aigwete ogokwana okwo kw’omonto oria o Nyasae, koria arentete maminncha y’egesasimero agwo Beteli, akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa ase egesasimero, agateba, “Bwata omonto oyo!” Okoboko koria kwaye aramborete gochia ase omonto oria gokooma pa, goika tanyarete naende gokoringa.
english: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.

ekegusii: Nabeire ngotegerera buya mono, korende timori gokwana ekeene. Onde tari ogweitia na koonchoka atige obobe bwaye na koboria: Ngento ki nakorire? Kera omonto nigo agendererete gokora buna anchete, ogwekanire ebarasi ekominyoka gochia ase okorwana esegi.
english: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, "What have I done?" Each pursues his own course like a horse charging into battle.

ekegusii: Obwo nabwo obosiru bw’abanto abwo besemeretie abanyene, omoerio obo abwo begenete amang’ana abo.
english: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings. Selah

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Ase engaki yancheire, nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, ase rituko ri’ogotooreka, nagokonyete, nabeire nkorendete, na goetera asore nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabanto, erinde oiranerie ense amaya aye na gwatanana emiando yasaretigwe.
english: This is what the LORD says: "In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga basirigwe kegima buna amache omogoko agoeta asira; ekero bakoruta emegwe yabo, eburoke.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows be blunted.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aboretie omokungu oria, nere akamotebia amang’ana onsi. Ase ayio omoruoti agachora omoteneneri oyomo anyare gokonya omokungu oria, akamotebia, “Irania ebinto bionsi biria biarenge bi’omokungu oyo, amo nokwama gwonsi korwa ase oboremo boria, gochakera rituko riria aruete ase oboremo boria goika bono.”
english: The king asked the woman about it, and she told him. Then he assigned an official to her case and said to him, "Give back everything that belonged to her, including all the income from her land from the day she left the country until now."

ekegusii: This is the account of Abraham's son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Isaka, mosinto o Ibrahimu. Ibrahimu nere oiborete Isaka.

ekegusii: Natagore emegwekano y’amagena egosasimwa agwo Heliopolis ase ense ya Misiri. Nasambe nomorero chinyomba chie chinyasae chia Misiri.”
english: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.'"

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Sara omonyene akanyora chinguru koba morito, nonya konya oeteire emiaka yaye, ekiagera amoroche ere oyomorierete eira, ng’a nomwegenwa are.
english: By faith Abraham, even though he was past age-- and Sarah herself was barren-- was enabled to become a father because he considered him faithful who had made the promise.

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mwebire obobe bwe chisokoro chiaino na obw’abaruoti b’Abayuda, na obw’abakungu babo, na obwaino, na obw’abakungu baino, obwo bwakoretwe ase ense y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your fathers and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

ekegusii: “Onye omosomba otamire korwa ase omonene oye, ochire asemore, timobaisa komoirania gochia ase omonene oye naende.
english: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand him over to his master.

ekegusii: nigo akwebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; nigo akobabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.
english: He lies in wait like a lion in cover; he lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

ekegusii: nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto, inwe abamwachenirwe ase Kristo Yeso, abamwarangerigwe koba abachenu amo na bonsi abakorangeria erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo kera aase, nere Omonene obo na oyoito.
english: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ-- their Lord and ours:

ekegusii: Akang’etia ase egati y’amauga aria, nkarora ng’a nigo arenge amange mono ase rikura riria, naende nkarora ng’a nigo arenge amomo pa.
english: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.

ekegusii: Gose esaro ase orogendo, gose chianga ibere, gose ebikoroto, nonya nenyimbo, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete endagera yaye.
english: take no bag for the journey, or extra tunic, or sandals or a staff; for the worker is worth his keep.

ekegusii: “Rigereria gochia igoro, orore; rora amare buna are igoro mono kogoetania.
english: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.

ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene Yeso, oyorabakwe goika kare na kare, omanyire ng’a tindi gokwana oborimo.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.

ekegusii: "A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
english: Ogochika okoyia nabaeire nakwo oko, mwanchane. Buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo.

ekegusii: Onye nomokungu nigo rirabe chisekeli emerongo etato.
english: and if it is a female, set her value at thirty shekels.

ekegusii: “Onye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa akonduera inche Omonene gekorusigwa ase chinyoni, rirorio arente amaruma gose amage ’amaruma.
english: "'If the offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

ekegusii: They prepared their gifts for Joseph's arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.
english: Barabwo bakabeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.

ekegusii: Egiloni akabwatana n’Abaamori na Abaameleki; barabwo bakarwania Abaisraeli, bakababua, bakaira Omochie bw’Emekendo.
english: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.

ekegusii: Chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, nabio biagerire amang’ana ayio abanyorire inwe. Oko nakwo ogosirigwa kwaino, na nigo kore nobororo obonge. Obororo obwo bwasoire ime ase chinkoro chiaino.
english: "Your own conduct and actions have brought this upon you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!"

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tombeera aare, Nyasae one, inchuo bwango onkonye!
english: Be not far from me, O God; come quickly, O my God, to help me.

ekegusii: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.
english: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ’ebirero biabo nkaba nendamwamu enene;

ekegusii: “Buna abakuani bagendererete kobucha, naboigo bagendererete gokora ebibe asende. Ase ayio ning’onchore obonene bwabo bobe obosooku.
english: The more the priests increased, the more they sinned against me; they exchanged their Glory for something disgraceful.

ekegusii: Elija agatebia omokungu oria, “Toiroka! Genda okore buna gwatebire, korende ritang’ani ondoiserie omogati omoke korwa ase obosio obwo, ondetere, erio nyuma yaye oroisie oyoo na oyo bw’omwana oo,
english: Elijah said to her, "Don't be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small cake of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

ekegusii: Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabanto bonsi.
english: He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

ekegusii: Na omoganda nigo orenge oikaransete omoetanaine, okamotebia, “Rora nyoko na bamura bamino isiko bare, mbakorigetie.”
english: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, "Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you."

ekegusii: Oborogi tibogokora gento ase abanto ba Yakobo, gose oboriori ase Abaisraeli. Nakwanwe igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo, nabwo Abaisraeli: Rora aya Nyasae akorire!
english: There is no sorcery against Jacob, no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'See what God has done!'

ekegusii: Nabo Abamidiani babuetwe n’Abaisraeli, na tibanyara koimoka gokora kende. Na bono ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika Gidioni agakwa.
english: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon's lifetime, the land enjoyed peace forty years.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ekiaare kia gatato ase ororeria rwabo, bancherwe basoe ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
english: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.

ekegusii: Agacha korandia omorembe asemore abamwarenge are, na ase abwo barenge ang’e.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.

ekegusii: Daudi akarengereria ase enkoro yaye, akabora, “Rituko erimo ning’itwe na Saulo. Egento kerabe ekiya mono asende nogotama korwa aiga na kogenda ase ense y’Abafilisti. Erio nario Saulo ararusie moyo, tana kondigia naende aa ase chingongo chi’Abaisraeli, na nintooreke korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”
english: But David thought to himself, "One of these days I will be destroyed by the hand of Saul. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up searching for me anywhere in Israel, and I will slip out of his hand."

ekegusii: agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero kere ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase obosio bwane, korende amanyinga onsi aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamba kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring’ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring’ana eri bansoeire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”
english: If, however, I am guilty of doing anything deserving death, I do not refuse to die. But if the charges brought against me by these Jews are not true, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!"

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino nabeke okoragereria okwo gwonsi igoro y’ababisa baino, na igoro ya baria babagechete na kobachanda.
english: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies who hate and persecute you.

ekegusii: Omokungu o Samaria agacha kobuucha amache. Yeso akamotebia, “Ing’a amache inywe.”
english: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, "Will you give me a drink?"

ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komotebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”
english: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"-- when you now have it with you.

ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etaai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.
english: His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like rods of iron.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.
english: O LORD Almighty, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

ekegusii: Ekiage ki’amariko onsi Aiga nonyore omariko onsi ime ya Botanix arikire ase Ekegusii. Category: Ebimeri bi’amache na nyancha Amariko igoro y’ogosimeka ebimeri bia amache na nyancha Egesicha Lotus ya Boindi Lotus ya Boindi (Nelumbo nucifera) nigo ere ekemeri ki’amache ekiya mono n’amato machani agocheng’enena ase amache. Amaoga amabariri agotoka ase amatina amanetu agotira chisentimita chinyinge igoro y’amache.
english: Today we talk about this This information concerns the use of Botanix products in Ekegusii. Category: Traditional medicine and herbs This explains how to use traditional medicine and herbs Boindi Lotus Flower The Boindi Lotus (Nelumbo nucifera) is a medicinal plant that grows in muddy areas within herbs. Its leaves are large and can reach up to several centimeters in size when used in medicine.

ekegusii: Abaatene bonsi na abamenyi abamenyete agwo tibarenge ne ribaga ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ogokwana na gotegerera amang’ana amayia.
english: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.
english: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God's house.

ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.
english: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
english: "Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.

ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.
english: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto babere nababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
english: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

ekegusii: Omorendi bw’egesieri nigo akomoigorera, ne ching’ondi nigo chikoigwa eriogi riaye; ere nigo akorangeria ching’ondi chiaye ase amarieta abo na gochiira isiko.
english: The watchman opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

ekegusii: Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata, korende akarua ase amaboko abo.
english: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

ekegusii: Naama! Inche nachakire korenta amabe igoro ase omochie oyio okorokwa ase erieta riane. Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a nigo moratigwe timoegwa egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro, ekiagera nindete esegi erwanie abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword upon all who live on the earth, declares the LORD Almighty.'

ekegusii: bakarangeria Loti, bakamoboria, “Abanto abwo bacha mwao bono botuko, ng’ai bare? Basokie isiko aa, tobakorere obosooku.”
english: They called to Lot, "Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them."

ekegusii: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
english: Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.

ekegusii: Timokomanya gose koinyora emegati eria etano ase baria chilifu isano, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?
english: Do you still not understand? Don't you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

ekegusii: Korende inwe, abanchani, mweagache ase okwegena kwaino kore ogochenu mono, na gosaba ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Na inche nkabora: Omonene, barabwo mbamanyete ng’a nigo narenge gosiba baria bakwegenete na kobaaka ase chisinagogi chionsi.
english: "'Lord,' I replied, 'these men know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene igoro y’Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi akamotebia, “Genda obare Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”
english: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go and take a census of Israel and Judah."

ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, ne chimingichi isano, ne chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.
english: and two oxen, five rams, five male goats and five male lambs a year old, to be sacrificed as a fellowship offering. This was the offering of Eliab son of Helon.

ekegusii: Ngento ki mogochia konyora ase okogenda Misiri konywa amache ’orooche rwa Sihori? Gose inki mogochia konyora ase okogenda Asuri konywa amache ’orooche rw’Eufarati?
english: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Shihor? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the River?

ekegusii: Abanto bao bonsi mbabe abanyene oboronge, mbaire ense ebe eyabo kare na kare; barabwo nigo barabe ekemeri kiane nasimegete, emeremo y’amaboko aane, erio inche ntogigwe.
english: Then will all your people be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nekeene nabatebirie: Ase ense enyia, ekero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto agochi‐gocha goikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, inwe abamwantunyanire namoche goikaransera ebirogo bi’obonene ikomi na bibere, mokogambera ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
english: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo nororeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa nyuma yaino,
english: "I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaburukania abakungu abamoirogete Nyasae, abasikire nabanto, na abanene b’omochie, bakagenka abanto bachande Paulo na Barnaba, na kobaseria korwa ensemo yabo.
english: But the Jews incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo airanete korwa ase okobwatia Abafilisti, agatebigwa ng’a Daudi nao are ase erooro ya Eni‐Gedi.
english: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, "David is in the Desert of En Gedi."

ekegusii: Nigo nakorikeire amang’ana aya, inde nogosemeria ng’a ninchiche asore bwango.
english: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,

ekegusii: Ase igo Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, na Yohanani, na Yonathani, basinto ba Karea, na Seraya, mosinto o Tanahumeti, na basinto ba Efai korwa Netofa, na Yesania, mosinto bw’omonto oyomo korwa Maaka, amo nabanto babo, bagachiera Gedalia agwo Misipa.
english: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah-- Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, and their men.

ekegusii: Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng’eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.
english: "Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their fathers treated the prophets.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw’omogisangio oye, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo chikobatang’ana chiabasiria.
english: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

ekegusii: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
english: na Yohanani oyo o gatano na gatato, na Elisabadi oyo o kianda,

ekegusii: Omoiti nigo akoboa mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko bwekora omoibi.
english: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises up and kills the poor and needy; in the night he steals forth like a thief.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, oria otanyare korua ebing’wanso bi’ogochenwa bia botambe bichikire.
english: These are the regulations for anyone who has an infectious skin disease and who cannot afford the regular offerings for his cleansing.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananire. Na emerindo yao yonsi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.
english: You hurled me into the deep, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere ara gatano na kabere. (Kera echuma eyemo ebe ey’engaki y’omwaka omogima.) Naboigo engaki eyio ebe ey’emiaka emerongo ene, na kianda.
english: "'Count off seven sabbaths of years-- seven times seven years-- so that the seven sabbaths of years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaimoka amo nabanto baye amagana atano na rimo, akagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maoki, omoruoti o Gati.
english: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maoch king of Gath.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria omosomba oyomo, akamochika, “Genda bwango orente Mikaya, mosinto o Imula.”
english: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rikagwenera omosangererekano bwonsi. Bagachora Stefano, omonto oichire nokwegena na Omoika Omochenu, na Filipo, na Prokoro, na Nikanora, na Timoni, na Parmena, na Nikolao bw’Antiokia, omonto oonchogete.
english: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

ekegusii: ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a embura yaisire gotwa.
english: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, goika ng’ikeranie chiira nakorierete; naende ninkoruere ebing’wanso bi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: I am under vows to you, O God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera nyuma yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab; his son Zebadiah was his successor. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Abanto tibamoiranerete oria obaete egesusuro, gose tibamorigetie Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ing’a oboronge bwane, ndwanerere nkonye korwa ase abanto batakoirogeti, ntoorie korwa ase abanto abang’ainereria, abatari abanyakeene.
english: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bamenyete moocha, na Abafilisti bamenyete bosongo, baasamirie emenwa yabo bamere Abaisraeli. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
english: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad."

ekegusii: Korende nigo arabae abataka oboronge bwabo ase okonacha ebina, tagokora ogwanchereria ase abaitongo b’ense. Naake ense nenyimbo y’omonwa oye, naite abakori amabe nomoika bw’omonwa oye.
english: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.

ekegusii: Buna aiboretwe ore getirianda korwa ase enda ya ng’ina, naboigo aragende ore getirianda buna achete, gose takoira kende ase ebio echandeire mono kobinyora.
english: Naked a man comes from his mother's womb, and as he comes, so he departs. He takes nothing from his labor that he can carry in his hand.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha, otanyare kobareka.
english: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.
english: Who is the liar? It is the man who denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a man is the antichrist-- he denies the Father and the Son.

ekegusii: Haroni agakora bo, akabeka chitaya echio, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio bw’ekebekerero ekio, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.”
english: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what he has done has been done through God."

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ase mwantomete erinde ng’ire ogosaba kwaino ase obosio bwaye, agoteba:
english: He said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:

ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Omonene akorire, tiga tobe nomogoko, tochenge ase rirorio.
english: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

ekegusii: Nigo inde nomogoko omonene ase okorenda oborori bwao; kobua koba nobotenenku obonene.
english: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairana ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, na barabwo bakababoria, “Naki motamorenta?”
english: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn't you bring him in?"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amabera ao nigo are amanene; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogamba kwao.
english: Your compassion is great, O LORD; preserve my life according to your laws.

ekegusii: “Nindere ase engencho y’ebitunwa, ninyeumie ase engencho y’amarisia e chirooro, ekiagera biomire na gosareka. Monto onde tagoeta ase egati yabo, na amariogi e chiombe chikwana tari koigugwa; chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiatamire chiachiire.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the desert pastures. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds of the air have fled and the animals are gone.

ekegusii: Onye bakoiraneria ng’a berure abanyene asemore na kobaa ribaga mosoe ase omochie obo, rirorio abanto bonsi bare ase omochie oria mbabe bakobakorera emeremo emekong’u na babe abasomba baino.
english: If they accept and open their gates, all the people in it shall be subject to forced labor and shall work for you.

ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one. Ekero arakore ebibe nimoe egesusuro nenyimbo na amaakwa aya mwanyabanto bakoegwa.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with the rod of men, with floggings inflicted by men.

ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa asende?
english: Why, O LORD, do you reject me and hide your face from me?

ekegusii: Abanto ba Misiri nabanyore obosooku, nababekwe ase amaboko ’abanto bakorwa sugusu.”
english: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame, handed over to the people of the north."

ekegusii: Erio Elisha agasaba, akabora, “Aye Omonene, nagosabire, ramokia amaiso aye, erinde arore.” Na Omonene akaramokia amaiso ’omosae oria, nere akarora chibarasi ne chigari chi’omorero nigo chiaichire ekegoro igoro, chietanaine Elisha.
english: And Elisha prayed, "O LORD, open his eyes so he may see." Then the LORD opened the servant's eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire? Nabeire nkorera ng’a ontoorie, korende kwambeereire aare.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "The Doe of the Morning." A psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?

ekegusii: Ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Mika.
english: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

ekegusii: Nigo ogokorobanania mwanyabanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;
english: You sweep men away in the sleep of death; they are like the new grass of the morning--

ekegusii: “Boigo naende mwagerete Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekero mwarenge agwo Tabera, na Masa, na Kibiroti‐Hatawa.
english: You also made the LORD angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

ekegusii: Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.
english: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia Nuhu amo nabamura baye, akabatebia, “Moibore, momeneteke, moichore ase ense.
english: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.

ekegusii: Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebichie bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
english: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"

ekegusii: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Asshur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
english: Na orooche rwa gatato rokarokwa Tigirisi, orwo rogoeta moocha y’Asuri. Na orooche rwa kane narororwo rokarokwa Eufarati.

ekegusii: Eri nkobatebia ase omosunte ime, ritebe ase omobaso; na eri mokoigwa rikomonyererwa, rirarie igoro ase ebirama.
english: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the roofs.

ekegusii: Abaringoria bagatebia Farao, “Eke nekiara kia Nyasae.” Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene atebete, akaanga kobaigwa.
english: The magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh's heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the LORD had said.

ekegusii: Aya naro omoruoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
english: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.

ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro akagenderera, agacha ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akariina ebitunwa igoro, agaikaransa aroro.
english: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.

ekegusii: Omonene naake Abaisraeli abanyegerie buna egetonto gekonyegerigwa ime ase amache, nabasimore barue ase ense eye engiya aete chisokoro chiabo, abasiarere gochia ng’umbu y’Eufarati, ekiagera barabwo bakorire emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, na igo bagechirie Omonene obeire nendamwamu.
english: And the LORD will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their forefathers and scatter them beyond the River, because they provoked the LORD to anger by making Asherah poles.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,
english: In that day the LORD Almighty will be a glorious crown, a beautiful wreath for the remnant of his people.

ekegusii: Yeso akabachika tibatebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.
english: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.

ekegusii: Inee! Ekero narengereretie gokora aya, inarenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u koroisia emeroberio yane? Gose nigo nayeroisetie buna omonto bw’ense ore ang’e goteba, “Ee, ee”, na, “Taibo, taibo”?
english: When I planned this, did I do it lightly? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say, "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?

ekegusii: Mosinto oria o Saulo nabwate abanto babere abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, abarenge abasakori. Oyomo nigo are korokwa Baana, na oria onde Rekabu. Barabwo nigo barenge basinto ba Rimoni o Beeroti, omochie bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin. (Beeroti nigo obaretwe koba bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin.)
english: Now Saul's son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Recab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin-- Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,

ekegusii: Nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness; he will govern the peoples with justice.

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Imoka, togende korwania abanto baria, ekiagera ntwarora ense eria, ng’a nengiya mono. Inaki mogoikaransa aa bosa? Timobaisa gotebana kogenda aroro na koira ense eria.
english: They answered, "Come on, let's attack them! We have seen that the land is very good. Aren't you going to do something? Don't hesitate to go there and take it over.

ekegusii: korende akabisa ensemo ye rigori riaye, na mokaye nere namanyete aya. Akarenta ensemo eyemo, akayebeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa.
english: With his wife's full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles' feet.

ekegusii: Ninyoisie ense nemegoko y’amanyinga ao, aichore aike ase ebitunwa igoro, ne chindooche chiichorwe naro.
english: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.

ekegusii: Musa akamosorora, akamotebia, “Koranche tobaisa gototiga, ekiagera aye nomanyete buna togochia konagotoora ase erooro. Ase ayio nobe kogototang’ana.
english: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the desert, and you can be our eyes.

ekegusii: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
english: Abarwani boigo bakamosekereria, bakamochiera, bakamoa chinkama,

ekegusii: Naki barabwo bateba, “Amarube aye namarito, naende nigo are amakong’u, korende ekero are amo naintwe ere omonyene nigo are omoreu, na amang’ana aye tari gento.”
english: For some say, "His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing."

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha aroro.
english: Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.

ekegusii: Musa akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Genda mochore chimanwa echirabaisane abanto ba kera enyomba, mochinyenye chibe chimanwa chi’epasaka.
english: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go at once and select the animals for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb.

ekegusii: korende ritang’ani nigo naranderetie baria ba Damesiki, na Yerusalemu, na ase ense ya Boyahudi, na abanto b’Ebisaku, baonchoke, baonchokere Nyasae bakore ogokora kobwataine okoonchoka kwabo.
english: First to those in Damascus, then to those in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and to the Gentiles also, I preached that they should repent and turn to God and prove their repentance by their deeds.

ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu atari nengencho, na ase okogania okobe kw’omobere na obonyaka bakogenka abwo bachakire gotama baria bagendererete gochia gosira.
english: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of sinful human nature, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.

ekegusii: Nigo yarenge emeremo y’ababugia ebirombeta na abateri baigwekane bagoterera amo ase ogotogia Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono. Na amariogi ’amatera aimokereretigwe igoro, na ay’ebirombeta, na aye chisani chiarenge goakanigwa kwoga, na ay’ebinto binde biare kobugigwa, ekero baare gotogia Omonene, bagoteba, “Omonene nomuya, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare.” Agwo enyomba y’Omonene egaichorwa ne riire,
english: The trumpeters and singers joined in unison, as with one voice, to give praise and thanks to the LORD. Accompanied by trumpets, cymbals and other instruments, they raised their voices in praise to the LORD and sang: "He is good; his love endures forever." Then the temple of the LORD was filled with a cloud,

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio nkaragwa imbe omoraria, na omotomwa, erinde inyorokie abanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana ’okwegena na ekeene; nigo ngokwana ekeene, tindi gokwana oborimo.
english: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle-- I am telling the truth, I am not lying-- and a teacher of the true faith to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: Korende nigo ngochanda omobere one na koyokoria buna omosomba, erinde konarandeirie abande, inche timba omonto ogocha kwangwa.
english: No, I beat my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.

ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?
english: Has not my hand made all these things?'

ekegusii: Barabwo bagateba, “Aya namanyinga! Abaruoti baria barwanire barabwo ase barabwo na goitana. Ase ayio bono intwe Abamoabu, togende tosakore!”
english: "That's blood!" they said. "Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!"

ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro bw’abaare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.
english: His brother's name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.

ekegusii: Nigo banga buna chindoto omonto akweba mambia gakoboka. Aye Omonene, naboigo bare asore buna omogwekano okororwa ase okorota, ekero okoimoka nigo okweba ebieni biabo.
english: As a dream when one awakes, so when you arise, O Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

ekegusii: omokuani amorenge. Nere kararore ng’a ebisambo bie risankwa ri’omobere nigo bire ebirabu ake, ebisambo ebio tibiri bobe; omonto oyio ochenekire.
english: the priest is to examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; that person is clean.

ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
english: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"

ekegusii: Akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’agachie, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamoboria, “Kwarorire gento?”
english: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man's eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, "Do you see anything?"

ekegusii: Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe nebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.
english: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor will I satisfy with food.

ekegusii: Korende Yudas Iskariota mosinto o Simion, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,
english: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,

ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga arue buna arengereretie ase enkoro yaye, tari ase ogoichana, gose tari ase okobetererigwa, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire ere oyokorua nomogoko.
english: Each man should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

ekegusii: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
english: Na abange b’emeganda bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete bagachiaara nchera.

ekegusii: “Ekero ababisa baino barabamige na kobasiongorokana, nigo morabe nemechando emenene, goika morie emebere y’abana baino, baria Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire.
english: Because of the suffering that your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the LORD your God has given you.

ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’oborimo bwaino mwagerire abanyene oboronge baichanire ase chinkoro chiabo, abwo inche ntaichanetie. Nigo mwagerire abakori amabe koba noboremu, erinde tibaonchoka batige chinchera chiabo chi’obobe, erinde batoorie obogima bwabo.
english: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,

ekegusii: Omokungu oria n’Omogiriki orenge, egesaku kiaye n’Omosurofenisa. Akamosaba amosererie ekerecha korwa ase enyaroka yaye.
english: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.
english: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the LORD.

ekegusii: Yakobo agatwa ebite ebibese bi’emete gete enga buna omosobeti, na omolozi, na omouru, akabisata chinsemo, erinde emeng’ororia emerabu ekarorekana ase ebite biria.
english: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

ekegusii: Na bono timoremeiri keegwa kende gionsi, komoganyete okoorokigwa kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.
english: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

ekegusii: Abanto be chinse echio nigo barenge abareu batari na nguru, bakaondoka na gosookigwa, bakaba buna ebimeri bire mogondo, na buna obonyansi oborere, buna obonyansi bomerete kerama igoro bogosusana botarakina.
english: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

ekegusii: Enyomba yaye nero enchera ekogenda aase abakure; ee, enchera eyio nigo ekogenda ase chiero chi’amakweri.
english: Her house is a highway to the grave, leading down to the chambers of death.

ekegusii: “Naye Sulemani, omwana one, omomanye Nyasae one inche iso, naende omokorere nenkoro yao yonsi, na ase ogwancha kwao gwonsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro chionsi, naende nigo amanyete kera omoroberio na ebirengererio bionsi. Koramorigie, ere nanche omonyore; korende onye gokomotiga, ere nigo aragotugute kare na kare.
english: "And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands every motive behind the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name-- he is holy.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baare gotera ogotera okoyia, bagoteba, “Kwagweneire aye kobogoria ebuku na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye, ekiagera aye nkwanyenyetwe, na ase amanyinga ao okamogorera Nyasae abanto ba kera eamate, na omonwa, na abanto, na egesaku,
english: And they sang a new song: "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased men for God from every tribe and language and people and nation.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’omoerio bw’amagambi ayio, ekero abasaria barabe baikeire ekerengo kiabo ki’omoerio, omoruoti omotindi mono oichire nobong’ainereria naoroke.
english: "In the latter part of their reign, when rebels have become completely wicked, a stern-faced king, a master of intrigue, will arise.

ekegusii: “Ekero ndabaserie gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku na mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ching’ao, barabwo mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
english: "They will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo naruete ase abarendi abwo, nkanyora omwanchi bw’omoyo one. Nkamotarera tinamotiga agende; nigo namorentete mwa baba, nkamosoyia gochia ase eero y’oyio onyiborete.
english: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my heart loves. I held him and would not let him go till I had brought him to my mother's house, to the room of the one who conceived me.

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere, mochake korwa engaki eria mogochaka rigesa ase emegondo yaino.
english: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?
english: that the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, that he is delivered from the day of wrath?

ekegusii: Ase chinsemo chiaye narengeo amakomomanga emerongo kianda, na atano na rimo. Amakomomanga onsi arenge igoro ase egesure ekemo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi nigo arenge rigana erimo.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; the total number of pomegranates above the surrounding network was a hundred.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue asemore kegima.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.

ekegusii: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,
english: Eleazari akaibora Finehasi, na Finehasi akaibora Abisua;

ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene bweka, momokorere ase obwegenwa bwe chinkoro chiaino chionsi, mobe mokoinyora aya onsi amanene abakoreire.
english: But be sure to fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene mboorokigwe, na mwanyabanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo. Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio.”
english: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all mankind together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken."

ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochayirwe nabanto baria abang’ani, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abakoorire emiaka ebere na abatarakoora emiaka ebere, koreng’ana nekero keria atebetigwe nabanto baria abang’aini.
english: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, Nyasae oino, ritang’ani atararenta omosunte nainwe mogochwe amagoro, ekero rikogoroba ase ebitunwa. Ase engaki eria morabe mosemeretie konyora oborabu, naonchore oborabu obwo bobe obomwamu na abokore bobe omosunte omonene.
english: Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to thick darkness and change it to deep gloom.

ekegusii: Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chisemi.
english: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Tindigeti kogenda, korende nyuma yaye akaonchoka, akagenda.
english: "'I will not,' he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko atano na abere aerete, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Amatenenerio aye nigo aroiseirie chifeta, na ekiegeko kiaye nigo kiaroiseirie chitahabu; egeikaransero kiaye nigo giatubire negetambaa kemonyinga. Abakungu ba Yerusalemu nigo bagechaberete ime, bare nomoyo bw’ogwancha.
english: Its posts he made of silver, its base of gold. Its seat was upholstered with purple, its interior lovingly inlaid by the daughters of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ara gatato ngaakwa chinyimbo, erimo ngaakwa amagena. Ara gatato ngasarekerwa nemeeri, obotuko obomo na omobaso oyomo ngaikaransa igoro y’endiba;
english: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,

ekegusii: Abanto abanene na abake bare ase ense eye goika bakwe. Tibagotindekwa, na monto onde tari orabareere, gose gwekeba omobere, gose gokigita etukia ase engencho yabo.
english: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut himself or shave his head for them.

ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana ’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.

ekegusii: Eyio nero emeroberio echikire amo namachiko Omonene aruete goetera ase omonwa o Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ebe ase egati yaye na Abaisraeli.
english: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the LORD established on Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Tirisa, na akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere na ene.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.

ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana ’ababani abwo bagokwana, abwo bakobana oborimo ase erieta riane, bagoteba. Inche narotete, ee, narotete!
english: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, 'I had a dream! I had a dream!'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, manya ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene tirikogwa inse bosa, riria Omonene akwanete igoro y’enyomba y’Ahabu. Ekeene, Omonene okorire aya akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Elija.”
english: Know then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The LORD has done what he promised through his servant Elijah."

ekegusii: Ase eri nario moramanye Omoika o Nyasae: Kera omoika oyokoorokia Yeso Kristo, ng’a ochire ase omobere, oyio noyo o Nyasae,
english: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abwo bagochandwa koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae, tiga bakore amaya na babeke emioyo yabo asare ere oyore Omotongi omwegenwa.
english: So then, those who suffer according to God's will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo babakorerete, erio nyuma yaye aye nokwe, osangererekane amo nabanto bao.”
english: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people."

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni basamunsire amaboko abo, korende onde tari okobaremia. Omonene ochikire igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo ng’a abanto abwo babaetananire babe ababisa babo; Yerusalemu obeire okogechia asebare.
english: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

english: Tucker Childs: People are saying that people from Kim area of Sierra Leone are suffering. Those who say this are saying it's bad. I read in the NYtimes yesterday that people from Kim area of Sierra Leone were kidnapped 24 people. It seems this issue is serious because people are saying that this kidnapping has happened to them too. Very sad. The people there are saying that they are afraid because of this situation. That means those people are scared because of this kidnapping happening around them. It's very difficult. Mende. They are talking about people being afraid of the Mende. Some people are able to help people from Kim but they are afraid of the Mende. But some people have already started running away, because of this fear, they are also running away. This thing is really making things hard for people to live comfortably. These problems are very big and causing trouble for everyone. Who can help these people so that they can overcome this problem? Who will help those people who are currently struggling? I don't know. I remember when I was young, we used to play games with our friends, and we always felt proud to be Gusii. We had a game we played, which showed how strong the Gusii culture was. I remember well the story of teacher Sebelius Nyangau, who taught us about the history of Gesure. Being a Gusii person, it's something to be proud of, and it's something to carry forward. Because I also grew up with this pride of being a Gusii. Our traditions. Our customs. The pride of being a Gusii person has been passed down through generations. We also went to Nyamagwa, where people spoke proudly about the Gusii culture, and they said it was like a treasure. Wonderful. Beautiful. That village. We learned. Stories. We realized that growing up with this tradition helps build character. This pride makes people think deeply. The traditions of the Gusii people have helped shape their lives over many years. We also went to Kangema, Muranga, and we saw how people from Egeswaeli celebrate the culture of Egesongo. Kangema has raised children who respect their heritage. There is a school there, and we found about 20 Gusii people. America also celebrates the culture of Egesongo. Is it possible to establish a connection between Americans and schools that support the Gusii culture? Americans may not understand the importance of Egesongo. Is it right to ask them? Maybe we should show them what they are missing out on. It's true that they don't know much about Egesongo. They don't understand its value unless they become part of it. They need to learn about its accent. Those who haven't experienced it, they too can learn about it, just like everyone else. It's like discovering hidden treasures. The accent is important. It's true that many Americans don't understand the value of their own cultures. Many people around the world don't understand how important it is to preserve their traditions and appreciate the richness of African cultures. The experience of Americans is often shaped by someone like Tucker Childs, who comes from Sierra Leone. Teacher Childs studied at Portland State University in Oregon. He also collaborated with the University of London in England. He didn't understand the importance of preserving and appreciating his heritage. When I read that story, I wondered: If those people were alive today, would they understand why it's important to preserve our traditions? Would they work with Americans to achieve this goal? Of those 2000 things that came from Africa, about 60 are related to Kenya. When I started researching, I found out that Wikipedia lists 60 things related to Kenya. Komenta nayio, etugo ekarea bobe mono mbaka ekang’ea gokwa mono. Abanto ba Bomariba bagachandeka kegima, ase enchara kobaita. Ko obokongu bwaba obonge, ogosemeria gokaera ase abamenyi aba. Bono bakaganya ogokwa ekiagera baganyete embura ase amatuko amange goika bakarosa. Bono omogaka oyo Mogire agachandeka kerage ase eng’encho arenge n’ eamate enene, eyio arenge korageria. Bono egasi yaye nigo yarenge ogotimoka gwoka. Ase boigo, kera oyomo ase abanto baye, natageta aigote. Bono omogaka Mogire akarosa korigeria eamate yaye. Akaba tari kogenda gotwara erinde anyore kende arentere eamate yaye eche koria. Nyaboke agachia komosegeta agende buna abagaka bande bare kogenda korigeria chiaamate chiabo, Mogire ere akaanga pi, kagotimoka abwo ase enka yaye. Mogire akaba gakobera nyomba, na Nyaboke ogenda korigeria abana endagera. Bono abana aba ba Mogire nigo bare korora buna abaise ba abasani babo bare kogenda korigia endagera ya abana babo, babaretera baria. Abana aba nabarabwo bakagania ng'a ise omwabo nere agende kobarigeria endagera ekiagera ng’ina tare korenta endagera ekobaisana. Engaki eyemo, Nyaboke akaba kagosiria ogosemeria gw’ okorageria eamate eye yaye. Bono agatiana ng'a tarageria omogaka oyo oye Mogire otare korwa nyomba, oganyererete arenterwe endagera na Nyaboke, omanya goansa koinagera. Bono omogaka oyo Mogire nigo amenyete saiga mwaye. Bono ng'ai mwaira amabere n' obonyansi bwakabucha iga? Mabere tarengeo akonywegwa. Emete amo n' obonyansi biakinire aaria Bomariba. Picture na special correspondent, Bomariba. Gusii.com files. english: The Story of the Gusii XXXVI: The Herdsmen Who Milked the Cow, The Warrior Who Conquered the Land of Igoro! These are their stories: Long ago, a man named Oyomo had a wife, who lived near the place of Bomariba. This man was known as Mogire. And his wife was known as Nyaboke. Mogire and his wife, mother Nyaboke, had five children. The people were blessed with abundant harvests. This beautiful story lasted for five years, a large gathering took place near the place of Bomariba. The rain that fell was good and sufficient, and the millet grew well. Because of this, everyone was happy, and the food and drinks were plentiful. Comment on this, a house built beautifully until it reached completion. The people of Bomariba rejoiced greatly, because of the large harvest. And today, the celebration continues to attract visitors from Bomariba. But this celebration sometimes causes problems and conflicts. So when there is a disagreement, someone mediates among the visitors. But they agreed to share the harvest equally, so that no one would be left behind. And this man Mogire rejoiced greatly, because he had many possessions, which were being increased. But his last act was to become very generous. And because of this, long ago and the people of those days, he showed kindness. But this man Mogire decided to distribute his possessions. He could not bear to see anyone suffer while he had plenty. Nyaboke encouraged him to continue helping others, and Mogire agreed to do so, remembering his past. Mogire began to build houses, and Nyaboke went to distribute the children amongst them. And these children of Mogire decided to return to their mothers, so that their fathers could also distribute gifts to their children, sharing with them. These children then gathered together, saying that they should go and help distribute the gifts equally, so that no one feels neglected. Today, Nyaboke decided to oversee the distribution of her own possessions. But she wondered whether to tell this man, Mogire, not to build houses, but instead to share everything with Nyaboke, so that there would be unity. But this man Mogire understood her intentions. But why does milk and witchcraft cause trouble? Milk that has soured is wasted. Food and witchcraft have spread throughout Bomariba. Picture and special correspondent, Bomariba. Nyaboke was able to provide for her family, and she declared that harvests are not enough! But Mogire started to feel sorry for his relatives who were poor. Mogire decided to start working hard so that they could all benefit. But he went to his friends and asked them to help him with his work and his relatives. His friends agreed to help, promising that his possessions would increase. Mogire was surprised and happy to hear this from his friend. Today, rain fell and the land became fertile. When this happened, it was a sign that the harvest would be plentiful. Because of this, witchcraft disappeared. This tree grew tall, and its leaves provided shade. Mogire realized that he had made a mistake when he mistreated his cows! “Oh! We will celebrate and dance with joy. Let the elders milk the cows, and let the milk flow like a river!” Mogire. He continued to praise the cows, Mogire thanked his friend for helping him, and said that the elders should milk the cows, and let the milk flow like a river! He promised that he would not forget, and that he would always remember his friend. The respect that Nyaboke had for him increased, and she helped Mogire today with the work that had been left unfinished since the time of Bomariba. Now and forever, Nyaboke remembered the lesson about sharing with her children and going to visit her relatives. Going to visit her relatives, she reminded him of what Mogire had failed to do. But Nyaboke woke up that morning and remembered everything. The lesson of that day, she and her daughters remembered how Nyaboke protected them from Mogire’s neglect. But people gathered and wondered why they were unable to achieve the prosperity that Mogire and Nyaboke had achieved.
