english: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.

ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi akoreke ase obuya na ase omoroberio.
english: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”
english: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Ezara omokuani akarenta Ebuku eyio y’Amachiko ase omoganda bwonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya aya baigwete.
english: So on the first day of the seventh month Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, which was made up of men and women and all who were able to understand.

ekegusii: Naama! Aya narorire are amaya na agwenerete nokoria na konywa na koba nomogoko ase ebinto ebio bionsi omonto echandeire aiga inse y’erioba, ase engaki y’amatuko amake Nyasae amoeire; ekio nakio egetari kiaye.
english: Then I realized that it is good and proper for a man to eat and drink, and to find satisfaction in his toilsome labor under the sun during the few days of life God has given him-- for this is his lot.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku ekeng’ese kia Manase: chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000), baria batoretwe amarieta abo bache kobeka Daudi abe omoruoti.
english: men of half the tribe of Manasseh, designated by name to come and make David king-- 18,000;

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense ya Kanani gochia ase omochie o Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya Negebu ebe eyabo.
english: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess [the land] as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.

ekegusii: Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa asebare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.
english: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' lend to 'sinners,' expecting to be repaid in full.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ase enchera eyio nabo inche ndasarie oboenenu bw’Abayuda na oboenenu obonene mono bw’abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabatebigwe ase emereng’anio, erinde okorora barore, korende tibarora, naende okoigwa baigwe, korende tibamanya.
english: He said, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, "'though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.'

ekegusii: Agachia korora emeganda y’abanto, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera konya bachandekire, baserebekanire buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.
english: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion on them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba baye agateba, “Tiga totome abanto bagende boyie chibarasi isano korwa ase echio chitigarete ase omochie, baroote tomanye amang’ana buna are. Emechando erabanyore abanto abwo tekoba emebe kobua ey’abwo batigarete ase omochie, gose ey’Abaisraeli bonsi basiririe obogima bwabo.
english: One of his officers answered, "Have some men take five of the horses that are left in the city. Their plight will be like that of all the Israelites left here-- yes, they will only be like all these Israelites who are doomed. So let us send them to find out what happened."

ekegusii: Naki oyominto, nigo nabete nomogoko omonge na okoremigwa ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao, ekiagera chinkoro chi’abachenu chiatimogetigwe naye.
english: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

ekegusii: “Erio nkaroisia Esanduku ye chibao chi’omokonge, na nkabaacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chiagwekaine chiria chie ritang’ani; nkabogoria chibao chiria ibere ase okoboko kwane, ngatiira gochia ase egetunwa igoro.
english: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

ekegusii: Bakabakorera obomera, na obomera bokagwera Matia; ere agachorwa koba amo nabatomwa ikomi nomo.
english: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

ekegusii: Naende Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamotebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y’etahabu.
english: So Moses went back to the LORD and said, "Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata, na nigo bamanyete koruta emegwe na amagena e chinduruche nokoboko gw’okorio amo nogw’okobee. Aba nigo barenge Ababenjamin, abanto bamwabo Saulo. Abanto aba nabwo aba:
english: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were kinsmen of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene Nyasae konya akorire korwa ase amaroba kera eng’iti y’orosana, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, agachirenta ase omonto oria, arore buna agochiroka; na buna arogete kera egetongwa kere moyo, erieta riaye rikaba rirorio erio.
english: Now the LORD God had formed out of the ground all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Maresa, nimbarentere oyorababue. Oyore Obonene bw’Abaisraeli naike Adulamu.
english: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

ekegusii: “Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.
english: "O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry never be laid to rest!

ekegusii: Nigo okobeka ekerarero kiao ase egetunwa keimokererete igoro mono, erio gwatiira gochiao korua ekeng’wanso.
english: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.
english: He replied: "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is near.' Do not follow them.

ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogambera naende.
english: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has mastery over him.

ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau bakoriga‐rigigwa ne chinibo chiabo chibisire chiaorokigwe maiso marore!
english: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!

ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamin, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;
english: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

ekegusii: Korwa Beteli rokagenda Lusu, rogatiira gochia Ataroti ase Abaariki bamenyete.
english: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

ekegusii: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).
english: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of the body I do not know-- God knows.

ekegusii: naende konya amochikire ase ring’ana erio, ng’a tabaisa gotunyana chinyasae chinde. Korende Sulemani tarenda amang’ana ayio Omonene amochigete.
english: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD's command.

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti agatoma gochia aroro chibarasi, ne chigari, na omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi, na barabwo bagaika aroro botuko, bakanaaria omochie.
english: Then he sent horses and chariots and a strong force there. They went by night and surrounded the city.

ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo boria na egesasimero, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori chionsi chireo amo nebikorero bigokorerwao. Barabwo bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
english: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance, the ropes and all the equipment used in its service. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na bonsi aba Yerusalemu bakamochiera, bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodan, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.
english: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Kora onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao. Genda, inche nigo inde amo naye, ninkore buna oganetie.”
english: "Do all that you have in mind," his armor-bearer said. "Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul."

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”
english: "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked. "Seven," they replied.

ekegusii: Erio agatoma abarwani bagende korwana esegi, bare ebiombe bitato, ekemo inse y’oboraai bwa Yoabu, ne egia kabere inse y’oboraai bw’Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu boigo, na egia gatato inse y’oboraai bwa Itai korwa Gati. Omoruoti agatebia abanto baye, “Nigo nkogenda amo nainwe inche omonyene.”
english: David sent the troops out-- a third under the command of Joab, a third under Joab's brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, "I myself will surely march out with you."

ekegusii: Nigo agokorera abanto chilifu obwanchani botari koera; ere nigo akwabera amamocho, na ogosaria, na ebibe, korende tagotiga koa abana na abachokoro egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.”
english: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation."

ekegusii: Ee, ntwarora amamonto, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki. Intwe nigo twerora ng’a nabasinini mono, tore buna ebisase. Naboigo twarorekana asebare.”
english: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them."

ekegusii: Minto FM Omogavana o’ Kisii County otebire buna eng’encho nereo abakoreri bo obochenu gotiga omogira na koirana emeremo. Nigo amentire goteba abakoreri abwo bo Obochenu nigo bare egati ya baria bagoakanwa eng’eria […] Abakenya Bamenyete ime Yense Ya Amerika, barobeirie gochi koumerana nomorai Bwense eyio -Joe Biden ewiki ogocha erio komoerera ekere Baganeti. Aya Nkorengána na Job Nyangenya Bwomanga Omenyete ime TEXAS. Omoteneneri omonene bwa amang’ana ya abasae ase abisi yo omokonyi bwo omorai bwense omosike Anthony Kibagendi otebire buna abasae nigo bagwenerete kobeka ebirengererio biabo mono ase ensemo yo oboremi amo […] Minto FM: Eng’ana yo okoruisigwa abisi yo omonogeri bwe ebunge ye ecounty ya Kisii omosike Kombo David Omo-MCA bwe e-ward ya Marani omosike Dennis Ombachi, oenekirie buna e-bill yo okogania komoruisia omo-spika bwe county ya Kisii emeremo omosike David Kombo, nigo yaiyerigwa ase ogotanyora chikura chiria chiganeirie […] Ababasi mbirero bare igoro yogotabgwa kwe-ecostituency eyio goetera ase okorosigwa kworoboti rwa BBI. Professor bwamangána agesiasa – Charles Choti nigo atebire barabwo buna ababasi mbarigochi gwancherana amngána ayuo. Abakenya baborigwe bagenderere koerenda nagoetanga korwa ase oborwaire bwa HIV gose enyamoreo ase engencho omobaro bwa baria barwarete nigo ogenderete koba igoro. Goikera bono, Kenya nigo ebwate abarwaire ba HIV […] Omowakili James Mamboleo nigo aegereire oroboti rwa BBI ase atebire nga okomentwa kwebitoki gochia ase chicounty ase ekerengo kia 35% naboigo ogochigochakigwa kwekegancha kia aba-MCA negere chicounty chikore amagenderero. Omowakili Victor Swanya otogirie egetambokoro gia BBI giokomenta abachumbe ase chi-constituency chiria chibwate abanto abange. Ase egetambokero ekio, omosike Swanya nigo aganetie chibesa chimentwe ekiagera chi-constituency chire aroro chibwate abanto […] Minto FM: Abasacha nigo bagendererete koerusia obogima ase engencho batari gosanga emechando yabo – Vincent Osere Kobwatekana no obotuki bwa bwango iga nigo bokoorokia buna omobaro bwa abasacha abwo bakoerusia obogima okinire mono. Vincent Osere oywo ore e-transformative coach naboigo e-motivational speaker nigo atebire buna abagaka […] Minto FM: Chibunge chie chi-county nchibwenerete chitware obosibore buna chiria chiense – Denis Ombachi – MCA Marani Ward Omo-MCA bwe E-ward ya Marani oywo boigo ore omonyakerogo ase ekomiti ye e-budget ime ye ecounty ya Kisii omosike Dennis Ombachi otebire buna nigo chibunge chie chi-county chigwenerete kobekerwa e-budget […]
english: Minto FM The Governor of Kisii County has announced that he will meet with leaders from various sub-counties to discuss development and security issues. He said he wants to work with leaders from those sub-counties to ensure there is peace and stability […] Kenyan citizens living in the United States have expressed their support for President Joe Biden's efforts to address climate change. This was stated by Nkorengána and Job Nyangenya Bwomanga during an event in TEXAS. A prominent lawyer, Anthony Kibagendi, has announced that he will provide legal assistance to people who have been affected by floods. He said that people should be prepared to seek help when they need it […] Minto FM: Reports indicate that investigations are underway regarding allegations against the Speaker of the Kisii County Assembly, David Kombo. The MCA for Marani ward, Dennis Ombachi, has claimed that a bill seeking to impeach the Speaker of the Kisii County Assembly, David Kombo, is being undermined. He alleges that someone is trying to prevent it from being discussed […] Several residents have accused MPs of interfering with the constituency elections process to influence the outcome of the BBI referendum. A professor of political science – Charles Choti – has stated that residents are concerned about the interference. Kenyans are encouraged to get tested for HIV regularly, especially young people, so they can receive treatment early if they test positive. Currently, Kenya has a large number of people living with HIV […] Lawyer James Mamboleo has criticized the BBI report, claiming that it unfairly allocates resources to constituencies, giving them 35% while MCAs receive less. He argues this allocation is unfair. Lawyer Victor Swanya says the BBI proposals are dividing constituents because some areas feel left out. According to Swanya, these concerns need to be addressed to ensure inclusivity in the constituencies. Minto FM: Residents are urging young people to take advantage of opportunities available to improve their lives – Vincent Osere Concerns about the high rate of unemployment have led to calls for initiatives to empower youth. Vincent Osere, a transformative coach and motivational speaker, has stated that young people need to be supported […] Minto FM: The county assembly should prioritize development projects that benefit everyone – Denis Ombachi – MCA Marani Ward The MCA for Marani ward, Dennis Ombachi, who is also a member of the budget committee of the Kisii County Assembly, has stated that the county assembly needs to allocate funds appropriately […]

ekegusii: Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.
english: "How then can I dispute with him? How can I find words to argue with him?

ekegusii: “Kwana nabanto bonsi b’ense eye, na abakuani, obaborie: Ekero mwarenge kweng’ata na korera ase kera omotienyi o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, ase chingaki echi chionsi chi’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, Inee, nigo mwarenge kweng’ata ase engencho yane?
english: "Ask all the people of the land and the priests, 'When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?

ekegusii: “Nase ki ndabeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egereti obogima bwane.
english: Why do I put myself in jeopardy and take my life in my hands?

ekegusii: “Sangererekana amo inwe mwensi, moigwe! Ning’o ase chinyasae echio obanete amang’ana aya? Omonto oyio Omonene anchete nere oraikeranie okogania kw’Omonene igoro ya Babeli, nere orarwanie Abakalidayo.
english: "Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of [the idols] has foretold these things? The LORD's chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.

ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omoruoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.
english: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking men from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Tiatira rika: Amang’ana aya naro Omwana o Nyasae agokwana, ere oyore namaiso agwoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na amagoro aye nigo anga buna etaai esenirie mono.
english: "To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agachika abasomba baye, akabora, “Kwana na Daudi bobisi, momotebie ng’a inche omoruoti nigo ngokirie nere, na abasomba baane bonsi nigo bamwanchete. Ase ayio bono momotebie ng’a inche imbe ise biara.”
english: Then Saul ordered his attendants: "Speak to David privately and say, 'Look, the king is pleased with you, and his attendants all like you; now become his son-in-law.'"

ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.
english: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.

ekegusii: Ningosirie ase enchera y’okoondokia mono, tokogenderera kobao; abanto mbakorigie, korende tibagokonyora naende nonya ng’ake. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’ee abanto abaao abakungu babo, na emegondo yabo ninyee abanto barababue. Abanto aba bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare neribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.
english: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abakungu. Moka Aburamu nigo arenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere ise Milka na Isika.
english: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milcah and Iscah.

ekegusii: abwo batari gokora amabe, korende nigo bakobwatia chinchera chiaye.
english: They do nothing wrong; they walk in his ways.

ekegusii: Abwo abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
english: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagakora onsi aya Omonene achigete Musa na Haroni.
english: The Israelites did just what the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Then the young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
english: Abamura bakaimoka, bakamotuba egetambaa, bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomoiseke o nyoko moke, moga iso; oyio nomoiseke omino iso aiborete.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father's wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Lawi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abagerisoni, abarwete ase Gerisoni, na Abakohati, abarwete ase Kohati, na Abamerari, abarwete ase Merari.
english: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.

ekegusii: Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y’amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, gose ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.

ekegusii: Abasomba nabwo bagotogambera, na onde tari ogototooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
english: Slaves rule over us, and there is none to free us from their hands.

ekegusii: Abisalomu agasorora omoruoti mono goika ere akamwanchera Amunoni amo nabamura bande bonsi baye bagende nere.
english: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king's sons.

ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are igoro, na nigo agokora rinde rionsi agwancha.
english: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Ng’usa obota bwao!” Nere akabong’usa. Na Elisha akabeka amaboko aye ase amaboko ’omoruoti oria,
english: "Take the bow in your hands," he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king's hands.

ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang’ana ’obong’aini, na ebirengererio bi’enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi’okomanya.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the utterance from my heart will give understanding.

ekegusii: buna amache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa mwanyabanto.
english: as water wears away stones and torrents wash away the soil, so you destroy man's hope.

ekegusii: Abanto bande abanene b’Abaefraimu: Asaria, mosinto o Yohanani, na Berekia mosinto o Mesilemoti, na Yehisikia, mosinto o Salumu, na Amasa, mosinto o Hadilai, bagatenena gokania abarwani baria barenge koirana korwa ase esegi,
english: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim-- Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai-- confronted those who were arriving from the war.

ekegusii: Mobaatere mobareng’anerie kera omonto ensemo yaye. Nigo netianetie koa chisokoro chiaino ense eye; ase ayio ense eyio nebe omwando oino.
english: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your forefathers, this land will become your inheritance.

ekegusii: Bono ekaba ng’a rituko erimo ekero abana ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase baare.
english: One day the angels came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them.

ekegusii: Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.
english: Then the Jews led Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness the Jews did not enter the palace; they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.

ekegusii: nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete nendamwamu enene asetore;
english: when their anger flared against us, they would have swallowed us alive;

ekegusii: Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa asebare, ee, nabeire asebare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.
english: "And now their sons mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.

ekegusii: Omonto ore ne ribero nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyosemeretie Omonene natenenkigwe.
english: A greedy man stirs up dissension, but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabatebia, “Oria nomogati oyo Omonene abaeire morie.
english: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the LORD has given you to eat.

ekegusii: Igwa, abanto abwo bare chituoni nigo bakorera mono agwo isiko, na abwo batomirwe bare namang’ana ’omorembe nigo bakorera bare nobororo.
english: Look, their brave men cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatore ase enyomba eye ere buna eema, nigo togwechanda, toritoerwa, tari ng’a igo torigetie korusigwa ase enyomba eye, korende ntorigetie okoboyigwa konde, erinde egekonyorekana namakweri kemerwe nobogima.
english: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rinene ri’omoruoti oito abagambi bakanywa edivai endoro goika ekabarwaria, na ere omonyene akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwatana nabanyacheche.
english: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

ekegusii: “Abakori amabe nigo bakonyorekana ase egati y’abanto baane; abwo nigo bagotega buna abategi be chinyoni, nigo bakobeka amareba babwate abanto.
english: "Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch men.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae, oyio ogosangereria Abaisraeli abaseretigwe, agoteba: “Ninsangererie abanto bande abaao amo kobua abwo konya basangererigwe.”
english: The Sovereign LORD declares-- he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered."

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Tingotebeti komwabera chintunda isano na ibere, mwabere nonya ne chintunda isano na ibere ara emerongo etano na ebere.

ekegusii: Naki nigo erikire “Oyorigetie gwancha obogima na korora amatuko amaya, tiga atange oromeme rwaye tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biaye tibikwana obong’ainereria.
english: For, "Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.

ekegusii: Ase igo Ahabu agatoma abanto bagasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi na ababani bonsi ba Baali amo, agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli.
english: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri tibaseretie abanto bamenyete ase emechie y’Ako, na Sidoni, na Alabu, na Akisibu, na Heliba, na Afeki, na Rehobu.
english: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Acco or Sidon or Ahlab or Aczib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob,

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, karie ebuku eye ngokoa eichore ase enda yao.” Erio nkayeria, egansa ase omonwa one buna obooke.
english: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

ekegusii: Erio kegima ensoko y’amanyinga aye egakama: akaigwa omobere oye ng’a ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.
english: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.

ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simeoni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y’omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
english: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro yaye, erinde akaigwa amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.
english: One of those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul's message.

ekegusii: Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.
english: He who conceals his hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

ekegusii: Onye nomobisa ore gonchecheria, nanga nigo nare koremereria; naende onye nomobisa ore gonkorera bobe ase oboenenu, nanga nigo nare kwebisa.
english: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.

ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.
english: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.

ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabatebia, “Naki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timekomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?
english: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: "Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?

ekegusii: Obwanchani tibogokorera omogisangio oo bobe; naboigo, obwanchani nabwo bogoikerania amachiko.
english: Love does no harm to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

ekegusii: Erio nintome omosomba one arigie emegwe eria. Kondatebie omosomba oria: Rigereia, emegwe nigo ere magega ao, gocha ensemo yane, genda oyerente, rirorio aye Daudi ochiche, obe nomorembe. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, togokorerwa bobe bonde.
english: Then I will send a boy and say, 'Go, find the arrows.' If I say to him, 'Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,' then come, because, as surely as the LORD lives, you are safe; there is no danger.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okorua oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.
english: The LORD works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti chinene; korende enyimbo ya Haroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.
english: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotegerera amang’ana onsi abanto bagokwana, nigo orabaise koigwa omosomba oo ogokoragereria.
english: Do not pay attention to every word people say, or you may hear your servant cursing you--

ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino Abafarisai, ekiagera mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na kera egesaku gie chinyeni, mogotiga oboronge na obwanchani bwa Nyasae. Naro aya nabagwenerete moyakore, motari gotiga ayande.
english: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.

ekegusii: Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.
english: Lacking clothes, they go about naked; they carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.

ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abamisiri, mbarente bamenye ase ense ya Patirosi, ensemo ya irianyi, ense eyio yarenge eyabo. Aroro agwo mbabe noboruoti botari ne chinguru.
english: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

ekegusii: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.
english: Timoba buna chibarasi ne chiyombo chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, baria barenge abamo be chirooti chiria chiarootete ense eria, bagatandora chianga chiabo,
english: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes

english: Let us celebrate this beautiful song that began with our fathers who left a good foundation for future generations and a good example for our children. Let us celebrate this beautiful song that began with our fathers who left a good foundation for future generations and a good example for our children, but let us also remember the pain of those who lost their lives due to the coronavirus pandemic, and may God bless the entire economy of Kenya. ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia; raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia.
english: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

ekegusii: Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.
english: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

ekegusii: Nigo gwakwanete ng’a obobe nobwao, ekiagera Omonene omentire omoichano ase obororo bwao, naende ng’a kwarosire ase ogochandeka kwao, gose tori nogotimoka.
english: You said, 'Woe to me! The LORD has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.'"

ekegusii: Agaita Abafilisti, akaira ense yabo goikera Gasa na orogongo rw’aroro, akaira onsi, emerobiri y’okorenda amo nemechie yagiteire chindwaki.
english: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.

ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene bw’okomanya, ng’a nonya namakweri, nonya nobogima, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nabare ne chinguru, nonya nebinto ebireo, nonya nebi gochi‐gocha, nonya nokobua,
english: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

ekegusii: Nkarengereria: Nkoriina inde omokendo oyo, imbwaterere chinsagia chiaye. Naki yare koba buya onye chimbeere chiao nchiaba buna ebisago bi’amasabibu, ne rimisu ri’omonwa oo ribe buna eri’amapera,
english: I said, "I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit." May your breasts be like the clusters of the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,

ekegusii: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
english: Ahiya, na Hanani, na Anani;

ekegusii: “Abaasuri mbaitwe nemioro, korende tari eya mwanyabanto, ee, emioro etari eya mwanyabanto nebasirie. Abanto abwo mbatame korwa ase esegi, na abamura babo mbairwe ase obosomba, bakore emeremo ase okobetererigwa.
english: "Assyria will fall by a sword that is not of man; a sword, not of mortals, will devour them. They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor.

ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, na obororo, na ababwatire nebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.
english: News about him spread all over Syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering severe pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and he healed them.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Serubabeli, na aya Nehemia, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo barenge korua kera rituko ebiegwa biachikeire abateri na abarendi b’ebiita. Boigo naende bakaba bakoa Abalawi ebitari ebi baatananeretwe, na Abalawi barabwo bakaa abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni ebitari biabo.
english: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the singers and gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.

ekegusii: Na Petero, karengereretie okorora koria, Omoika okamotebia, “Rora, abanto batato bagokorigia.
english: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Simon, three men are looking for you.

ekegusii: Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.
english: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa kogoka gose gochenga buna abanto b’ebisaku bagokora, ekiagera inwe mwakorire obotomani, mwatigire Nyasae oino. Mwagokeire eng’eria y’obotomani ase kera ekeooreri gi’okoorera.
english: Do not rejoice, O Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.

ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Aleksanderi, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso ’abanto. Aleksanderi akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.
english: The Jews pushed Alexander to the front, and some of the crowd shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende nyuma Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorete aya.
english: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

ekegusii: “Barabwo mborokererie abanto baane bamanye gwatanana ebinto bire ebichenu na ebitaatananiri koba ebichenu, naende baborokererie bamanye gwatanana ebinto bichenegete na ebitachenegeti.
english: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.

ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.
english: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous fall.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyacheche akonyora egesusuro, oria otamanyeti amange nigo akoba omong’aini; na ekero omonto omong’aini akworokererigwa nigo akonyora chisemi.
english: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; when a wise man is instructed, he gets knowledge.

ekegusii: Gaki inwe rika rirube ase Abayahudi, moribeke erieta riane, inche omoruoti, morike buna morarore, moribeke ekemanyererio ki’ebonyi yane, ekiagera rirube rinde rionsi ririkire na kobekwa erieta ri’omoruoti amo nekemanyererio ki’ebonyi yaye, onde tari orarionchore.”
english: Now write another decree in the king's name in behalf of the Jews as seems best to you, and seal it with the king's signet ring-- for no document written in the king's name and sealed with his ring can be revoked."

ekegusii: Naki nigo bantebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.
english: They said to me, 'Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him.'

ekegusii: Erio otige enyongo eyio ere bosa igoro ase omorero bw’amakara, eyie esambwe, erinde etaai y’enyongo eyio eyie ebariire burure; riko rire imeo rigokomoke, na oboboosu bw’enyongo eyio boyie bonyititoke boere.
english: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows so its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.

ekegusii: Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.
english: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.

ekegusii: Korende Amasia tanchete gotegerera. Nyasae nigo achigete ng’a Abayuda babekwe ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, ekiagera barigetie chinyasae chi’Abaedomu.
english: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might hand them over to [Jehoash], because they sought the gods of Edom.

ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang’e nere bakabora, “Inee! Naye okorama omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”
english: Those who were standing near Paul said, "You dare to insult God's high priest?"

ekegusii: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
english: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekina baite Lazaro boigo,

ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oranyorekane ore ang’e kobua nase omonto oyio akwerete, bachore ritororo ritarakorigwa emeremo, gose ritarasiberwa rikorogoto ase ogokurura ebinto.
english: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

ekegusii: Nyasae one nere egetare kiane, asare nao nyebisete, ere nenguba yane enkengerete, na orogunchara rwane rwandeterete ogotooreka, naende nere eburi yane enkong’u, na obotamero bwane. Ere n’Omotooria one, oyogontooria korwa ase obotindi.
english: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior-- from violent men you save me.

Ani Bwanchi Mbwa Maiso, Mioyo Etamanyaini" Egioto Ekemo Korwa Aaria Nyabitunwa Bine Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare ebioto mbiarenge aroro aaria Nyabitunwa Bine. Biri binde kibiachia korora aya bikamoboria buna gose nkoigwa arenge buna biare gokwana. Egioto eke gekabatebia buna ime y' engoro eyio ime, nigo amato atinete !! These days are like this: Long ago, the people lived peacefully among the people of Nyabitunwa Bine. The people who were there used to live happily and peacefully. Abarumi 3:23 Mwanyabanto igo atongetwe abe omosani O'Nyasae, korende ere akarigia enchera yokogenda kobwaye na obosani bwaye na Nyasae bokabutoka. Eke nakio Ebibilia ekoroka ebibe. Ase omogwekano... - Ekero mwanyabanto akoba mamincha ya Nyasae. - Ekero mwanyabanto atari komosika Nyasae. - Ekero mwanyabanto atari komenya ime yechinchera ching'ikeranu chia Nyasae. MWANYABANTO OATANANIRWE KORWA ASE NYASAE Taibo, obobe bwaino nabwo bwabaatananire korwa ase Nyasae Oino. Ebibe biaino biagerire Omonene obisire obosio bwaye korwa asemore, ase igo tari koigwa ogosaba kwaino. Isaya 59:2 Nyasae nomochenu na mwanyabanto nomonyabibe. Mwanyabanto origirie chinchera chiokomoikera Nyasae ase chinchera ao ao: goetera ase Ekanisa, ogokora okuya, gokonya abanto bande, korende ase chinguru chiaye osinyirwe. |Richiko na 3. YESO KRISTO NERE ENCHERA YOKA YOKORUSIA EBIBE Yeso Kristo agakwa ase engencho y'ebibe biaito erio mwanyabanto anyare komanya obwanchani na omoroberio o Nyasae ase obogima bwaye. AGAKWA NAENDE AKABOKA: Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y'ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho yabatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. I Petero 3:18 YESO IMOYO ARE Nyuma y'ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia asebare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng'a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y'amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y'oboruoti bwa Nyasae. Ogokora Kw'Abatomwa 1:3 YESO NERE ENCHERA YEKEENE YOKA Yeso akamoiraneria, Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera asencle. Yohana 14:6 Goetera ase ogokwa kwa Yeso Kristo ase omosaraba mwanyabanto onyarire goika ase Nyasae. Okomanya amachiko aya atato oka taisaini. Ogochika gwa kane nigo gogokomanyia buna oranyare komonyora Kristo ase obogima bwao... Richiko ria 4. NEKOGWENERETE KOMOMANYA YESO KRISTO BUNA OMOTORIA NA OMOKONYI BWOBOGIMA BWAO. Nario oramanye obwanchani na omoroberio o'Nyasae igoro yobogima bwao. GOIKA OMONYORE KRISTO GOETERA ASE OKWEGENA Korende bonsi abamwanchete, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae, nabwo bariegenire erieta riaye. Yohana 1:12 Naki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y'okwegena; ayio tarwete asemore abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde tacha gwetogia. Abaebeso 2:8,9 NIGO OKOMONYORA KRISTO GOETERA ASE OKOMWARIGANIA ASOE ASE ENKORO YAO Rigereria, ninteneine gesieri gotura; omonto karaigwe eriogi riane na koigora egesieri, ninsoe asare, nindagere amo nere, na ere amo nainche. Okomanoka 3:20 Komwanchera Yeso Kristo asoe ase enkoro yao nokomanya ng'a: - Goonchoka gochia ase Nyasae na gotiga ebibe - Komwegena Kristo asoe enkoro yao naende akwabere ebibe biao. - Omwanchere aonchore obogima bwao obe buna atagete ere. Inee bicha ki ere omoreng'anio oo? Inee bicha ki oganetie ebe omoreng'anio bwo obogima bwao? Ayakobwatia nomoroberio buna oramonyore Kristo ase obogima bwao. NABO ORAMONYORE KRISTO BONO IGA Morangerie Yesu asoe ime yobogima bwao. Mwegene Omonene anyare kogokorera kobwatekana na eira yaye. Ere Yesu bwanchire akwariganie naende naganetie komenya ime yenkoro yao. Nabo orasabe iga. Omonene Yeso Kristo, ninkoganetie. Naigoire egesieri kiobogima bwane naende nagwanchire obe omotoria naende omonene one ekiagera inche natigire ebibe. Imbuya mono ase okonyabera ebibe biane. Kabe omonyakerogo bwobogima bwane. Onkore omonto oria otagete imbe ase obosio bwao. AMINA Inee Ogosaba oko inkworokia kore okogania gwenkoro yao? Onye ogosaba oko kore okogania kwomoyo oo, bono saba onyare komwanchera Kristo asoe ime yobogirna bwao. BUNA ORAMANYE NG'A YESU OSOIRE IME YE ENKORO YAO Bono inee? Kwamwariganeirie Yeso ime yobogima bwao? Naki omanyete? Kobwatekana na Okomanoka 3:20 Ng'ai Kristo are bono iga? Kristo otebire buna nachiche ime yobogima bwao. Inee nang'ainererie gose? Naki oramanye ng'a Nyasae okoiraneirie ogosaba kwao? (Egekogera natebete ng'a onde bwensi oranyegene amo na amariko ane nakonyeke ekiagera ariegenire erieta ri'Omwana o Nyasae!) OYORE NA YESO NARE NOBOGIMA BWA KARE NA KARE Naki obo nabwo oborori, ng'a Nyasae otoeire obogima bwa kare na kare, na obogima obo nigo bore ime ase Omwana oye. Ere oyore n'omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n'Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima. Nabarikeire inwe amang'ana aya, erinde momanye ng'a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri'Omwana o'Nyasae. 1 Yohana 5:11-13 Mwaakere Nyasae imbuya mono kera rituko kiagera Kristo nare ime yobogima bwao. "Mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachigete; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw'ense" (Mathayo 28:20). Okoeire obogima bwa kare na kare. Abakristo nigo bagwenerete kwegena omonene Nyasae oito amo nering'ana riaye buna erikire ase ebibilia. Neba buna oranyare kweigwa aye omonyene, manya nga Kristo ere tari goonchoka ase obogima bwao. "Timoba abanchi chibesa, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene otebire, "Tinkogotiga nonya ng'ake, gose tingokoremera" (Abaiberania 13:5) Ebigicha eye yegari igo egotworokia obomaene bwe Ebibilia. Okwegena amo na okweigwa igo bigokora emeremo ase obogima two omoknisto. - Obomaene bwomonene igo bobwate chinguru chiogototang'ana - (Einchini) - Igo tobwateranetigwe nechinguru chiobomaene na okwegena - (Amaguta ye ebetironi) - Buna tokoigwera obomaene, ebirengererio biaito igo bikobwatia enchera endonge. - (Orotuba gose eturera) - Igo tokwegena Nyasae nobomaene bwaye korende tari okweigwa gwaito Ekero twakorire ebibe nigo egwenerete twangame nere natwabere. Ase go tonyara kwegena ebirengererio biao korende bwegene obomaene bwe ring'ana ria Nyasae. BONO KWAMONYORIRE KRISTO Ekero kwamonyorete Kristo ase enkoro yao ebinto ebinge igo biakoregete. - Kristo agasoa ime yenkoro yao (Okomanoka 3:20 na Abakorosai 1:27) - Ebibe biao bikaberwa (Abakorosai 1:14) - Okaba omwana o Nyasae (Yohana 1:12) - Kwanyarire konyora omoroberio omyuya noborai obuya bwa Nyasae ase obogima bwao (Yohana 10:10 na II Abakorinto 5:14, 15, 17). Inee nonyare korengereria igoro ya kende gionsi ekiya kebuete Kristo oyore ime yenkoro yao? Onye nabo mwaakere Nyasae imbuya mono ase ogosaba bono iga ase amaya agokoreire. Goakera Nyasae imbuya mono igo gokworokia okwegena. Tosabe bono tosibogete. Egento kende ninki? BUNA ORANYARE GOKINA ASE EKEMOIKA Buna omwana omoke agokina naboigo egwenerete omokristo nere akine ekemoika. Amang'ana akobwatia nabo aranyare kogokonya. EKANISA IGO ERE YENGENCHO ENENE MONO Ekero chinko chibekire amo, igo chikoyia noborabu obonene mono. Beka oroko rokoyia ase riraba rire nobokendu nomorero oye igo okorima naende obe ekegenga, chinko chinyinge nigo chigwoka buya. Ase omobwekano oyo: igo ere obogima obokong'u mono ekero ogotema komenya obogima bwegekristo aye bweka. Igo ere buya mono kegima ekero mokobwaterana nabakristo bande baria bamomanyete Yeso Kristo buna omotoria obo (Abaibirania 10:25) Goika ogende ekanisa eria abanto begenete buna Ebibilia nering'ana riobomaene ria Nyasae, naende ase Yeso Kristo agotogigwa buna nomwana O Nyasae.

YOU MUST KNOW JESUS CHRIST SO THAT YOUR LOVE AND FAITH MAY BE IN HIS LIFE. Believe in God’s love and eternal life. COME TO CHRIST THROUGH FAITH Whoever believes, he shall become a child of God, and they shall receive His inheritance. John 1:12 By grace you have been saved through faith, and this is not from yourselves, but a gift from God, so that no one may boast. Ephesians 2:8,9 TO KNOW CHRIST MEANS TO LIVE WITH HIM AND IN HIS CHURCH Reveal yourself, because I stand at the door and knock: if anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him, and I will sup with him, and he with me. Revelation 3:20 To accept Jesus Christ and live with Him means: - To turn away from sin and seek God - To accept Christ into their lives and let Him forgive their sins. - To surrender their whole life to Him completely. What prevents you from doing this now? What keeps you from receiving this life? Jacob says that God’s love requires us to believe in Christ and eternal life. AND IF YOU BELIEVE IN CHRIST TODAY Receive Jesus into your life. Accept the Father’s invitation to be reconciled with Him. Let Jesus change your heart and help you live in His church. And pray today. Father Jesus Christ, I confess. I give you my life and I surrender myself to you, and I want to live according to Your will and do what pleases You. Lord, cleanse me from my sins. Give me strength to live according to Your life. Amen Does God ask you to open the doors of your heart? Anyone who asks God to open his heart, also ask Him to accept Christ into his life. IF YOU KNOW THIS ABOUT JESUS HE GIVES YOU HIS LIFE So what? Will you accept Jesus into your life? Why not? According to Revelation 3:20, is Christ waiting for you today? Christ promises to enter and live in your life. What are you waiting for? Do you know that God loves you and wants to answer your prayers? (Consider this truth carefully, so that no one deceives you and causes you to reject the inheritance of the Son of God!) LIVE WITH JESUS NOW AND FOREVER Why would you refuse, when God offers eternal life, and that life is only through His Son? If you join the Son, you have eternal life; if you reject the Son of God, you do not have eternal life. Remember these words, and understand that eternal life is only through the Son of God. 1 John 5:11-13 Always remember that God, our Father, has promised to be with Christ always, giving eternal life. “And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age” (Matthew 28:20). Receive eternal life. Christians should honor God above all things and obey His commandments found in the Bible. But if someone does not love him, know that Christ will never depart from his life. “Let your conduct be without covetousness, and be content with such things as you have, saying, ‘God has said, “Never will I leave you nor forsake you.”’” (Hebrews 13:5) The pillars of faith are based on the teachings of the Bible. Honoring and obeying them lead to a fulfilling Christian life. - The pillar of honoring is to offer everything willingly – (Offerings) - It is not right to offer something unwillingly and dishonestly – (Electronic money) - If you fail to honor, its consequences will bring misfortune. - (Bad luck) - To honor God with what He has given us means we must also do what He commands, so that we can live according to His will. Therefore, do not hesitate to give generously, knowing that it pleases God. TRUE BENEFITS OF KNOWING CHRIST Knowing Christ brings countless benefits. - Christ gives life abundantly (Revelation 3:20 and Colossians 1:27) - Your sins are forgiven (Colossians 1:14) - Becoming a child of God (John 1:12) - Having a full life, enjoying peace and the love of God throughout eternity (John 10:10 and II Corinthians 5:14, 15, 17). Think about this: What more could you desire than to receive abundant life through Christ? Pray to God, our Father, asking Him to show you how to live according to His will. Thank God, our Father, and seek to honor Him. Pray sincerely and faithfully. What is your decision? WHY IT IS IMPORTANT TO BE BAPTIZED Every believer who wants to be a true Christian must be baptized. These words will help those who may hesitate. THE CHURCH SHOULD ALWAYS STAND STRONG The church, like a building, needs strong foundations. Just as a house needs a solid foundation to withstand storms and remain standing, the church needs strong faith to endure trials. And remember this: It offers eternal life—life in Christ—to everyone who believes. It is important to gather with fellow believers regularly (Hebrews 10:25) Go and join a church where people worship God based on the Bible, which is the Word of God, and where Jesus Christ is proclaimed as the Son of God.

ekegusii: Na JOSHUA ARAKA. Gusii.com, Suneka, Kisii County. Ebwagi (June) 5, 2011 Aya amwabo aya: Kogenda 10 km na amagoro kera rituko! Stellah Nyayiemi nigo are koboka rimaaambia echuni na gotara 5km gochia esukuru. Na kera rimorogoba, oayerera mbaka mwabo. Igo kera rituko nigo are gotara 10km. Nonya nabo igo, Stellah, 18, nigo akorete omokia aase amasomo aye na magega ye emiaka ene, akanyora A- (minus) korwa aaria St Peter’s Suneka Secondary School, Kisii County. Moi University, we are coming. Our future chemical engineer. St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County star student, Stellah Nyayiemi. Picture na Joshua Araka, Gusii.com files. Na ekero yaigete rituko rie chisemi amo na okoegwa ebiegwa aase esukuru eyio, rituko nigo riaonchogete rikaba eria Stella. Omokwani gochia ase oyonde nigo bamotogia Stellah egekogera anene baria bakonyora egrade ekio nigo bagosoma chisukuru chinene ase bakomenya ime. Stellah ere nigo aremereretie embeo, etintira, embura na obokendu na konyora e grade ekio getari gotoka Gusii mono. Ase engencho ya omokia oye, esukuru nigo yamoete epigipigi ya Sh 50,000. Boigo nabo anyorete ebiegwa ebinge korwa aase abageni ao ao. Omongina mama omwabo agasira kare kerasi isano ne emo Stellah nigo agoteba buna ere nigo atagete gokora e degree in Chemical Engineering korwa aaria Moi University erio ache gokonya tata omwabo oyio omorendire korwa ekero mama omwabo asirete kare kerasi isano nemo. “Omonto nabo agoeta amatemwa korwa ande onsi. Nigo natagete konyora A plain korende nigo ingoakera Nyasae nga mbuya mono ase eki angete,” Nabo atebetie Gusii.com. Tari gotiga ise. "Thanks dad for all your support". Stellah amo na tata omwabo during the academic excellency awards day at St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County yesterday. Picture na Joshua Araka, Gusii.com files. She attributed her success to hard work, group discussions, advice from her mother who told her to work hard and the desire to make his father proud. Ise Stella, omogaka Nyayiemi, 69, nigo amosaberete amaya erinde asome erio ache gokonya enke yabo. Stellah nere ore omoke mwabo. The school’s former principal, Mr. Godfrey Omoni who got credited for molding Stellah nigo agoteba buna baria bakorwa inka kera emaambia nigo bagokora buya aase engencho bakonyora emechando. Omoni, now heading Nyamagwa High School nigo agoteba buna Gusii nabo ebwenerete gokora buya. "Kae chisemi ribaga", Dr. Margaret Obaga “This is a sign of good things to come,” Nabo omosike Omoni atebete. A don from Daystar University, Dr Margaret Obaga, oyio orenge omogeni omonene nigo atebetie abaorokigwa bae chisemi ribaga baratiga emegoko emenge ya ense eye. Another don, Dr Samuel Ongoncho nigo atebete buna Stellah obeire omogwekano omuya ase abaana bande. “We will get more Stellahs korwa ase esukuru eye. Nyasae tiga asesenie omwana oyo,” Nabo Dr Ongoncho atebete. Attentive students. The 2011 Academic Excellency Awards Day at St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County.
english: To JOSHUA ARAKA. Gusii.com, Suneka, Kisii County. June 5, 2011 These are the news: Walking 10 km with burdens is tough! Stellah Nyayiemi also walks five kilometers to school daily. And when it rains, she struggles until she gets home. That journey is ten kilometers. Despite this, Stellah, 18, has excelled in her studies for four years, scoring an A- (minus) while at St Peter’s Suneka Secondary School, Kisii County. Moi University, we are coming. Our future chemical engineer. St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County star student, Stellah Nyayiemi. Picture with Joshua Araka, Gusii.com files. And because of the difficulty of that long journey to and from school, that journey became known as Stella's. People visiting her often praise Stellah for her great efforts in getting good grades so they can continue their education and succeed. Stellah also faces challenges, including hunger, thirst, and poverty, yet she manages to get good grades despite being from Gusii. Because of the cost of education, the school requires a fee of Sh 50,000. Her parents have struggled to pay those fees due to their limited resources. Her mother, who supports her family, sacrificed greatly for them. Stellah says she hopes to pursue a degree in Chemical Engineering at Moi University so she can help her father and support her mother who has sacrificed so much for them. "I thank God for everything. I wish I had scored an A plain so I could please God more," she told Gusii.com. Thank you Dad for all your support. Stellah and her father during the academic excellence awards day at St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County yesterday. Picture with Joshua Araka, Gusii.com files. She attributed her success to hard work, group discussions, advice from her mother who told her to work hard and the desire to make her father proud. Her mother, Stella Nyayiemi, 69, has struggled to provide for her children so they can achieve their goals. Stellah is her only daughter. The school’s former principal, Mr. Godfrey Omoni who was praised for nurturing Stellah, said that if students work hard in their studies, they will achieve excellent results. Omoni, now heading Nyamagwa High School, said that Gusii people should strive for excellence. "This is a good omen," Dr. Margaret Obaga “This is a sign of good things to come,” Omoni added. A lecturer from Daystar University, Dr Margaret Obaga, a prominent guest, congratulated the students saying this good omen indicates positive developments in the region. Another lecturer, Dr Samuel Ongoncho said that Stellah is a role model for other students. “We will get more Stellahs from this school. God bless that child,” Dr Ongoncho added. Attentive students. The 2011 Academic Excellency Awards Day at St. Peters Secondary School, Suneka, Kisii County.

english: Is this blessedness only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham's faith was credited to him as righteousness.

ekegusii: Omoro nochiche igoro ya Misiri, na emechando emenene nebe aaria Etiopia, ekero abanto ba Misiri baraitwe, na obotenenku bwabo boirwe, na amaroso ’ense eria naiyerigwe inse.”
english: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa koiroka, ekiagera togosookigwa; toichana, ekiagera togosookigwa; mbwebe obosooku kwarenge nabwo korwa oboke bwao, na tokoinyora nonya ng’ake ogochaywa kw’oboboraka bwao,
english: "Do not be afraid; you will not suffer shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

ekegusii: Erio Hamani agatebia omoruoti Ahaswero, “Mbare aa abanto b’egesaku gete besiarerete, bamenyete ase egati y’abanto be chingongo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwao. Amachiko ’abanto abwo nigo are nogwatananeka korwa ase amachiko ’abanto bande. Barabwo tibari korenda amachiko ao, aye omoruoti. Ase ayio, aye omoruoti, okoremereria koba nabanto aba tigokorenta bitoki binde ebiya asore.
english: Then Haman said to King Xerxes, "There is a certain people dispersed and scattered among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom whose customs are different from those of all other people and who do not obey the king's laws; it is not in the king's best interest to tolerate them.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye Omonene nigo agogete koa amachiko aye okobua na ogosikwa.
english: It pleased the LORD for the sake of his righteousness to make his law great and glorious.

ekegusii: Hana akabora, “Tiga inche, omosomba oo, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.” Erio omokungu oria akarua aase agwo, akagenda koragera, gose taba oichanete naende.
english: She said, "May your servant find favor in your eyes." Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.

ekegusii: Tera nigo akoorete emiaka amagana abere, na etano (205); erio agakwera aaria Harani.
english: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakure ase rituko ria gatato;
english: He told them, "This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase ororeria rwa Haroni nanyare koria endagera eyio. Ekio nkebe egetari kiabo kia botambe gi’okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebing’wanso ebio nigo arabe omochenu.”
english: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. It is his regular share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire for the generations to come. Whatever touches them will become holy.'"

ekegusii: Timobaisa koigwera amang’ana ’ababani abwo bakobatebia ng’a: Timokorera omoruoti o Babeli. Ase ogoteba igo, obwo noborimo.
english: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' for they are prophesying lies to you.

ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa inse koragera; bagachia koimokia amaiso abo korigereria, bakarora omoganda bw’Abaisumaeli ogocha korwa Gileadi. Barabwo nigo baare ne chingamia chiabo, chibogoretie ubani, na amaguta akogwenia, na manemane, ase orogendo rwabo baare kogenda Misiri.
english: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’Epasaka buna eri konya tiriana koinyorwa korwa ase amatuko ’abagambi, baria bagamberete Abaisraeli, gose ase amatuko onsi ay’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, gose ay’abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: Not since the days of the judges who led Israel, nor throughout the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah, had any such Passover been observed.

ekegusii: Kagokwana aya akeonchora gochia nyuma, akarora Yeso oteneine, tamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
english: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

ekegusii: So Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
english: Amang’ana ayio naro Musa atebetie Haroni, amo nabamura ba Haroni, na Abaisraeli bonsi.

ekegusii: Inche Paulo narikire aya nokoboko kwane omonyene, ning’akane. Amaene, ninyare kogotebia, ng’a nore nesira asende, engencho yaye aye bweka omonyene.
english: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back-- not to mention that you owe me your very self.

ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana aya mwandikerete, mbuya omosacha takuna omokungu.
english: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good for a man not to marry.

ekegusii: Titoba buna Kaini, oyorenge bw’oria omobe, agaita oyomwabo. Ere nigo amoitete ase ki? Igo amoitete ekiagera ogokora kwaye kwarenge okobe, na okw’oyomwabo nigo kwarenge okwa boronge.
english: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother's were righteous.

ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana ria Nyasae nasemore riarwete, gose ninwe mweka riaikerete?
english: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agaatanana chimanwa chisigiti isano na ibere, agachibeka ensemo.
english: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:
english: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Tiberias. It happened this way:

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.
english: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase chinchera, boigo nase chichiiro.
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street, she raises her voice in the public squares;

ekegusii: “Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.
english: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.

ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agwetumata, na bweria omobere oye orea.
english: The fool folds his hands and ruins himself.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
english: "'On the eighth day hold an assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: So Mordecai went away and carried out all of Esther's instructions.
english: Erio Moredekai akagenda, agakora onsi buna Esteri amochigete.

ekegusii: Onye gotagete amangana amayia rakini amakoro ase Youtube, koranche genda Irongo. Imbuya mono. Eee bono. Magokoro okanire. Nigo ateba inga ebisukari. Amatoke amo ne chinkara. Bionsi bibekwe irongo. Amang'ana are muhimu ase Abagusii korwa Youtube nao are irongo. Amang'ana amakoro. Sokoro nigo atebete inga ewebusaiti eye yaansire koba siloo. Agateba inga ebinto binde bibekwe kiage. Rakini magokoro akamwebereria na komotebia inga tiga ebisukari ebio bibekwe irongo. Onye gotagete kororora amangana amayia abete omwaka oria, aye genda irongo. Kenya egenderere.
english: Someone who skillfully creates videos and uploads them to YouTube, please come forward. Very good. Yes indeed. My heart rejoices. Let us eat sweets together. Bananas and meat. Let people respect iron. Creators are important to the Abagusii community on YouTube and those with iron. Skilled creators. Soon we will see things happening on websites that can help a lot. They will show things that have been respected greatly. Videos bring hearts together and encourage people to consume sweets which are also respected like iron. Someone skilled should continue creating videos for another year, and come forward. Kenya is progressing.

ekegusii: Na bono Farao, okorota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.
english: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.

ekegusii: Ekero omosacha oria airanete namache, momura na mosubati baye bagacha nere. Agatebia omosubati oye, “Egento ekiya nkere ase egunia eria ere nyomba. Genda!onyerente igaa!” akaigora egunia eria ake igo korora ninki kiarenge ime yaye, gotatiga chinchoke chiria chikamoroma okoboko. Akarangeria kagoteba, “Nigo gekoroma.” Agatebia momura omwabo “Genda omokonye korenta!” Korende amachibu akaba boo naende.
kiswahili: Jitu lilirudi na maji pamoja na watoto wake wawili – msichana na mvulana. Likamwambia msichana, "Kuna mlo mtamu ndani ya mfuko. Nenda ukaulete!" Msichana alifungua mfuko kuona kilichokuwa ndani. Nyuki walimwuma mkono akalia akisema kwa sauti, “Inauma, inauma...” “Nenda ukamsaidie,” jitu lilimwambia mvulana kwa sauti. Pia mvulana aliumwa akalia kwa uchungu.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bagatosika ase ogosika okonene; naende ekero twachia gosoa emeeri bagatoa ebinto biria twaremeire.
english: They honored us in many ways and when we were ready to sail, they furnished us with the supplies we needed.

ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agatebia Abayahudi, “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring’ana ri’okorega gose okong’ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,
english: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, "If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye, Malikia, oyomo bw’abaturi chifeta, akaagacha ensemo ende goikera ase enyomba y’abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na ey’abaonchoreria, agwo ang’e n’Egeita gi’Okorobera, na kogenderera goika ase akanyomba ka irongo agwo ase Ekoona.
english: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;

ekegusii: Mokore ayare amaronge na amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario erabe buya asemore, monyare gosoa na koira ense eria engiya Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee,
english: Do what is right and good in the LORD's sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers,

ekegusii: Simon the Zealot and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
english: Simion, oyomo bw’Abazelote, na Yudas Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Pi‐Hahiroti, bakagenda bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro. Erio bakagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atato ase erooro y’Etamu, bagatoora agwo Mara.
english: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.
english: Jesus answered, "I did tell you, but you do not believe. The miracles I do in my Father's name speak for me,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Rora amatuko ngocha are, ekero omoremi araikeere omogesi, na omomiti amasabibu araikeere omobusuri chimbusuro. Ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore edivai.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills.

ekegusii: Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
english: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Tiga komorigereria, motige anyore obotoereru, erinde agokere amatuko aye buna omonto orikire emeremo.
english: So look away from him and let him alone, till he has put in his time like a hired man.

ekegusii: Kera omonto agatiga omochie ase okobwatia Abaisraeli. Onde tatigarete ime ya Ai, gose Beteli; omochie ogatigwa bosa otari na getango.
english: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.

ekegusii: Ere akanyuoma omoiseke bw’Ahabu, na buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bakorete, ere boigo akabwatia chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli. Agakora ayarenge amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
english: Ekero Abagibeoni baigwete buna Yoshua akorete emechie ya Yeriko na Ai,

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.
english: But Jesus answered, "No more of this!" And he touched the man's ear and healed him.

ekegusii: na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,
english: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

ekegusii: Ani! Ekero ekio abanto batato baikire ase enyomba eria namenyete, na barabwo nigo batometwe asende korwa Kaisaria.
english: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogoko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!
english: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it;

ekegusii: Abateneneri bande be chiamate chiabo mbaruete ebiegwa ase ogokorera emeremo. Omogavuna akabeka ase ekungo ebisamunye bie chitahabu bikorokwa chidariki, elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chisani emerongo etano (50), ne chianga chi’abakuani, amagana atano, na emerongo etato (530).
english: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 drachmas of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.

ekegusii: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn't I? Why have you deceived me?"
english: Bogachia gokia mambia, Yakobo akanyora ng’a Lea aetwe. Erio akaboria Labani, “Inki eke gwankorerete? Tinagokorerete, erinde ong’e Raeli? Naki gwakorete okang’aina?”

ekegusii: Ee, rigereria oyio ore omoenenu, omokeyie, na abakori amabe obatindachere inse agwo ase bateneine.
english: look at every proud man and humble him, crush the wicked where they stand.

ekegusii: “Moigwere amachiko aya onsi nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, moyabwate, erio nario morabe moyo na komentekana, erinde mogende moire ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee.
english: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers.

ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde biare kobekwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae: egesasimero gi’etahabu, ne chimesa ase emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa,
english: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God's temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: Aya nabatebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”
english: "I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."

ekegusii: Ninki rende toratebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amabera amenteke abe amange kobua?
english: What shall we say, then? Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase?

ekegusii: Isaka agasimeka endagera ase ense eria, akagesa ase omwaka oyio ara rigana, na Omonene akamosesenia.
english: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the LORD blessed him.

ekegusii: Omonto oria naakane egento keria egechenu ataruete, naende goika amente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio, ayee omokuani. Erio omokuani arue emingichi eyio y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha na akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He must make restitution for what he has failed to do in regard to the holy things, add a fifth of the value to that and give it all to the priest, who will make atonement for him with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Nigo akorigia omogondo oyogora, na korwa ase ebitoki bi’emeremo y’amaboko aye nigo agosimeka emesabibu.
english: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

ekegusii: erinde erieta riao ritogigwe kare na kare. Erio abanto bariatore botambe, bagoteba: Omonene bw’Emeganda, nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.
english: so that your name will be great forever. Then men will say, 'The LORD Almighty is God over Israel!' And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.
english: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

ekegusii: Akabekera Haroni eganchwa erobekanire eigete inse, na eganchwa eria ende, akamoboeria norokini. Naende akamobekera egesibao ki’obokuani, akamoboeria norokini rw’egesibao roroisirie nomonto omong’aini.
english: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also tied the ephod to him by its skillfully woven waistband; so it was fastened on him.

ekegusii: Omonto ore omokorekanu ase enkoro yaye tari goseseneka, na oyobwate oromeme rw’ogosiria nigo akonyorwa nemechando.
english: A man of perverse heart does not prosper; he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.

ekegusii: Haroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.
english: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo imanyete ribero riabo. Ogwetogia kwabo nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria, naboigo nogokora kwabo kore.
english: I know her insolence but it is futile," declares the LORD, "and her boasts accomplish nothing.

ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Eke nakio ekemanyerio ase kera rirube riane; naboigo nkorika.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.
english: Upon receiving such orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi oyio, Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana amo, beng’atete na beboyetie chigunia, bageaka ebundo ase emetwe yabo.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and having dust on their heads.

ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere chire chisare chi’engabi.
english: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.

ekegusii: Bono narure chinse echio chionsi nachibekire ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, omosomba one. Boigo nabekire ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana ase okoboko kwaye chimokorere.
english: Now I will hand all your countries over to my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.

ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.
english: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
