ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti, oroiboro rw’amarubi, naki morakore motame ekina ki’omorero o kare na kare.
english: "You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

ekegusii: Osokie ebinto biao isiko mobaso kobaroche, ebinto buna ebi’oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye, na rigoika mogoroba, ogende aye bweka kobaroche, buna oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye.
english: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abanafutali: “Inwe Abanafutali nigo mwanyorire ogwancherawa okonge na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene, moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya irianyi,”
english: About Naphtali he said: "Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the LORD and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake."

ekegusii: Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.
english: make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nigo nyanchete amachiko ao kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire.
english: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

ekegusii: Timokora emeremo ende yonsi. Okwo nogochika koragenderere asemore, ebiaare ase ebiaare aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

ekegusii: Onye barabwo bare ababani b’ekeene, na onye ring’ana ri’Omonene rire asebare, tiga basorore Omonene bw’Emeganda ng’a ebikorero ebio bitigarete ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba y’Omoruoti bw’Abayuda agwo Yerusalemu bitigwe tibiirwa Babeli.”
english: If they are prophets and have the word of the LORD, let them plead with the LORD Almighty that the furnishings remaining in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.

ekegusii: Omonene agankania, agantebia, “Tobaisa gonsaba ase engencho y’abanto aba ng’a mbasesenie.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

ekegusii: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.
english: Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.

ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri; nkababooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba, inche ngatoma Musa, na Haroni, na Miriamu, bakaba bakobaraa.
english: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge basinto b’Abihaili, mosinto o Huri o Yaroa, o Gileadi, o Mikaeli, o Yesisai, o Yado, o Busi.
english: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso asebare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge.
english: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

ekegusii: Agasamba omwana oye omomura akamokora ekeng’wanso; akaba ogokora oborogi na oboragori, na akaboria ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, na akenaria oborogi bonde. Agakora amabe amange ase obosio bw’Omonene, akamogechia goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger.

ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”
english: This is what the LORD has commanded: 'Each one is to gather as much as he needs. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.'"

ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y’obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.
english: to prepare God's people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.
english: When King David heard all this, he was furious.

ekegusii: Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa asende, na amabe achie komonyora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.
english: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.'

ekegusii: Korende Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino, erio abatantanie, nainwe goika mobasirie kegima.
english: But the LORD your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero abete omoruoti, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia korwa Libuna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

ekegusii: Naende ase entunda ya gatano, Sanibalati agatoma omosomba oye asende obwate rirube ritamumekeirie
english: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter

ekegusii: Yudas, nere oyokomorua, akamoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwatebire.”
english: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" Jesus answered, "Yes, it is you."

ekegusii: Emegondo ere Hesiboni yasusanire amo nemesabibu ere Sibuma. Abanene b’ebisaku babutoire chinsagia chi’emesabibu, echio chiarandete chigaika Yaeseri, na chikagenderera goika ase erooro. Emerande yaye nigo yarandete, ekaamboka enyancha.
english: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae one, agoteba: “Risia riicho rie ching’ondi echio chiachikeirwe konyenywa.
english: This is what the LORD my God says: "Pasture the flock marked for slaughter.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Saridi rika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate emeika eria etano na ebere ya Nyasae, ne ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere. “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Nore nerieta ng’a moyo ore, korende nigo okwete.
english: "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

ekegusii: Inche omogaaka ngokorikera nde aye omokungu omochore amo nabana bao, inwe abwo nyanchete ase ekeene. Tari inche bweka mbanchete, korende nabaria bonsi abamanyete ekeene.
english: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth-- and not I only, but also all who know the truth--

ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na eya Yuda tibari abegenwa asende nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: The house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia eanga ya Yusufu, na bakanyenya embori, bakaimokia eanga eria, bakayetobeka ase amanyinga;
english: Then they got Joseph's robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.

ekegusii: Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.
english: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.

ekegusii: na buna abakuani na abanene baito bamoruete ase ekina ki’ogokwa, bakamobamba.
english: The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;

ekegusii: Erio akarenta endagera eyio ase Saulo na abasomba baye, nabarabwo bakayeria. Nyuma y’ayio bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obwo.
english: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.

ekegusii: Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.
english: My times are in your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

ekegusii: Na onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie oritugute; mbuya gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae kore egetong’o, kobua koba namaiso abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare,
english: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omoroberio obo, eamate ase eamate. Korwa ase Abayuda nigo barenge abateneneri aba b’abarwani esegi chilifu: Adina, omochiki amo nabarwani baye chituoni chilifu amagana atato (300,000).
english: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, “Buna koreng’ana narentete amabe aria onsi amanene igoro ase abanto aba, naboigo ngochia kobarentera amaya onsi aya nabarierete eira kobarentera.
english: "This is what the LORD says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.

ekegusii: “Erio abateneneri bakwane nabanto, babatebie: Onye omonto ore aiga oagachire enyomba, korende tarayemenya, tiga airane bwoye, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koira enyomba yaye na koyemenya.
english: The officers shall say to the army: "Has anyone built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else may dedicate it.

ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane; nere akong’a onsi aya ngwenerete konyora; ere igo arendete aya antungetie.
english: LORD, you have assigned me my portion and my cup; you have made my lot secure.

ekegusii: Akarusia chinyasae chingeni na emegwekano eria y’ogosasimwa korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; boigo akarusia ebisasimero konya aagachire ase egetunwa igoro, ase enyomba y’Omonene yarenge agwo Yerusalemu, akabituguta gochia isiko y’omochie.
english: He got rid of the foreign gods and removed the image from the temple of the LORD, as well as all the altars he had built on the temple hill and in Jerusalem; and he threw them out of the city.

ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamotebia,
english: That night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying:

ekegusii: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech.
english: Erio Yotamu akaminyoka, agatama gochia Beeri, akamenya agwo, ekiagera airogete Abimeleki momura omwabo.

ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora riroroche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.
english: See how your enemies are astir, how your foes rear their heads.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o mwanyabanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw’okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.
english: During the days of Jesus' life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamunsa chianga chiaye, akabatebia, “Amayinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
english: But when the Jews opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am clear of my responsibility. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."

ekegusii: Naboigo nkore ogokora ao ao, korende Omonene nere oria oyomo.
english: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Ewili‐Merodaki, omoruoti o Babeli, achagete kogamba akaba namabera ase Yehoyakini, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamosibora korwa ase echela. Ayio nigo akoregete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatano na kabere, omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na kabere nyuma Yehoyakini omoruoti bw’Abayuda goosirwe,
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin from prison on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.

ekegusii: Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.
english: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.

ekegusii: Mokagorwa ase rigori, timoba abasomba b’abanto.
english: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.

ekegusii: Abange ase abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, baria barenge abagotu, abaroche enyomba eria ye ritang’ani, bono ekero baroche oboroso bw’eyio enyia bwabekirwe, bakarera na koiyeria amariga. Korende abange bagaaka amariogi amanene ay’omogoko.
english: But many of the older priests and Levites and family heads, who had seen the former temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, while many others shouted for joy.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bamenyire ase ense ya Misiri ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430).
english: Now the length of time the Israelite people lived in Egypt was 430 years.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.
english: How great are your works, O LORD, how profound your thoughts!

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya mwanyabanto.
english: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

ekegusii: Na egoora eria ere isiko ye Hekalu oyetige, toyerenga, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bayeeirwe, na barabwo nabatache omochie omochenu ase engaki y’emetienyi emerongo ene na ebere.
english: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.

ekegusii: Erio nkarengereria: Bono Abafilisti mbabaise gocha asende aa Giligali ritang’ani ntaraboria ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase igo ayio akambetereria korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.”
english: I thought, 'Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the LORD's favor.' So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering."

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi baria Amasia atancherete bagende nabarabwo korwana esegi, bakarwania emechie y’Abayuda, gochakera Samaria goikeera Beti‐Horoni, bagaita abanto chilifu isato (3,000), bagasakora ebinto ebinge.
english: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had sent back and had not allowed to take part in the war raided Judean towns from Samaria to Beth Horon. They killed three thousand people and carried off great quantities of plunder.

ekegusii: agatoma ekegonkoru, na kerokio gekairuruka gochia aaria na aaria goika amache agakamoka korwa ase ense.
english: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.

ekegusii: Ababisa bantegeire oboreba ase ngoeta, bamionogoreire inse. Bakunyire eirima ase enchera yane, korende mbarabwo abanyene bagure imeo.
english: They spread a net for my feet-- I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path-- but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah

ekegusii: rirorio inche nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, inwe amo nomochie oyio nabaete inwe ne chisokoro chiaino.
english: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your fathers.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, moire eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ase ogochena Hekalu.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoteba: Mokore omorembe nainche, moche asende, erio kera omonto ore asemore narie okwama kw’emesabibu yaye omonyene, na kera omonto narie okwama kw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,
english: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and fig tree and drink water from his own cistern,

ekegusii: "My eyes have seen all this, my ears have heard and understood it.
english: “Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge gokwana omonwa omoao,
english: When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

ekegusii: “Namanyire ogokora kwao, na obwanchani bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, na obokoreri bwao, na okoremereria kwao. Naende namanyire ng’a ogokora kwao kw’omoerio kwabuire koria kwe ritang’ani.
english: I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and perseverance, and that you are now doing more than you did at first.

ekegusii: Bagaita bonsi abarenge ase omochie oyio ime, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.
english: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anything that breathed, and he burned up Hazor itself.

ekegusii: Omosacha ae omokungu oye ekemogwenerete; naboigo nomokungu ae omosacha oye ekemogwenerete.
english: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.

ekegusii: Akabeka chinguba na amatimo ase emechie eyio yonsi, na akayekora ekaba emekong’u mono. Ase enchera eyio akagenderera kogambera Abayuda na Ababenjamin.
english: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.

ekegusii: “Ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha ekero abana baino barababorie: Ninki engencho y’oborori obo, na amachiko aya, na emeroberio eye, ebi Omonene, Nyasae oito, abachigete? Nase ki Omonene, Nyasae oito, abachigete amachiko aya na emeroberio eye?
english: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the LORD our God has commanded you?"

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akagenda nyomba mwaye, akanyenya emanwa y’embori, akayeroisia; naende korwa ase obosie bw’ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere akaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Akabeka chinyama ase egetonga, na omosori akayoumora ase enyongo, akairera omomalaika oria orenge inse y’omote onga buna omotontera endagera eyio.
english: Gideon went in, prepared a young goat, and from an ephah of flour he made bread without yeast. Putting the meat in a basket and its broth in a pot, he brought them out and offered them to him under the oak.

ekegusii: Boigo arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, buna aranyare. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa.
english: and two doves or two young pigeons, which he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

ekegusii: “Nigo nabarenterete amaakwa anga buna aria narentete Misiri; naende ngaita abamura baino nemioro; nkabaura chibarasi chiaino, nkabatiokeria obogundo bw’abanto baino baitetwe, agwo ase ebitwori biaino. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Akamosorora mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.
english: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.

ekegusii: Erio nkairaneria, nkabatebia, “Nyasae o igoro natosesenie togenderere ase obuya; ase ayio intwe, abasomba baye, nkoagacha tore omochie oyo naende; korende inwe timobwati egetari kende gionsi aiga, gose timobwati oboronge gose okoinyorwa konde gwonsi ase Yerusalemu.”
english: I answered them by saying, "The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it."

ekegusii: Korende Daudi agatebia Saulo, “Inche, omosomba oo, nabeire nkorisia ching’ondi chia tata, na ekero kende gionsi endo gose edubu yare gocha koira eng’ondi korwa ase riicho,
english: But David said to Saul, "Your servant has been keeping his father's sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,

ekegusii: Ekero bambokire ng’umbu, Elija agatebia Elisha, “Boria egento ndanyare kogokorera ritang’ani ntararusigwa asore.” Elisha agateba, “Nagosabire, ong’e omoika oo ara kabere.”
english: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, "Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken from you?" "Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit," Elisha replied.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inche ninchiche mboorie abanto ba Sayoni, na abwo ba Yakobo baonchoke na batige ogosaria kwabo.
english: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Omonto oria kararue emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, arente esigiti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
english: "'If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he is to bring a female without defect.

ekegusii: Naki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y’okwegena; ayio tarwete asemore abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae;
english: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith-- and this not from yourselves, it is the gift of God--

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore obotamero bwane, naki gwantigire? Ninki gekogera inche ngendererete kweumia, na ababisa baane bagendererete gonkorera bobe?
english: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria akariina ebarasi, akagenda koumerana nere, akamotebia, “Omoruoti nigo akoboria gose namang’ana ’omorembe obwate.” Yehu akamoiraneria, “Ninki ogokorera omorembe? Irana nyuma yane ontunyane!” Omorendi oria akaira amang’ana, agateba “Omonto oria otomwa naika asebare, korende tari koirana gocha.”
english: The horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, "This is what the king says: 'Do you come in peace?'" "What do you have to do with peace?" Jehu replied. "Fall in behind me." The lookout reported, "The messenger has reached them, but he isn't coming back."

ekegusii: ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.
english: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.
english: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

ekegusii: Bakang’iraneria, bagantebia, “Abatigari baria batooretigwe korwa ase obosomba bare ase orogongo rwabo, nigo bare ase emechando emenene na ogochaywa okonene Orwaki rwa Yerusalemu rwatagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe.”
english: They said to me, "Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire."

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akang’eteria ase egesoero kiarenge ang’e negeita, agansoyia ase ebinyomba ebichenu bi’abakuani biarenge sugusu, nkarora aase aria korwa nyuma, ensemo ya bosongo.
english: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.

ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.
english: Let a righteous man strike me-- it is a kindness; let him rebuke me-- it is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. Yet my prayer is ever against the deeds of evildoers;

ekegusii: Naki twabeire ababwatani na Kristo, gatorabwate bokong’u ogosemeria gwaito kwe ritang’ani goika omoerio.
english: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly till the end the confidence we had at first.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio eyio, Vasti eting’ana, moka omoruoti, nere agakorera abakungu omoyega agwo ase enyomba y’omoruoti Ahaswero.
english: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.

ekegusii: They urgently requested Festus, as a favor to them, to have Paul transferred to Jerusalem, for they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.
english: na bakamosaba abanchere, arue ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe Yerusalemu, konya barobeirie komoboera na komoitera nchera.

ekegusii: Na abasomba aba bao bonsi nabatirimboke gocha asende na batung’ameo, bakobora: Genda, karue aa, aye na abanto bao bonsi bakobwatie. Nyuma y’ayio nindue aa!” Erio agwo Musa akarua o Farao ore nekeririanda ekenene.
english: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, 'Go, you and all the people who follow you!' After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Naki nairokire, ng’a inse gocha timbanyora buna ndigetie kobanyora; naende ndorekane asemore, tari buna morigetie inwe. Aande gose mbanyore more neriomana, ne ribero, na endamwamu, na okweancha, na ogoitania, na okogenkana, na oboenenu, ne riroroche.
english: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.

ekegusii: Ahabu agatebia Obadia, “Togende toete ase ense yonsi na ase chinsoko chi’amache, na ase amagooko onsi; ande nabo torabaise konyora obonyansi, erinde totoorie chibarasi ne chiyombo chibe moyo, na titobaisa gosiria chitugo chinde.”
english: Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals."

ekegusii: Erio akairera Egiloni, omoruoti bw’ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa biria. Egiloni nigo arenge omonto omonetu mono.
english: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

ekegusii: Naki onye nkorandia enchili, tindi neri ingwetogeria, ekiagera okobetererigwa kwabekirwe asende. Obobe nobwane ntarandeti enchili!
english: Yet when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, for I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto b’amachiko! Ekiagera mwarusirie ekeigorero gie chisemi; inwe abanyene timwasoa, na baria abaare gosoa mwabatangire.”
english: "Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering."

ekegusii: korende mwanyabanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.”
english: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.

ekegusii: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kwa Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, ekero arenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Ahasia, mosinto o Yehoramu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani timogokora emeremo ende yonsi ya kera rituko, korende nigo morabe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima.
english: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

ekegusii: Rigereria ase ebitunwa, orore amagoro ay’oyio okorenta amang’ana amaya ay’omogoko na koraria amang’ana ’omorembe! Inwe Abayuda, renda Amatuko aino Amanene, moikeranie chiira chiria mwariete. Abakori amabe tibagocha kobarwania naende, ekiagera basirigwe kegima.
english: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, O Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.

ekegusii: Mwaigure okorama kwaye. Naki moroche?” Bonsi bakamonachera ekina ng’a nagwenerete akwe.
english: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.

ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha asende bwango.
english: Do your best to come to me quickly,

ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkoba imorigeretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for only he will release my feet from the snare.

ekegusii: Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ngotogie, na aya gwachikire, tiga ankonye.
english: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Babeli bakaroisia omogwekano bw’enyasae yabo Sukoti‐Benoti, bakayosasima na abanto ba Kuta omogwekano o Nerigali, na abanto ba Hamati oyo bw’Asima,
english: The men from Babylon made Succoth Benoth, the men from Cuthah made Nergal, and the men from Hamath made Ashima;

ekegusii: Agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agatoma asare abagaaka b’Abayahudi komoboria ache agwenie omosomba oye.
english: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.

ekegusii: “Inee! Titwabakanetie bokong’u ng’a timworokereria ase erieta eri? Na rora, mwaichoirie Yerusalemu nokworokereria kwaino, naende morigetie korenta amanyinga ’omonto oria igoro asetore.”
english: "We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man's blood."

ekegusii: Agripa agatebia Festo, “Omonto oyo nanga nasiborwa onye atarigia ekina kiaye keirwe ase Kaisari.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, "This man could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar."

ekegusii: Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,
english: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;

ekegusii: Ekero abaruoti baria barentetwe ase Yoshua, ere akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, agatebia abatang’ani b’abarwani, abwo bagendete amo nere ase esegi, “Inchuo aiga ang’e, motache amagoti ’abaruoti aba.” Erio barabwo bagaika ang’e, bakabatacha.
english: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, "Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?”
english: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakoira chitigere chie chintakana, baira chiombe chi’ababoraka koba intenenera.
english: They drive away the orphan's donkey and take the widow's ox in pledge.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amache igoro.
english: Samaria and its king will float away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

ekegusii: Na bono Omonene, inki nganyete? Naye bweka nsemeretie.
english: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ayio, ekero nabarusirie ase ense eyio, nimbarorere amabera naende, mbairanie naende kera omonto ase omwando oye, na ase ense yaye.
english: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to his own inheritance and his own country.

ekegusii: korende buna twancheirwe na Nyasae koba abatwegenirwe koegwa enchili, nabo togokwana, tari ase okogwenera abanto, korende ase okogwenera Nyasae, oyokorenga chinkoro chiaito.
english: On the contrary, we speak as men approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please men but God, who tests our hearts.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda ase omochie onde bw’Abayuda inyoire?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda.” Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Norori?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Heburoni.”
english: In the course of time, David inquired of the LORD. "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The LORD said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the LORD answered.

ekegusii: Akamochiera oyo okabere, akamotebia boigo. Nere akamoiraneria: Nkogenda inde, omonene; go tagenda.
english: "Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, 'I will, sir,' but he did not go.

ekegusii: Na Daudi akaboria Nyasae “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafilisti? Nobabeke ase amaboko aane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda, nimbabeke ase amaboko ao.”
english: so David inquired of God: "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The LORD answered him, "Go, I will hand them over to you."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie, basire korwa inse y’erioba!”
english: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende onye Omonene ogochia gokora egento ekeyia, erinde riroba ritandoke, rimere abanto abwo amo nebinto biabo bionsi, na barabwo barimere riroba ime bare moyo, bagende gochia aase abakure, erio namomanye ng’a abanto aba bachayire Omonene.”
english: But if the LORD brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the grave, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt."

ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora.
english: Such is the end of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the lives of those who get it.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba igoro y’ababani abwo: “Naama! Nimbae ekemeri ekeroro barie, nimbae namache are nobosongo banywe. Korwa ase ababani ba Yerusalemu, ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwesiareire ase ense yonsi.”
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."

ekegusii: Naende nyuma yaye abaiseke baria bande bagacha, bakabora: Omonene, Omonene, toigorere!
english: "Later the others also came. 'Sir! Sir!' they said. 'Open the door for us!'

ekegusii: Amache akagenderera komenteka goichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe, ebiare ande onsi inse y’erioba, bigatubwa.
english: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebinge konya benyoreire, ne chinibo chionsi babeire bagachete mbabibogorie bamboke nabirobio ase Orooche rw’Emesobeti.
english: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.

ekegusii: bagakwana nabarabwo agwo Silo, bakabatebia, “Omonene nigo achigete goetera ase Musa ng’a toegwe emechie ase tokomenya, amo namarisio, ase chitugo chiaito chirarisie.”
english: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The LORD commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."

ekegusii: Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduku ye chisiringi, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.
english: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.

ekegusii: “Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ensoko netuboke ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, erinde basibigwe korwa ase ebibe biabo, na ogotacheneka kwabo.
english: "On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inwe abanyene mwanyangire, mwairanire nyuma, mwantigire. Ase engencho eyio naramboire okoboko kwane kobasiria kegima, ekiagera narosire ase okobarorera amabera.
english: You have rejected me," declares the LORD. "You keep on backsliding. So I will lay hands on you and destroy you; I can no longer show compassion.

ekegusii: Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egacha, egasiria bonsi.
english: People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.

ekegusii: “Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chie ching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.
english: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo batoboerete, titwarenge konyara gotaara ase chinchera chiaito. Engaki yaito nigo ere ang’e koera; amatuko aito abarirwe; ee, omoerio oito oikire.
english: Men stalked us at every step, so we could not walk in our streets. Our end was near, our days were numbered, for our end had come.

ekegusii: Ime y’omochie oria akanyorekanao amanyinga ’ababani, na ay’abachenu, na aya baria bonsi abaitetwe ase ense.”
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of the saints, and of all who have been killed on the earth."

ekegusii: Erio agwo akamobeka ase amaboko abo abambwe. Barabwo bakabwata Yeso.
english: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.

ekegusii: Emechando na omoichano bianyorire, korende nigo ngokerete amachiko ao.
english: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamotebia, “Otegerere amang’ana abo baragotebie. Tari aye bangire, korende ninche bangire, timba omoruoti obo.
english: And the LORD told him: "Listen to all that the people are saying to you; it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected me as their king.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chinchera chi’omosunte.
english: who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

ekegusii: Omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abayuda, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na omosangererekano bw’Abaisraeli abachete korwa ase ense yabo, na abageni abachete korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli, na abamenyi bamenyete ase ense y’Abayuda, bakaba nomogoko omonene.
english: The entire assembly of Judah rejoiced, along with the priests and Levites and all who had assembled from Israel, including the aliens who had come from Israel and those who lived in Judah.

ekegusii: Agasoka naende chinsa isano nemo, ne chinsa kianda, agakora boigo.
english: So they went. "He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.

ekegusii: Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?
english: Do you have an arm like God's, and can your voice thunder like his?

ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omoriri nigo okomorentera ogosirigwa, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chikoba omoeto asare.
english: A fool's mouth is his undoing, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

ekegusii: Naki nigo ndoche ng’a Nyasae otobekire intwe abatomwa tobe ab’omoerio ase bonsi, buna abanto bagambetigwe ng’a baitwe, ekiagera twabeire ekiorokererio ki’ogosekererwa ase ense, na ase abamalaika, na ase mwanyabanto.
english: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like men condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to men.

ekegusii: Gose titokora obotomani buna abande babo bakorete, na abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na isato bagakwa ase rituko erimo.
english: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did-- and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.

ekegusii: Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kwe ritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.
english: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.

ekegusii: Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyara gwatanerwa omogoko bw’enkoro eyio.
english: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

ekegusii: Nimobekere ekeonga kiane abwatwe ase oboreba bwane; erio imoire Babeli, ase ense y’Abakalidayo; nonya naboigo takoyerora namaiso aye, korende nao arakwere.
english: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

ekegusii: and the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.
english: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,

ekegusii: Emechie yonsi abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni baetwe nigo yarenge ikomi na etato; bakayeegwa, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: All the towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabatebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na rero, oyio konya mogokora botambe?”
english: The Israelite foremen appointed by Pharaoh's slave drivers were beaten and were asked, "Why didn't you meet your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?"

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ogotera oko ngoterwe ase ense y’Abayuda; “Intwe nigo tomenyete ase omochie omokong’u. Omonene otoeire ogotooreka kobe chindwaki ne chiburi chiaito.
english: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.

ekegusii: (Na ase emeeri ime nigo twarenge abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano nomo.)
english: Altogether there were 276 of us on board.

ekegusii: Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”
english: "I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is reliable, and what I have heard from him I tell the world."

ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oria okirete goika rituko ria kabere, takwanete ring’ana igoro y’ayio, rirorio nayiancherete, na omokungu oria goika aikeranie chiira chiaye chionsi ariete, gose ogotiana kwaye kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete. Omosacha oye nayianchete, ekiagera takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria ayaigwete.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabugwa nabarwani ba Daudi. Ogoitwa okwo gokaba okonene, na ase rituko riria abanto chilifu emerongo ebere bagaitwa.
english: There the army of Israel was defeated by David's men, and the casualties that day were great-- twenty thousand men.

ekegusii: Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.
english: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka nonya nase emechando yaito, ekiagera ntomanyete ng’a emechando nigo ekorenta oboremereria;
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na isano nemo, na amagana atano (76,500).
english: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.

ekegusii: ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.
english: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from birth.

ekegusii: Omonto aise koba aiga, oyo oigwete amang’ana’okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania naende eremie abe nobomaene ime ase enkoro yaye, erio akwane: Nabo erabe buya asende nonya nkogenderera koba omotaigweri, oyio nigo arabasirie mwensi, abamogotinda na abamore nerang’o.
english: When such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself and therefore thinks, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way." This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

ekegusii: Bono tinkobisa obosio bwane naende korwa asebare. Ning’umore omoika one igoro y’Abaisraeli. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Omonene nabarierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabae ense y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Eyio nense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Ekero arabaikie agwo goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke ase omotienyi oyio.
english: When the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites-- the land he swore to your forefathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey-- you are to observe this ceremony in this month:

ekegusii: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
english: Baria ikomi na babere achorete nabwo aba: Simion nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bekeri nabwo aba: Semira, na Yoashi, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Yerimoti, na Abiya, na Anatoti, na Alemeti. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Bekeri.
english: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Soa oete ase omochie o Yerusalemu bwonsi, obeke ekemanyererio ase obosio bwa kera omonto oichanete na korera ase engencho y’ebibe bi’okogechia bigokorwa ase omochie oyio.”
english: and said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it."

ekegusii: Korende bono okwegena kogwachire, titori naende inse y’omotebereria.
english: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under the supervision of the law.

ekegusii: Aroro Abadani bageteneneria omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa. Yonathani, mosinto o Gerisomu o Musa, nere orenge omokuani ase Abadani, na abana baye abamura bakaba abakuani babo goika engaki y’ogwoswa kwabo.
english: There the Danites set up for themselves the idols, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.

ekegusii: Akarua aroro, agasoa ase esinagogi yabo.
english: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,

ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.
english: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan-- five towns--

ekegusii: Nabarikerete ase rirube riane, ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani.
english: I have written you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people--

ekegusii: Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakabora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”
english: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"

ekegusii: Narenge omonto oyomo, ng’ina arenge Omoisraeli, na ise n’Omomisiri. Omonto oyio akagenda ase egetwori akomana nomonto onde Omoisraeli.
english: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Amina. Tiga Omonene akore ayio. Ee, tiga akore amang’ana ayio kwabanire aikerane, erio airanie korwa Babeli ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene na abanto bairetwe obosomba.
english: He said, "Amen! May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the LORD's house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.

ekegusii: Gaki ekero naigete Teroa ase engencho y’okorandia enchili ya Kristo, nkaigorerwa egesieri n’Omonene,
english: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and found that the Lord had opened a door for me,

ekegusii: Yehu agatebia abanto baye. “Babwate bare moyo!” Na barabwo bakababwata bare moyo, bakabaita na kobaruta ase engoro agwo ang’e na Beti‐Ekedi, abanto emerongo ene, na babere; tatigaretie nonya noyomo.
english: "Take them alive!" he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked-- forty-two men. He left no survivor.

ekegusii: Naki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariko amachenu, ayaranyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.
english: and how from infancy you have known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.
english: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

ekegusii: Erinde monyare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabatebie amang’ana onsi.
english: Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know how I am and what I am doing.

ekegusii: for they have shed the blood of your saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve."
english: Ekiagera barabwo baiterete amanyinga ’abachenu na ay’ababani, aye kwabaeire amanyinga banywe. Barabwo banyorire ayabagweneire!”

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakabora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”
english: "How many loaves do you have?" he asked. "Go and see." When they found out, they said, "Five-- and two fish."

ekegusii: Korende atakoigwereti, ira omonto oyomo, gose babere, mogende asare mwensi, ng’a kera ring’ana rinyare gwancheranwa ase abarori babere gose batato.
english: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that 'every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.'

ekegusii: Ase ogochika okwo kw’omoruoti abatomwa bakariina chibarasi chi’omoruoti chiare kominyoka bwango. Ogochika koria gokararigwa boigo agwo Susa, omochie oria omonene bw’eburi.
english: The couriers, riding the royal horses, raced out, spurred on by the king's command. And the edict was also issued in the citadel of Susa.

ekegusii: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, 'What is your occupation?'
english: Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,

ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete koba aiga ase obosio bwao na gonsoera, onye bare ne ring’ana igoro asende.
english: But there are some Jews from the province of Asia, who ought to be here before you and bring charges if they have anything against me.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abamoabu aroche ng’a esegi yamobuire, akaira abanto amagana atano na abere babogoretie emioro, akagania amigererie gochia ase omoruoti bw’Abaedomu, korende tanyarete.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Debiri, akaumokera omochie oyio.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

ekegusii: ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, na ebioma. Imoka, ochake gokora emeremo! Omonene abe amo naye.”
english: in gold and silver, bronze and iron-- craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the LORD be with you."

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’obong’ainereria, korende oyo ogosimeka oboronge nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’ekeene.
english: The wicked man earns deceptive wages, but he who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, bakaira ne chitugo chionsi.
english: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria amo nomokungu oye o sere‐sere, na omosomba oye, baimogete kogenda, ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Rora bono omobaso oerire, na bwaisire koiira, nagosoroire, beera aiga ase obotuko bwa rero naende, oigwe buya. Ankio oimoke mambia chuni, ochake orogendo, ogende seino.”
english: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said, "Now look, it's almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."

ekegusii: Emete eyio egasoa amo noro gochia aase abakure ase abwo baitetwe nemioro basoete, ee, emete eyio nigo yaikaransete ase ekiriri kiaye ase egati y’ebisaku ase okoyokonya.
english: Those who lived in its shade, its allies among the nations, had also gone down to the grave with it, joining those killed by the sword.

ekegusii: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.
english: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.

ekegusii: Korende ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikabokia ime asende chingencho chionsi chi’okogania okobe. Ase amachiko atari, rirorio ebibe mbikwete.
english: But sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from law, sin is dead.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya ogombairie chinda chi’abanto bonsi b’enka y’Abimeleki, tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Ibrahimu.
english: for the LORD had closed up every womb in Abimelech's household because of Abraham's wife Sarah.

ekegusii: They bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate, the governor.
english: Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gavuna.

ekegusii: one male goat for a sin offering;
english: na egoree eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amache ’enyancha, buna amache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars; he puts the deep into storehouses.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Nimbeke omoika one ime yaino, na inwe mobe moyo. Nimbarente, mbabeke ase ense yaino. Erio momanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, boigo nayakorire.”
english: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken, and I have done it, declares the LORD.'"

ekegusii: bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.
english: saying, 'This fellow began to build and was not able to finish.'

ekegusii: “Karue ase omoganda oyo, otigere gochia aare, erio inche mbasirie ara rimo.” Musa na Haroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
english: "Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once." And they fell facedown.

ekegusii: nkamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Inki keragere tindorekana inde nomoichano ekero omochie oria, aase chimbeera ohie chisokoro chiane chire, ogendererete koba ritombe, na ebiita biaye biasarigwe nomorero?”
english: but I said to the king, "May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my fathers are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?"

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, ekero aiboretwe, akabiswa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato nabaibori baye, ekiagera baroche ng’a nomwana omuya, gose tibairogete ogochika kw’omoruoti.
english: By faith Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king's edict.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”
english: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."

ekegusii: Buna nabeire mbarigereretie ase okobasimora, na kobatagora, na kobaonchorana, na kobasiria, na kobarentera amabe, naboigo ndabarigererie ase okobaagacha na kobasimeka. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abalawi bagachora Hemani, mosinto o Yoeli, na ase abanto bamwabo Asafu, mosinto o Berekia, na ase ororeria rwa Merari abanto bamwabo Etani, mosinto o Kusaya.
english: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, amang’ana aya karakogwenere, karue ogochika ng’a abanto aba baitwe basirigwe kegima. Onye nabo nindete chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi (10,000) ase abanto abwo bagokora emeremo yao, aye omoruoti; ne chifeta echio nigo chirabekwe ase ekungo yao, aye omoruoti.”
english: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will put ten thousand talents of silver into the royal treasury for the men who carry out this business."

ekegusii: Chiombe ne chitigere chiaino, echio mokoremia ase emegondo yaino, nchinyore chindagera chingiya chisongire noroteru na goswagwa, chiochoganirie nomonyo, chirie.
english: The oxen and donkeys that work the soil will eat fodder and mash, spread out with fork and shovel.

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

ekegusii: Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.
english: Though one wished to dispute with him, he could not answer him one time out of a thousand.

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Goika Nyasae amanyekane ng’a nomonyene ekeene, nonya nkera omonto ore omorimo, buna erikire, “Erinde omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ase amang’ana ao, na obue ekero ogosoa ase ekina.”
english: Not at all! Let God be true, and every man a liar. As it is written: "So that you may be proved right when you speak and prevail when you judge."

ekegusii: Imbeke ase enkoro yao imbe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, ee, buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao. Obwanchani nigo bore ne chinguru buna amakweri, ne ribero nigo rire ritindi buna embeera. Ogwoka kw’obwanchani nigo konga ebibemberi bi’omorero, ee, nekebemberi gekorwa ase Omonene.
english: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm; for love is as strong as death, its jealousy unyielding as the grave. It burns like blazing fire, like a mighty flame.

ekegusii: “Onde taba ase Abaisraeli, omokungu gose omosacha, okwebeka ase obonyaka bwe chihekalu.
english: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bamenyete Yabesi o Gileadi baigwete aya Abafilisti bakorete ase Saulo,
english: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard of what the Philistines had done to Saul,

ekegusii: “Oyo oragere oyomo bw’aba abake, abanyegenete, akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe ase endiba y’enyancha.
english: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: gose takorete gwatananekana ase egati yaito na barabwo, korende agasibia chinkoro chiabo ase okwegena.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.

ekegusii: Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.
english: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emiaka etari meke, omoruoti o irianyi nakore okobwatana nomoruoti o sugusu. Omoruoti o irianyi nasokie omoiseke oye ase omoruoti o sugusu ase ogokora okobwatana. Omokungu oyio takogenderera koba nokobua okwo araegwe, na omoruoti oria o sugusu takogenderera koba nokobua kwaye. Omokungu oria narusigweo aitwe, ere amo nabwo bamorentete, oyo omoiborete na oria omoete okobua ase engaki eria.
english: After some years, they will become allies. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an alliance, but she will not retain her power, and he and his power will not last. In those days she will be handed over, together with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Imoka, otirimboke gochia ase egetwori kiabo obaumokere, ekiagera nakebekire ase amaboko ao.
english: During that night the LORD said to Gideon, "Get up, go down against the camp, because I am going to give it into your hands.

ekegusii: Nkaegwa kobaorokereria abanto bonsi barore omoroberio bw’obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase Nyasae, oyotongete ebinto bionsi;
english: and to make plain to everyone the administration of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.

Nekeene ng’a omonto OSIRETE ensemo yaye n’omorero otakoera namo nebirecha; aya nigo tokoyamanya ekero tokorigereria amariko: “Ogochia goika ng'umbu, ense y'Abagadari, akaorokerwa nabanto babere babwatetwe nebirecha, nabarabwo bakarua chimbera; nabatindi mono abanto abwo, goika omonto onde takonyara goeta enchera eria” - Matayo 8:28-29 "Goika agachia goika engegu, akanyorwa nomonto oyomo bw'omochie oria, orenge nebirecha; nas'ekero ekenene igarenge tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge goikaransa 'nyomba, tatiga ase chimbera ime. Agachia komorora Yesu akaaka egeturi, akagwa as'obosio bwaye, agakwana as'eriogi rinene, Ninki nde naye, Yesu, Omwana o Nyasaye Ore Igoro Mono? english: What makes a demon know WHO IS WHO in this world? The man who had been possessed by demons told him about his life, fell at his feet, trembling, and begged him, ‘Jesus, Son of God Most High, have mercy on me!’" - Luke 8:27-28 This story shows how a story can be repeated so that we don’t forget what happened…... Anyone WHO DOES NOT KNOW JESUS CHRIST as Lord, and REJECTS his teachings WHO IS WHO and the power that surrounds him, will never escape evil and will always oppose JESUS who CREATED everything! ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emekorogoto yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omoruoti bw’obonene asoe ime!
english: Lift up your heads, O you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

ekegusii: Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko ’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, korende timokorirora.
english: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

ekegusii: Omonene akarua ogochika, na omoganda omonene bw’abakungu bakararia amang’ana ayio:
english: The Lord announced the word, and great was the company of those who proclaimed it:

ekegusii: Naboigo akore okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kw’Abaisraeli amo nogosaria kwabo, na ebibe biabo bionsi. Naende akore okobwatanigwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, eyio ere amo nabarabwo na ase egati y’ogotacheneka kwabo.
english: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.
english: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete.
english: Jesus answered them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.
english: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

ekegusii: “Tebia Abaisraeli ng’a natebire iga: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Korende aye mwanyabanto, tegerera aya nkogotebia; tobaisa koba oyo otari koigwera buna egesaku eke getari koigwera. Asamia omonwa oo, orie egento eke ngokoa.”
english: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."

ekegusii: Obotenenku bwonsi na amasikani nigo bikorwa asore aye, naye okogamba igoro ase bionsi. Ase okoboko kwao chinguru na okobua nao bire; nobwate okobua kw’ogokinia na korua chinguru ase bonsi.
english: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.

ekegusii: Emebere y’abanto baraitwe nigo eratugutwe isiko, na ogotioka kw’obogundo bw’ebitondo ebio nigo koratioke aande onsi; amanyinga ’emebere eyio natirimboke korwa ase ebitunwa igoro.
english: Their slain will be thrown out, their dead bodies will send up a stench; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.

ekegusii: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwabo. Omwana omomura omotangi o Isumaeli nere Nebayoti; na abande nabwo aba: Kedari na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu;

ekegusii: “Inee! Kwaigure amang’ana abanto aba bagokwana? Nigo bagoteba: Omonene bwangire ebisaku biria bibere achorete. Nigo bachayire abanto baane, gose tibababareti koba egesaku.
english: "Have you not noticed that these people are saying, 'The LORD has rejected the two kingdoms he chose'? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, nigo mwanchete abamino bonsi abare Makedonia yonsi. Korende twabasoroire, baminto, momente ayio mono kobua.
english: And in fact, you do love all the brothers throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers, to do so more and more.

ekegusii: ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogoko?
english: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue nimoe ribaga arie amatunda ’omote bw’obogima, oyio ore ase Paradiso ya Nyasae.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.

ekegusii: Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Abisalomu, bakayoruta ase engoro entambe, agwo ase rinani, bakayotuba amagena akaba etui enene, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatama kera omonto gochia bwoye.
english: They took Absalom, threw him into a big pit in the forest and piled up a large heap of rocks over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.

ekegusii: Abakungu baito bare Sayoni bakoreirwe amabe, boigo nabaiseke abekungi abare ase emechi y’Abayuda.
english: Women have been ravished in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.

Enchera ende, oyo ogwete roche nere otagete korianani oy' omwabo oboremo. Esegeto enene neri buna abanto bari bagosinywa kogamberwa ekina na abamwabo, nigo bagotigwa, n' ekina kiabo kianyorwa n’ omobasokano omobe. Bono aya naro agerete Omogusii ominto omokoro agateba buna Mang'ana Ntuboka, Mogayani Obora. Tureti Yaikaransa Yatebia Keore Na Ombere Omwabo Konya Bwango Gose Masio Are Korigererania. Keore N' Ombere Omwabo Batebia Banyene, "Komwangire Bagambi Bw’Abanto Na Gucha Mwayesinya?". Gucha Ngaasama Nkagayana Kina Kia Miaka Amechinini. Mokonywa Oteba Kogwankonyire Bogima Bwa Roche A Gucha Nainche Mboremo Nyakebuna Ndakoe. Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: These are the words: Hey! We Gusii people, we have this story about a doctor who treats many people and heals them quickly. Who are these people? They will be healed. The doctor is called Mang'ana Ntuboka, Mogayani Obora. Let us praise Yaikaransa who heals with strength and power. Strength and power heal people, “Will you forgive the sins of our fathers and their mistakes?” Mistakes happen due to years of wrongdoing. The medicine man refuses to reveal the secret of Roche to those who don’t respect him. Below: It doesn’t matter. Let us say he touched his hands three times, and they were completely cured. The great doctors said, “Aaaa tooooooo!!!!..These are powerful medicines!!” and rejoiced greatly. It happened that Keore and Ombere, they went to a place, and they found people suffering greatly. Many days passed. The doctor then realized that things were happening slowly, and people were getting tired. Many of those who got tired gave up. They were told to persevere, continue working hard. This time the case was serious, Okeore and Ombere asked them to confess. What now? It seems those who get tired give up easily and refuse to finish the work. Continue listening. Continuing to rejoice, those who were wronged were healed!! These days the great doctors and those involved in the case said, “Why are these people being forgiven, why aren’t our fathers and Egucha forgiving them?” Mang'ana’s medicines are used by the doctors. Examine the tools of the doctors. Why does the doctor take so long to heal someone? This situation, the doctors are struggling with their problems. The young doctor takes a long time to heal. Why does he take so long? He doesn’t care, he just wants to earn money. The young doctor goes to ask for help from Roche of Egucha, and he falls down. However, sometimes things happen unexpectedly, and the doctor takes a long time to heal. The doctor should hurry and find a solution, otherwise he will ruin everything! This time it happens again, and he falls down while trying to help them with Egucha. Sometimes they start with a problem, and they cry because Egucha has failed. Quickly, Egucha wakes up and starts shouting loudly!! That place........I remember everything well, and I understand..... Shouting loudly there, they say I remember that place, especially! Explain further, this thing that has fallen, you shouldn’t hide it from your fellow people. It is very important that people are forgiven when they confess their sins to their relatives, and they are remembered, and their names are written by the community leader. Why did they bring Omogusii, a great person, to Mang'ana Ntuboka, Mogayani Obora? Let us praise Yaikaransa Yatebia Keore and our fellow people who have helped everyone. Keore and our fellow people are praising those who said, “Let us forgive the sins of the people and the mistakes they have made?” Gucha Ngaasama Nkagayana has been around for many years. Don’t be afraid to share your knowledge with Gucha, so that he can remember everything properly. The work of the doctor is to help people, and now he needs your support for this week. Goodbye and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Uhuru tabwateraniri na gokong’a kwobogima ime yense; Col (rtd) Cyrus Oguna Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 6, 2022 Omonogeri bwe eserekali Cyrus Oguna otebire omorai bwense Uhuru Kenyatta tabwenereti gotamerwa ase ogokina kwa amagori yebinto ime yense ya Kenya Gokwana ne egetaseni ekemo kioboraria , Oguna nigo aenekia buna ogokina kwa amagori nomochando obwateraneti chinse chinyinge aseigo mochando oywo tori o’ Kenya gose Uhuru. Nigo Oguna amentire goteba buna Uhuru Kenyatta tabwati kobua konde gwensi ase chisegi chigendererete gati yense ya Russia na Ukraine eyu egerete anene mono ase ogokina kwobogima bwa abakenya. Boigo nairaneria amang’ana yoomokonyi bwomorai bwense omosike William Ruto ase atebete buna ogokwanania gati yomorai bwense omosike Uhuru na Raila odinga okwo komanyekanete buna handshake omwaka bwe chiribu ibere na ikomi na isano na isato (2018), nenchera eyemo esegetete ogokina kwamagori yebinto ime yense ya Kenya. Obaboririe abanasiasa batige gotumeka amang’ana buna aywo atabwati bokeene bonde bwensi ase okogania kwemanyekani . Boigo naenekia buna koru abarai abwo babere bakwanani, omorembe na amagenderero arorekanire.
english: Uhuru has been communicating with the government throughout the entire period; Col (rtd) Cyrus Oguna Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 6, 2022 The spokesperson, Cyrus Oguna, stated that President Uhuru Kenyatta should not be allowed to continue interfering with the affairs of the entire country of Kenya According to reports from various media outlets, Oguna explained that interference with the affairs and continuous communication secretly causes more harm than good to Kenya under Uhuru. He further stated that Uhuru Kenyatta does not want to take responsibility for his actions regarding the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine which has caused great suffering to the people of Kenya. english: Five people died from coronavirus in Nyamira Five people have been confirmed to have contracted the coronavirus disease in Nyamira county, bringing the total number of infected people to 379 who have so far been tested positive and discharged after being confirmed to have contracted the disease, while a total of 7,050 people have been screened and the total number of people infected with the disease across Kenya now stands at 10,105. The number of people who have been confirmed to have contracted the disease in Nairobi county is leading with 209 cases followed by Kiambu with 49 cases, Busia with 38 cases, Migori with 19 cases, Mombasa with 16 cases, Kajiado with 12 cases, Uasin Gishu with 8 cases, Lamu with 6 cases, Machakos and Nakuru counties each recorded 5 cases respectively, Wajir, Narok and Kisumu each had 2 cases respectively, while Nyamira, Isiolo, Kericho, Nyeri, and Trans Nzoia counties each recorded one case respectively.
