ekegusii: Naki abwo baare kobekwa ase obokuani tibare kobekwa amo nemuma, korende Yeso akabonyora amo nemuma goetera asare oyo omotebetie, “Omonene otianire, gose takoonchora ebirengererio biaye, Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare.”
english: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: 'You are a priest forever.'"

ekegusii: Yehu akabatebia, “Tuguta omokungu oyio gocha inse aa!” Ase ayio bakamotuguta gochia inse; amanyinga aye agasiarokera enyasi amo ne chibarasi, Yehu akamotindachera inse ne chibarasi ne chigari.
english: "Throw her down!" Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.

ekegusii: Amachiko nigo are ao ase okwegena, ekiagera nigo arikire, “Omonto oyorakore ayio nabe moyo ase aro.”
english: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, "The man who does these things will live by them."

ekegusii: “Aka eriogi rinene, tobaisa gokira, aka eriogi buna eri’egetureri! Tebia abanto baane ogosaria kwabo, batebie abwo bare ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo ebibe biabo.
english: "Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the house of Jacob their sins.

ekegusii: Nigo ekwenaria okobua gwonsi kw’eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani ase obosio bwaye, na kogera ense na bonsi abamenyete aroro basasime eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani, ero eyio orogoma rwaye rw’amakweri rwagwenetigwe.
english: He exercised all the authority of the first beast on his behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amachenu asende egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: Say to the Israelites, 'This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare nomochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with him.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki omokuani akabogoria orogunchara rw’amaguta korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, agaaka Sulemani amaguta ayio ase okomwatanana. Erio bakabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagateba, “Omoruoti Sulemani ochie kare!”
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"

ekegusii: “Erio abwo baratigare goika baorokie ebibe biabo, naende baorokie ebie chisokoro chiabo, abwo batabete abegenwa asende, na ekiagera baangete konyigwera,
english: "'But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers-- their treachery against me and their hostility toward me,

ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chibesa chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.
english: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one's sack, along with the silver for his grain." And he did as Joseph said.

ekegusii: Agwo akabatebia, “Narorire ng’a iso tari kondigereria buya rero buna botambe. Korende Nyasae o tata obeire ore amo nainche.
english: He said to them, "I see that your father's attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

ekegusii: "Listen to me and I will explain to you; let me tell you what I have seen,
english: “Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.

ekegusii: Namosesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde bionsi. Ase egati yaino onde tari omosacha gose omokungu, orabe omogomba, gose etugo ende yaino tekogombaa.
english: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor any of your livestock without young.

ekegusii: Erio ngatebia abanene baria basikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bande, “Emeremo nigo ere emenene, naende egareete, na intwe nigo twesiarerete ase orwaki rwonsi, na kera omonto nigo are aare korwa ase oyonde.
english: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.

ekegusii: Ekero nanyora amang’ana ng’a bamoboeire omonto oyo, ngachora komotoma asore erio kegima, ngachika abamosoeri bache bakwane amang’ana igoro yaye ase obosio bwao.”
english: When I was informed of a plot to be carried out against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkaigwa egento buna neriogi rinene ri’omoganda omonene igoro, rigoteba, “Haleluya! Ogotooreka, na obonene, na okobua, nebia Nyasae oito.
english: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,

ekegusii: Meonotai akaibora Ofura. Seraya akaibora Yoabu ise Abageharasimu. Barabwo nigo barogetwe igo, ekiagera barenge abaroisia ebinto.
english: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge Harashim. It was called this because its people were craftsmen.

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw’ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omonto ogotegerera nagenderere gokwana.
english: A false witness will perish, and whoever listens to him will be destroyed forever.

ekegusii: Korende inwe Omonene obarusirie ase eriko ri’ebioma rigosamba, nario Misiri, erinde mobe abanto baye ere omonyene buna more goika rero iga.
english: But as for you, the LORD took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

ekegusii: Amaranya amo nemegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche rwa Naili mbiome bisareke kegima.
english: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.

ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amariogi ’emeganda y’abanto bakwoga igoro ase ebitunwa! Tegerera moigwe amariogi ay’okomumura kw’amaruoti ’ebisaku asangererekanire amo. Omonene bw’Emeganda nkoroberia are emeganda y’esegi.
english: Listen, a noise on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations massing together! The LORD Almighty is mustering an army for war.

ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.
english: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

ekegusii: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, "What were you arguing about on the road?"
english: Bagaika Kapernaumu. Ekero arenge nyomba ime, akababoria, “Ninki mware koamererania inchera?”

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.
english: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa na eriogi rie chimbaba chi’ebitongwa biria bire moyo chigokunana, na eriogi ri’amagoro aria arenge mbarabare yabo riarenge buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba.
english: the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.

ekegusii: Mbarengeo abanto bagechetigwe ase emioyo yabo, bakabora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?
english: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?

ekegusii: Ase igo agatoma abanto bagende Tekoa kwoyia omokungu gete omong’aini korwao. Ekero achire Yoabu akamotebia, “Aye bwekore ng’a nigo okwereire; obeke chianga chi’ogokwerwa, tibweaka amaguta, bwekore buna omokungu obeire okweumia amatuko amange ekiagera akwereirwe.
english: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and had a wise woman brought from there. He said to her, "Pretend you are in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes, and don't use any cosmetic lotions. Act like a woman who has spent many days grieving for the dead.

ekegusii: Gaki, nonya chire echinde chikorokwa chinyasae igoro gose ense (buna chire “chinyasae” chinyinge, na “abanene” abange)
english: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"),

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Onye nabo, naki rende Nyasae aranyare kogambia ense?
english: Certainly not! If that were so, how could God judge the world?

ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mokaye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi?”
english: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?"

ekegusii: Kwabekeire omwaka egutwa y’obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.
english: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

ekegusii: Ekero ebiku bikorenta amakweri a mobosokano, na abanto batari na komocha banyorwe namaakwa, ere nigo akobachecheria.
english: When a scourge brings sudden death, he mocks the despair of the innocent.

ekegusii: Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye gochia sugusu asirie Abaasuri; nasirie na Nineva obe bosa, na ayuomie obe erooro.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa buna neriogi rikorwa gati‐gati ye ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo, rikobora, “Engano ekemunu ekemo ase edinari eyemo, na esairi ebimunu bitato ase edinari eyemo; amaguta na edivai tobisaria.”
english: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "A quart of wheat for a day's wages, and three quarts of barley for a day's wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!"

ekegusii: Ngachanda abanto b’Enchera eye goika nkabaita bagakwa, ngasiba abasacha na abakungu na kobabeka echela ime,
english: I persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison,

ekegusii: Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?
english: Why do you pursue me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakabeera aroro amo na Daudi ase amatuko atato, bakaba bakoria na konywa, ekiagera abamwabo konya babaariganeirie ebinto bionsi.
english: The men spent three days there with David, eating and drinking, for their families had supplied provisions for them.

ekegusii: Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”
english: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."

ekegusii: Obotambe bw’esiiro eyemo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na igoro ase esiiro egesure gi’etaai nkiarengeo; obotambe gochia igoro bw’egesure keria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atato. Egechanga na emegwekano y’amakomomanga biaetanaine egesure keria. Bionsi nigo biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai. Esiiro ya kabere nigo yarenge egwekaine eria entang’ani, yaetananirie nebichanga.
english: Each pillar was twenty-seven feet high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was four and a half feet high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Ee bono, titokogoita, nigo toragosibe rioka, erio tokobeke ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.” Ase ayio bakamosiba ne chingori ibere chinyia, erio bakamorusia korwa ase egetare keria.
english: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.

ekegusii: Ankio mambia goika mwerente aa bosio, egesaku ase egesaku. Abanto b’egesaku keria Omonene aratige obomera bobagwere goika bache bosio, eamate ase eamate Abanto b’eamate eria obomera boragwere bache bosio, enyomba ase enyomba. Abanto b’enyomba eyio Omonene aratige obomera bobagwere goika bache bosio omonto ase omonto.
english: "'In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD takes shall come forward clan by clan; the clan that the LORD takes shall come forward family by family; and the family that the LORD takes shall come forward man by man.

ekegusii: Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw’okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso ’ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y’abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.
english: The LORD has brought over you a deep sleep: He has sealed your eyes (the prophets); he has covered your heads (the seers).

ekegusii: Bono onde tamochera oyomwabo na komong’aina ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera Omonene nere okorusia egesiomba ase aya onsi, buna twabamanyetie ritang’ani na kobakurera bokong’u.
english: and that in this matter no one should wrong his brother or take advantage of him. The Lord will punish men for all such sins, as we have already told you and warned you.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye gwatomire rirube ase erieta riao gochia ase abanto bonsi bare Yerusalemu, na ase Sefania, mosinto o Maaseya omokuani, na ase abakuani bonsi. Ase rirube erio kwarikire iga:
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,

ekegusii: “Inee! Abaisraeli nabasomba bare? Gose nigo baiboretwe bare abasomba? Onye taibo, nase ki rende bakoirwa ase obosomba?
english: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?

ekegusii: Ere agantebia: Koranche, ong’ike ang’e ong’ite, ekiagera nonya ngendererete koba moyo, nigo inde nobororo bw’ogokwa.
english: "Then he said to me, 'Stand over me and kill me! I am in the throes of death, but I'm still alive.'

ekegusii: Aye omonene one, Omonene nere ogotangire tigwaitera amanyinga na kweruseria egesiomba nokoboko kwao omonyene. Bono buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, tiga ababisa bao, abwo bakorigia kogokora bobe, babe buna Nabali.
english: "Now since the LORD has kept you, my master, from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, as surely as the LORD lives and as you live, may your enemies and all who intend to harm my master be like Nabal.

ekegusii: Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.
english: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?
english: "Are all these words to go unanswered? Is this talker to be vindicated?

ekegusii: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.
english: Naki ekero twarenge amo nainwe ntwatang’anete kobatebia ng’a ntonyore emechando, buna yabete agwo, na inwe moyemanyete.

ekegusii: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.
english: “Naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Haroni amo nabamura baye.

ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye; moche ase obosio bwaye morentane ebiegwa, mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu!
english: ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name. Bring an offering and come before him; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’ayio agakorera Dina, omoiseke oyio o Yakobo, buya, akamwancha na gokwana nere amang’ana amaya.
english: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke tenderly to her.

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia Elisha, “Aye beera aiga, ekiagera Omonene ontomire ngende Yorodan.” Elisha akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, naende buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio, aba babere bakagenda orogendo rwabo.
english: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here; the LORD has sent me to the Jordan." And he replied, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So the two of them walked on.

ekegusii: nachigete chisokoro chiaino, ekero nachirusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko rigosamba. Nigo nabatebetie ng’a kobaranyigwere na bakore onsi aya nabachigete, erio nario baare gocha koba abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.
english: the terms I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.' I said, 'Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

ekegusii: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
english: Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

ekegusii: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n’Abayuda goika rero iga.
english: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

ekegusii: Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani asende.”
english: "Sir," the invalid replied, "I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me."

ekegusii: Yoshua akabaakera obomera ase okoboria Omonene aria Silo, agaatananera Abaisraeli ense eyio, kera egesaku ensemo yaye.
english: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Naende nerikire: Toteema Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
english: Jesus answered him, "It is also written: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"

ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.
english: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

ekegusii: Korende ebiatigarete korwa ase eeri eria, riiyo riaye, ne chinyama, na esike, akabisokia isiko y’egetwori akabisambera aroro, buna Omonene amochigete.
english: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its offal he burned up outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: “Ee, barabwo nigo batochandete korwa oboke bwaito, korende tibana‐gotobua.
english: they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.

ekegusii: Akarigia chitaya chirentwe, akarindoka gochia ime, okoiguswa ase obwoba, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Paulo na Sila;
english: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

ekegusii: Chigochi chie chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna chimbeera chiasie, bonsi nigo bare abanto chituoni.
english: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.

ekegusii: Abamidiani, na Abaameleki, na abanto ba moocha nigo barenge agwo ase ense omweya abange buna chingige. Nigo barenge ne chingamia chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha chitaare kobareka.
english: The Midianites, the Amalekites and all the other eastern peoples had settled in the valley, thick as locusts. Their camels could no more be counted than the sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia komorora, bakamosasima; korende abande mbabete nogosiereria.
english: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

ekegusii: Nigo kiarenge ekero ki’obokendu, na Yeso nigo arenge gotaara ase Hekalu ime, ase egoora ya Sulemani.
english: and Jesus was in the temple area walking in Solomon's Colonnade.

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.
english: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies.

ekegusii: Abarisia tibakonyora ase baratamere; abanene be riicho tibagotooreka.
english: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.

ekegusii: Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
english: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;

ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora aya, bakooboa, bakamotogia Nyasae, oyoete mwanyabanto okobua konga buna oko.
english: When the crowd saw this, they were filled with awe; and they praised God, who had given such authority to men.

ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mokaye.
english: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

ekegusii: Naase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”
english: You know the way to the place where I am going."

ekegusii: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
english: na Hasari‐Gada, na Hesimoni, na Beti‐Peleti,

ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.
english: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, ningenderere gokora amang’ana ay’ogokumia ase abanto aba, ee, amang’ana ayio nigo arabe ay’ogokumigwa na goichanwa; obong’aini bw’abanto babo bare abang’aini mbosire, na okomanya kw’abamanyete mono nkobiswe.”
english: Therefore once more I will astound these people with wonder upon wonder; the wisdom of the wise will perish, the intelligence of the intelligent will vanish."

ekegusii: Bugia egetureri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata ogochenu, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasima!
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

ekegusii: Erio Elikana akairana gochia Rama nka bwoye, korende omwana oria Samweli agatigara ogokorera Omonene inse y’oboteneneri bwa Eli omokuani.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwarigania endagera bayebeka ase emesa, babeka abarendi bakorenda, naende baria na konywa. Bono inwe abagambi, imoka, moake chinguba chiaino ebitinya.
english: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamoboria, “Ngoika ririri oratoichanie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, totebia maiso marore.”
english: The Jews gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae akamoseria korwa ase omogondo o Edeni, akamobeka areme riroba agwo ase arwete.
english: So the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

ekegusii: Naomi agatebia baka bamura baye ng’a bairane, na kera oyomo agende komenya mwa ng’ina. Naende akabora, “Omonene abakorere amaya, buna inwe mwakorerete baria bakwete, mogankorera nainche.
english: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back, each of you, to your mother's home. May the LORD show kindness to you, as you have shown to your dead and to me.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaooma Hekalu ime netahabu engiya. Chingataare chiaoomire netahabu chikabekwa ase egesieri bosio bw’akanyomba ka ime.
english: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.

ekegusii: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor do I consort with hypocrites;
english: Tindi gosanga nabanyaborimo, gose tindi kogosoria nabang’ainereria.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria Yehosafati, “Omonto oyomo natigarete, toraborie Omonene goetera asare, nere Mikaya, mosinto o Imula, korende nigo imogechete, ekiagera ere tari kobana amang’ana amaya igoro yane, korende botambe namabe oka.” Yehosafati akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokwana igo.”
english: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say that," Jehoshaphat replied.

ekegusii: Ere akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na etato. Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Samiri.
english: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

ekegusii: Omosenia chibao nigo akorambora ekerengo, bwata omong’ororia nekaramu ase ebao. Erio oyesenia neranda, oyeng’ororia ekeringerera, naende oyebaacha yaba omogwekano bw’omonto omonyakieni, oyobeka nyomba ime.
english: The carpenter measures with a line and makes an outline with a marker; he roughs it out with chisels and marks it with compasses. He shapes it in the form of man, of man in all his glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.

english: Salumu akaibora Yekamia, na Yekamia akaibora Elisama.

english: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

english: Now when you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes and all kinds of music, if you are ready to fall down and worship the image I made, very good. But if you do not worship it, you will be thrown immediately into a blazing furnace. Then what god will be able to rescue you from my hand?"

ekegusii: Buna abana abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kwe ritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,
english: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

ekegusii: Endo yaimokire korwa ase riraro riaye; oria ogosiria ebisaku oimokire, orure aase aye, akore ense yaino ebe bosa; emechie yaino nesarigwe ebe amaturi, atamenyiri nabanto.

ekegusii: Morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
english: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil;

ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.
english: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.

ekegusii: Naki igo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.
english: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

ekegusii: Korende nairokire ng’a buna eng’iti eria, ase obong’ainereria bwaye, yang’ainete Hawa, naboigo ebirengererio biaino birasareke, na mobaise gotiga obwegenwa bwaino bw’ekeene more nabwo ase Kristo.
english: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent's cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

english: You foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless?

english: They were from nations about which the LORD had told the Israelites, "You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods." Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.

english: na Malikiramu, Pedaya na Senasari, Yekamia na Hosama, na Nedabia.

english: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, "The two will become one flesh."

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Korwa Ase Capital FM, Parliament Grounds: Riberera ritindi ndiamentekana ase rituko ria rero, aaria ase Parliarment, igoro y' ogochia maguta motwe ase ebiiseke. Kobwatekana na Kitutu Chache North MP Hon Jimmy Angwenyi, ogochia maguta motwe nigo kore egento ekenene ase ebisaku ebinge, naende buna nigo ebewenerete gotigwe kogenderera. Parliament nigo yatebetigwe buna the Director of Public Prosecutions, nigo atagete gokora omokia gosiria FGM, ase chinsemo echio chire chintindi ase egekoro ekio echio chire buna ekobwatia: It is time to move on. Ching'ong'o chiria still chikwerekererete FGM ase obotindi, Kenya engima. Nyamira County Women's Representative, Mhe Alice Chae nigo agotosemia buna bono yaikire engaki ase intwe Abagusii to move on, korwa ase chinchera chiria chitatokonye gochia ase amatuko a motwe. "Inche tiindochi buna ninki gekogera eserikali etagete goetia amachiko ayio agoita ekemira, abwo ase ntwe totaraetia richiko rigokana obwanchani gati ya abasacha amo na abasacha bande, gose abakungu am na abakungu bande, ebio bire ebimira bie chinse chinde" Nabo Mhe Angwenyi atebete. "Egekoro kia Abagusii nigo kegoteba buna abaiseke nkonintwa bare aake" Nabo Mhe Angwenyi amentete naende. Bono abwo nario riberera riamentekanete ekero Mwingi North MP Mhe John Munuve, aboretie Mhe. Angwenyi gose ere onintirwe, naende gose n' ekeene buna abaiseke baye banintirwe. Abwo abwo bono nario Nyamira County Women's Representative Mhe Alice Chae aimogete na goteba buna ere nachiete magotwa motwe. Ase boigo, nigo Mhe Chae atebete buna ekemira eke nigo kere ekebe, naende giateire amatuko aye. "Nigo ngosaba buna nanga Mhe Angwenyi nigo are omosubati buna inche, oyio ochiete maguta motwe, korende ore moyo. Ase boigo, tiga Mhe Angwenyi atoenekerie buna abasacha bagototama, erinde bagenda konywoma abakungu korwa chinsemo chiria chitari kogenda maguta motwe" Nabo Mhe Chae amentete. Mhe. Angwenyi, oyio ogendererete gwekwania, nigo atugutetwe isiko ya Parliament. Ababunge nigo baboretie buna tiga richiko rikong'igwe, ase ogosiria egekoro eke, ekio kere mamincha y' richiko ria Kenya, Prohibition of FGM Act of 2011 and the The Children's Act of 2001.
english: These are the details: Event at Capital FM, Parliament Grounds: The situation is tense and uncertain near Parliament, there is a lot of commotion and excitement. It involves Kitutu Chache North MP Hon Jimmy Angwenyi, a lot of commotion and excitement is happening, and it seems they are planning something to help. Parliament has been adjourned while the Director of Public Prosecutions investigates cases related to FGM, and this issue is very serious and important because it affects our daughters: It is time to move forward. This practice which continues to perpetuate FGM and child marriage, shames Kenya. Nyamira County Women's Representative, Hon Alice Chae said that we should forget about the past and encourage the Abagusii people to move on, so that this harmful tradition does not continue. "We need to thank the government for taking action against those who commit these crimes, both current and former officials, including leaders and former leaders, and all those involved in this bad behavior," Hon Angwenyi added. “The future of the Abagusii people depends on ensuring our children are safe” Hon Angwenyi concluded. This matter also concerns Mwingi North MP Hon John Munuve, who supported Hon. Angwenyi and urged everyone to be careful, and emphasized that our children deserve protection. This was also echoed by Nyamira County Women's Representative Hon Alice Chae who agreed and stated she will continue to fight for their rights. And further, Hon Chae added that the law is already in place, and she respects the traditions of her people. "I urge Hon Angwenyi to continue speaking out, to protect our children, and to save lives. And I ask Hon Angwenyi to show compassion to the people, so they don't blame leaders for this harmful tradition,” Hon Chae concluded. Hon. Angwenyi, who is seeking re-election, was escorted out of Parliament. Members of Parliament have resolved that if the law is broken, and if it threatens the welfare of the country, then it undermines the laws of Kenya, the Prohibition of FGM Act of 2011 and the The Children's Act of 2001.

ekegusii: Gehasi agatang’ana akagenda bosio, akabeka enyimbo eria igoro ase obosio bw’omwana oria, korende nonya neriogi gose ekemanyererio kende tikiarengeo ng’a omwana nabe moyo. Ase ayio akairana, akaumerana n’Elisha, akamotebia, “Omwana tacheti moyo.”
english: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the boy's face, but there was no sound or response. So Gehazi went back to meet Elisha and told him, "The boy has not awakened."

ekegusii: Baise kogotebia, “Inchuo ogende amo naintwe; toboere abanto tobaite, toumokere onde bwensi otari na komocha.
english: If they say, "Come along with us; let's lie in wait for someone's blood, let's waylay some harmless soul;

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bw’omwaka o kabere nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, akamotebia,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:

ekegusii: Omorente atenene ase obosio bw’Eleazari omokuani, na ase amasio ’omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto, erio ase amasio abo omorarie ng’a nere oirire ribaga riao.
english: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

ekegusii: Chinsea chiaye nigo chinga buna ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari, bigotioka rimisu rigiya. Ebikoba biaye nigo binga buna ebisicha ebiya, nigo bigotonyia manemane.
english: His cheeks are like beds of spice yielding perfume. His lips are like lilies dripping with myrrh.

ekegusii: Tinkogotiga osekererwe nabanto b’ebisaku nonya ng’ake, gose togochaywa nabanto. Aye togotiga egesaku kiao kegwe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Naende akarusia abakuani barenge gosasima emegwekano, baria abaruoti b’Abayuda babegete gosambera ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase emechie y’Abayuda na goetanana Yerusalemu; naboigo nabaria barenge gosamba ubani ase Baali, na erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi chia igoro.
english: He did away with the pagan priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem-- those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Arama otebire amaonchorerio yerichiko ye busaa irarente emeremo, ebirengo biokorosia bigende igoro Omobunge bwe econstituency ya Nakuru Town West Hon.Samuel Arama nigo are nekerenga kiogochia gokorera amaonchorerio ensemo yerichiko ria “Alcohol drinks and control act of 2010 to legalise busaa” Nigo atebire buna richiko erio ribaise goeta emeremo neetoke, ebusaa korosigwa ne ebirengo bio obochenu bwa igoro ne ebango gotoka ase chinsemo ebusaa eraonigwe. Sangana Nancy Kemunto Ekiababa amo na Hon. Samuel Arama ime yomoroberio Bwebigeri erio bwemanyie amange.
english: Minto FM: The MP has requested an amendment to the law regarding traditional alcoholic beverages so that they can be legally produced, stating that brewers are suffering due to the current regulations. The Member of Parliament for Nakuru Town West Constituency Hon.Samuel Arama said he will bring a motion to amend the "Alcohol Drinks and Control Act of 2010" to legalize busaa. He added that this law is causing hardship for people because busaa production is prohibited and brewers are facing challenges and their businesses are being shut down due to illegal busaa brewing. Reportedly Nancy Kemunto Ekiababa and Hon. Samuel Arama were at a meeting in Bwebigeri where this issue was discussed extensively.

ekegusii: Nkagenda nkarobisa aase agwo buna Omonene anchigete.
english: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD told me.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagasiria abanto abatigari b’Abaameleki, naende bakamenya aroro, nao bare goika rero iga.
english: They killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ogokora igo mokagoka na gochenga; mokanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, mokaba mokoria chinyama na konywa edivai, mogateba, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”
english: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! "Let us eat and drink," you say, "for tomorrow we die!"

ekegusii: Bae abanto abwo emeremo emerito mono, baisaneke nero, na tibabaisa gotegerera amang’ana ’oborimo.”
english: Make the work harder for the men so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies."

ekegusii: Onye oyomino okoba nogwechanda ase engencho y’endagera okoria aye, gwatigire gotaara ase obwanchani. Ase engencho y’endagera yao tosaria omonto oria, ere Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.
english: If your brother is distressed because of what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother for whom Christ died.

ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaka komosoera, agateba, “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,
english: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented his case before Felix: "We have enjoyed a long period of peace under you, and your foresight has brought about reforms in this nation.

ekegusii: Inche: nkabatebia: Onde bwensi obwate etahabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”
english: So I told them, 'Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.' Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero asogete mambia, agatenena agakwana nabanto bonsi, akabora, “Inwe timori na komocha. Ninche nakora omoroberio mamincha y’omonene one, nkamoita, korende ning’o oita abaiga bonsi?
english: The next morning Jehu went out. He stood before all the people and said, "You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

ekegusii: ekiagera Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oyore gati‐gati y’ekerogo ki’obonene nabarisie, ere nabaraae gochia ase chinsoko chi’amache are moyo, na Nyasae natinyie amariga onsi korwa ase amaiso abo.”
english: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; he will lead them to springs of living water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamotebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”]
english: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."

ekegusii: Sulemani omoruoti akarua ebing’wanso, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000). Naboigo omoruoti amo nabanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba ya Nyasae ekaba enchenu.
english: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.

ekegusii: Korende abaminto, nindigetie momanye ng’a ekero ase ekero nigo narengereretie gocha asemore (korende ngatangeka goika bono) erinde inyore okwama ase egati yaino, buna inde nakwo ase abanto b’Ebisaku binde.
english: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that I planned many times to come to you (but have been prevented from doing so until now) in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.

ekegusii: Gaki manya ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere bweka Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende Nyasae bw’obwegenwa, oyokorenda okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, na koorokia obwanchani bwaye botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu ase baria bamwanchete na babwatete amachiko aye.
english: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commands.

ekegusii: Korende oyogosaba, tiga asabe ase okwegena, taba na tang’u‐tang’u, ekiagera oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u nigo are buna emerindo y’enyancha ekona‐koirwa nomwaga gochia aaria na aaria.
english: But when he asks, he must believe and not doubt, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

ekegusii: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.'
english: Nere oragotebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.

ekegusii: Esanduku eria ekabogorigwa goetanana omochie ara rimo. Erio bonsi bakairana ase batoorete, bakabeerao obotuko boria.
english: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. Then the people returned to camp and spent the night there.

ekegusii: Omonene oorokirie okoboko kwaye ogochenu ase amaiso ebisaku bionsi, ne chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense nchirore ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.
english: The LORD will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

ekegusii: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
english: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo nare aiga ase oboruoti bwao, omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu ore ime yaye. Ase engaki eria iso arenge kogamba, omonto oyio akarorekana ore noborabu, na okomanya, na obong’aini bore buna obwe chinyasae, ime yaye. Omoruoti Nebukadinesaro iso akamobeka akaba omonene bw’abaringoria, na abarogi, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, ee, nabo omoruoti iso akorete,
english: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods in him. In the time of your father he was found to have insight and intelligence and wisdom like that of the gods. King Nebuchadnezzar your father-- your father the king, I say-- appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners.

ekegusii: Tochandeka ase engencho ye chitigere chiria chiasirete korwa ase amatuko atato aetire, ekiagera echio chianyorekanire. Inee! Ebinto bionsi ebiya bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli nase ng’o birabe? Nigo birabe asore na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.”
english: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and all your father's family?"

ekegusii: Ere nigo are nobwanchani asende, naende orwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ngotamera, ekiagera nabeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.
english: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

ekegusii: They were all encouraged and ate some food themselves.
english: Erio bonsi bakagonkomoka, na barabwo bakaria endagera.

ekegusii: Omonene akabaa egesusuro, ekiagera bagerete Haroni agakora emori eria, bakayesasima.
english: And the LORD struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.

ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.
english: The evil deeds of a wicked man ensnare him; the cords of his sin hold him fast.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio asende, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime na ekeokio kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo; ninkoiranie ogende ase enchera eria gwacherete.
english: Because you rage against me and your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.'

ekegusii: Erio abaringoria, na abaragori, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, bagacha asende. Inche nkabatebia chindoto chiria, korende tibanyarete gontebia engencho yaye.
english: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners came, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.

ekegusii: Goika rituko ria rero monto onde tari bwekeeirie ase okoba omoitongo, gose koiroka na kobwata amachiko aane, na emeroberio nabegete ase amasio aino, na ase amasio e chisokoro chiaino.
english: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your fathers.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.
english: Jesus answered, "My teaching is not my own. It comes from him who sent me.

ekegusii: na ekero amonyorete akamorenta Antiokia. Ase engaki y’omwaka omogima bagasangererekana amo nekanisa na kworokereria abanto abange. Agwo Antiokia nao aborokigwa batang’anete korokwa Abakristo.
english: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Misiri more buna abaiseke abekungi, tiira gochia ase Gileadi monyore amaguta akogwenia. Namoisa konyora amariogo amange a bosa asemore, okogwenigwa tikori asemore.
english: "Go up to Gilead and get balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt. But you multiply remedies in vain; there is no healing for you.

ekegusii: Na abanto baito tiga beorokererie kwerua ase ogokora okuya, na gokonya aase oboremerwa bore, erinde tibaba batari nokwama.
english: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order that they may provide for daily necessities and not live unproductive lives.

ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kane bokagwera Romamuti‐Eseri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng’a abeire bosa ase engencho y’obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yeso Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,
english: What is more, I consider everything a loss compared to the surpassing greatness of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ

ekegusii: Korende echiare chinyoro tare gochibekera ebite ebio. Ase igo echiare chinyoro nigo chiare koba echia Labani, na echiare ne chinguru chiba echia Yakobo.
english: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.

ekegusii: Abigaeli agatebia abasomba baye, “Tang’ana mogende, nainche nkobabwatia inde.” Korende tatebetie Nabali, omosacha oye.
english: Then she told her servants, "Go on ahead; I'll follow you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Ase omokubio oyo oera, omogaka sokoro ominto natosemia igoro y' Omogusii oria orenge korokwa Omorominta. Ntwarora buna omorominta nigo are Omogusii oria oitete Omosigisi. Ase boigo, tokarora buna ogoitana gwaito ntwe Abagusii n' ebisaku binde nigo kwarengeo ase engencho ebisaku ebi binde biatoetanaine, biatagete gotoita. Ase rero, omongina magokoro ominto nigo atagete kobwatera abwo korwa ase sokoro atigerete. Tigwachiete nyangi? Rirorio tiyarenge konyarekana ogende ase ekeigoroigoro gi' okoremera ebiranya ase engaki eyio. Abangina nkoiririata bare aaria Keumbu. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. Omongina baba ominto nigo agoteba buna ase chisegi chiato amo n' Abasigisi, ebiranya nkoremerwa biare. Bono okoremera ebiranya ninki? Nabo oraborie. Ebiranya nigo biare koremerwa erinde Abasigisi aba ababisa baitwe ase obonge. Ase okoinyora, ntwaroche ase eganki y' omotienyi bw' Egetamo (March) omwaka oyo, buna ebiranya biaremeretwe mbaka Abasigisi abange bagaitwa ase Esegi Y' Osaosao amo na Kabianga. Ebiranya nigo biare koremerwa nse. Biamanya koragererigwa n' abagaka abanene Bono baba nigo agoteba buna oyore gosicha ebiigoro igoro nere ore kogenda oremera ebiranya egere bing'use abasigisi. Bono ebiranya ninki? Kobwatekana n' baba ominto, eye n'emete yare gosunyuntwa baremera inse. Ko biaremeirwe nse, abagaka abakoro nigo bare koragereria Abasigisi. Bono Abasigisi bakonyagoka baete rioka, nigo biare kobasiekera, baitwa baera pi! Ebiigoro igoro n'omong'ina Omogusii ogasichire oba buna egosori yare gokorwa botuko korende torenge borogi. Komenta nayio, bari bare koyokora nigo bare koba getirianda! Mosacha tatakeire igaa! Ebiigoro igoro nigo biare gokorwa n' abakungu boka. Abaminto inyora buna aba n' abakungu boka bare koyokora. Oyo otamanyete, tare kogenda. Tari igo rioka, oyotachieti nyangi, taregochi aroro na torekoirwa nka. Chinyabubu nigo chiare gosicha, na aiga obosemi obonge nigo bware koregwa buna enyangi ye ebitinge, kera ekemo kie ebimira bio Omogusii na nigo yaregosicherwa orosana ime na abakorerani ao ao. Nabo omoyega bw' okoremera ebiranya orenge gokorwa igo. Until next time, omongina baba nigo ateba buna bwatera abwo and thank you for listening.
english: These are the things: It is said this day, the government is good, seeking help from people so that the Gusii nation may be remembered by the Government. We request that the government remember the Gusii nation who have helped the Kisii people. It is also said, we request that you bring gifts like the Gusii and their clans so that they can remember those clans which were forgotten, they will not fail to assist. Therefore, a person with a good heart should not fail to help them because they have assisted. Are we understanding correctly? The matter does not exceed showing respect and honoring the differences among the communities and their cultures. Those who understand well are found in Keumbu. Picture with Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. A person who loves people understands that there is a meeting with the Kisii people, differences are being honored greatly. Why honor the differences now? They are asking about it. Differences are greatly honored especially the Kisii people who show kindness to others and their generosity. Also concerning this, we request that you remember the culture of our ancestors during March of this year, so that differences are honored until the Kisii elders are called upon from Esegi Y' Osaosao and Kabianga. Differences are greatly honored indeed. They know how to cooperate with the leaders. Therefore, people understand that you should go and see the problems facing the people so that you can help them overcome those challenges. What about these differences? It is about uniting with the people, and they are happy when they are helped. Let it not be forgotten, the leaders should remind the Kisii people. Therefore, the Kisii people should rejoice and celebrate, they should sing songs of praise! These problems and the Gusii people who are suffering, it is said that they will be resolved quickly so that they don’t take too long. Comment on this, if they continue they will find solutions! The youth should not be left behind! These problems will be solved by the leaders. People say that those with the leaders should continue. This one you did not understand, go and learn. It is not a small matter, you will understand later and be rewarded accordingly. Gossip is spreading, and all the bad news has been heard that the community’s traditions, customs and values of the Gusii people have been preserved and shown to everyone and their collaborators. They also pray for assistance in resolving the differences and ensuring it doesn’t happen again. Until next time, people love and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Nimbe ngotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene, inde ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
english: that I may walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

ekegusii: Korende Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani, agaika, akamorusia ase amaboko aito ne chinguru,
english: We planned to judge him according to our own law, but the commander Lysias came, and with great violence took him from us. Then Lysias gave orders that his accusers should come before you. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]

ekegusii: Aiga nao obong’aini boganeirie. Ere oyore ne chisemi tiga abare chinamba chi’eng’iti eyio, naki echi nechinamba chia mwanyabanto, ne chinamba chiaye namagana atano na rimo na emerongo etano nomo na isano nemo (666).
english: This calls for wisdom. If anyone has insight, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is man's number. His number is 666.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’ense ase engencho y’amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Naki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!
english: "Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

ekegusii: “Ribebe ria irianyi nigo rirabebekane norongogo rwa Gadi. Nigo riragenderere korwa Tamari gochia ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba, na korwa aroro ribwatie akarooche ka Misiri ritwomere Enyancha Enene.
english: "The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi [of Egypt] to the Great Sea.

ekegusii: Twaramboreire Abamisiri na Abaasuri amaboko batoe endagera egotoisana.
english: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.

ekegusii: Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagambi ebina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.”
english: then these also would be sins to be judged, for I would have been unfaithful to God on high.

ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, inche Omonene ngasiria Abaamori abwo barenge abatambe buna emecharake, naende abakong’u buna omote onga buna omotontera. Nigo nasiretie amatunda abo, ngasimora nemeri yabo yonsi.
english: "I destroyed the Amorite before them, though he was tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.

ekegusii: Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omoruoti akamoboria, “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria, “Barabwo nigo barwa Babeli, ense y’aare, bagacha asende.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came to me from Babylon."

ekegusii: Erio abatang’ani abwo bakairaneria, bagateba, “Goika toiranie ebinto ebio, gose titoboria ebitoki korwa asebare; ntokore buna gwatebire.” Agwo nkarangeria abakuani batianie abatang’ani abwo barie eira ng’a bakore buna batebetigwe.
english: "We will give it back," they said. "And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say." Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.

ekegusii: naende, “Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.”
english: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.'"

ekegusii: Ense y’Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Seiri nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y’ababisa babo. Abaisraeli mbagenderere koba nokobua.
english: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

ekegusii: Usia korwa Asitera; Sama na Yeieli, basinto ba Hotamu korwa Aroeri;
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

english: "'Sir,' the man replied, 'leave it alone for one more year, and I'll dig around it and fertilize it.

ekegusii: Omongina Kwamboka Mireri, (Ichuni) Bomobea, Nyaribari Masaba; Omogaka Samuel Omare Nyambisa, (Gesure) Bosansa, Bobasi Chache; Omogaka Kenyanya Marube, (Otamba) Bogeka, Nyaribari Chache; Amaumuntia (May) 26, 2012. Chinyomba chio Omogusii: Aya amwabo aya: Ntwaroche nga aaiga Egesumu (Kisumu), nao ng'ina Mogusii [ omongina Nyakomisaro oyio naende orenge korokwa Nyakomogendi ] asirerete. Ase boigo, ntwatebetigwe buna omwana o Mogusii okorokwa Orechi (Enswe ase Ekegere), nao anyoreretwe aaiga Egesumu. Ase okogenderera gotebigwa omogano oyo oito, temanyekanetie gose Orechi ere nigo atigarete aaiga Egesumu ase okonganya konde gwaito, na gotwara ororeri rwaye aroro, gose nigo asirerete aroro. Erieta "Kisumu" n' rie Ekegusii. Twaikire Downtown, City Of Kisumu [Egesumu]. Tiga tosike omochie o Kisumu. Aaaiga nao esokoro yaito enene, Mogusii asirerete. Ase boigo, aaiga nao ng'ina Mogusii, [ magokoro oito omonene Nyakomisaro, oyio naende ore korokwa Nyakomogendi ] asirerete. Ase okogenderera n' omogano oyo oito, nigo togotebigwa buna abamura ba Mogusii baria banganyete korwa Egesumu nigo barenge batano na babere. Orechi ere tari gokwanwa ase achiete. Bono nigo togotebigwa ng'a Mogusii narenge ne chinyomba isano na ibere buna ekobwatia. Chinyomba echio nigo chire: [I]. Mogusero: Mosinto Omogusii omomura omonene, nigo arenge korokwa Mogusero. Mogusero nigo aiboretwe n' omongina Mokeira Bwari, oyio orenge oyomo bw abangina batano b' Mogusii. Omomura oyo Mogusero nere otang'ete komena egesero mogondo! Komenta nayio, Mogusero nere naende togotebigwa orenge korokwa Sereti. Abana b' Mogusii nigo barenge buna ekobwatia: Ase okounenkia omogano oyo oito, temanyekanetie gose Mogusero ere nayorete enyomba yaye buna Monyaribari gose Mobasi, konyora atarasira gose nigo asirete bogesi. Nonya nabo igo, ekero tokobwatia abana ba Mogetutu, Abagusero mbareo. Omwana oyo o' Mogetutu okorokwa Mogusero nabo erabe ng'a nigo nigo aetwe erieta ria ise moke [ Mogusero oyio konyora osiriore magega ]. [II]. Omogetutu: Ase abana ba Mogusii baria baigete kwamboka korwa Egesumu gocha ase ebitunwa bia Gusii na gochia motwe, Mogetutu nere omomura omonene. Omogetutu gose Mogetutu Mw' Nyakundi ere nigo arogetwe iga korwa ase omongina Mogoisera oyio otamete. Bono Mogoisera nigo arenge otare konyora bamura. Ekabetereria ng'a omongina Mogoisera [ mosubati omwabo Gichana ] goika anywome omoiseke oyio oramonyorere omwana. Ekero omosubati oyo anyora omwana, akamonengeta ng'a " Na aganto g' Enkundi...Agatutu". Omwana oyio akarokwa Mogetutu Mwanyakundi. [III]. Mogirango: Mogirango ere nigo arogetwe iga ase engecho y' omongina Bwoisera ore koanga koria engo koyaitirwe. Omongina oyo ere nigo are kogira na gokana pi pi pi buna takoria engo. Gachia konyora omwana bakamoroka buna Gendabu Mw' Mogirango Okogira Engo. Bono aba bakarokwa Abagirango gose "Bakogira engo". [IV]. Monyaribari: Nyaribari amagenga rende barabuo ninki barokeretwe iga? Abamura ba Nyaribari abagaka na abana babo kibare kogenda esegi yo oroari rwa Sigisi na Gusii nigo bare gotanga Mosigisi taira chiombe chia Gusii bakarokwa Nyaribari Amangenga. [V]. Mobasi: Ababasi nigo baitete eng'era na koyebasa korwa omogongo rika bare koyenyenya korwa ritana. Bakarokwa Ababasi. [VI]. Momachoge: Abamachoge rende? Omwana omoiseke Bwoisera akagenda Bomachoge rinani ime. Buna togotebigwa, eng'oge ekamonyoria omwana akarokwa Machoge Osweta Ngoge. [VII]. Monchari: Bonchari na abana b' omosubati o Mogusii orenge korokwa Kebenchari. Omosubati oyo Kebenchari nigo asogete Bogere, korende magega yaye akairana nka Gusii. Ororeria rw' Kebenchari narwo rokorokwa Abanchari.
english: Omongina Kwamboka Mireri, (Ichuni) Bomobea, Nyaribari Masaba; Omogaka Samuel Omare Nyambisa, (Gesure) Bosansa, Bobasi Chache; Omogaka Kenyanya Marube, (Otamba) Bogeka, Nyaribari Chache; Dated May 26, 2012. The story of Omogusii: These are the words: It happened that when he went to Kisumu, and there was a person from Gusii [ this Nyakomisaro who always likes being praised by Nyakomogendi ] he became angry. After that, he was asked to be circumcised like a child of Gusii in Orechi (the place near Ekegere), and he refused to go to Kisumu. And because of this matter which caused great trouble, it wasn’t understood by Orechi until he agreed to go to Kisumu and carry his belongings, and take his cattle with him, so that he could become angry again. “Kisumu” is also in the Gusii language. We arrived Downtown, City Of Kisumu [Kisumu]. There were many people in Kisumu. People went there in large numbers, Gusii became angry. After that, people and a person from Gusii, [ whose heart is very big Nyakomisaro, who always likes being praised by Nyakomogendi ] became angry. And because of this matter which caused great trouble, it wasn’t decided that the elders of Gusii should meet in Kisumu and discuss things and agree. Orechi did not allow it until he achieved his goal. That is why it was decided that Gusii would not have anything to do with this story and its consequences because it was troublesome. This story is: [I]. Mogusero: The most important elder of Gusii, he always likes being praised by Mogusero. Mogusero was born to Omongina Mokeira Bwari, who has five children of Gusii. This elder Mogusero never forgets about the history of the elders! Remember this, Mogusero will never be forgotten when talking about Sereti. The children of Mogusii are numerous: And considering this matter which caused great trouble, it wasn’t understood by Mogusero until he realized his mistake and apologized to both Monyaribari and Mobasi, and he regretted what had happened and became calm. However, we don’t know the children of Mogetutu, the Abagusero clan. That child of Mogetutu who was praised by Mogusero also said something like this [ Mogusero who regrets his mistakes ]. [II]. Omogetutu: And among the children of Gusii who went to look for work in Kisumu while leaving their homes and families behind, Mogetutu was the most important. Mogetutu and Mogetutu Mw' Nyakundi were given land to cultivate by Omongina Mogoisera who gave it to them. But Mogoisera always liked praising people. It is said that Omongina Mogoisera [ a friend of Gichana ] used to give gifts to those who flattered him and praised the child. Whenever that friend praised the child, he would say “With the power of Enkundi…Agatutu”. That child was praised by Mogetutu Mwanyakundi. [III]. Mogirango: Mogirango was also given land because of the wealth of Omongina Bwoisera so that they could build a home. That family was known for working hard and diligently, especially when building a home. They say that whenever a child is born, they praise him saying Gendabu Mw' Mogirango Okogira Engo. Therefore, those who are praised are called Abagirango meaning “Those who build homes.” [IV]. Monyaribari: Nyaribari asks how many clans are there and where did they come from? The people of Nyaribari, along with their children, often traveled to the forest of Sigisi and Gusii and brought back goods from Sigisi to sell in Gusii and were praised by Nyaribari Amangenga. [V]. Mobasi: The Babasi people are skilled in farming and harvesting crops, and they enjoy sharing with others. They are praised as the Babasi. [VI]. Momachoge: Who are the Bamachoge? A child of Bwoisera goes to Bomachoge very often. When someone is praised, the name of the child who is praised is Machoge Osweta Ngoge. [VII]. Monchari: Bonchari and the children of the clan of Mogusii are always praised by Kebenchari. That clan, Kebenchari, settled in Bogere, and his skills were similar to those of Gusii. The story of Kebenchari is also told by the Abanchari.

english: Kenya number one in safety The Kenyan government has launched a program to promote tourism recovery through safe travel initiatives known as the "Safer Tourism Seal" in collaboration with Rebuilding Travel. Kenya was praised during a virtual event attended by Tourism Minister Najib Balala and representatives from various organizations to launch the initiative which aims to reassure tourists and stakeholders in the tourism sector.
