ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde, oyo o gatato, akabatunyana, ogoteba neriogi rinene, “Omonto karasasime eng’iti eria na omogwekano oye, na kobekwa ekemanyererio ase obosio bwaye igoro, gose ase okoboko kwaye,
english: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and his image and receives his mark on the forehead or on the hand,

ekegusii: Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: But the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

ekegusii: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
english: na Avimu, na Para, na Ofura,

ekegusii: korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo ekero chikonyorekana, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.
english: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

ekegusii: Ning’o oyio okorwa Edomu, oyio okorwa Bosira obegete chianga chimbariri burure, oyio bweboyetie obonene, ogotaara ore ne chinguru chinyinge? “Oyio ninche, ngokwana ase oboronge inde nokobua kw’ogotooria.”
english: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save."

ekegusii: Chimbaba chi’abakerubi baria nigo chiaramboire chikaba nobotambe bw’amaboko emerongo ebere. Abakerubi abwo nigo bateneine namagoro abo, barigereretie gochia Aase Aachenu.
english: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.

ekegusii: Omonene naimoke akore buna akorete ase egetunwa gia Perasimu; nabe nendamwamu buna abete ase Rikura ria Gibeoni; nakore ogokora kwaye kore okogeni, nakore emeremo yaye ere ey’ogokumia.
english: The LORD will rise up as he did at Mount Perazim, he will rouse himself as in the Valley of Gibeon-- to do his work, his strange work, and perform his task, his alien task.

ekegusii: Asare ere ntwanyorete obuya na obotomwa, erio ase engencho y’erieta riaye tworokererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, erinde banyare koba nokoigwera gw’okwengena
english: Through him and for his name's sake, we received grace and apostleship to call people from among all the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.

ekegusii: Erio ngatoma amang’ana gochia asare, nkamoiraneria, “Amang’ana buna ayio tari ay’ekeene, ayio namang’ana ao aye omonyene okorengereria korwa ase enkoro yao na koyaroisia boigo.”
english: I sent him this reply: "Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head."

ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw’omorembe nkobe asare ere, na ase ororeria rwaye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw’obokuani, ekiagera abete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”
english: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites."

ekegusii: Agachia koba ngosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge amo nere, akababoria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
english: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"

ekegusii: Nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, buna naseretie abanto bamino, ororeria rwonsi rw’Efraimu.
english: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your brothers, the people of Ephraim.'

ekegusii: Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.
english: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

ekegusii: They left Rephidim and camped in the Desert of Sinai.
english: Bakarua Refidimu, bakagenda bagaika erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora aroro.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akamochiera Samweli agwo ase egeita, akamotebia, “Koranche ontebie ase omorori amenyete.”
english: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, "Would you please tell me where the seer's house is?"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomoruoti origetie gokora omobaro nabasomba baye.
english: "Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarentera Abaisraeli amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria bagendete koroota, bagateba, “Ense eria twataara ime yaye koyeroota, nigo ere ense egoita abanto bamenyeteo. Abanto bonsi twarora nabatambe mono.
english: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ara rimo naende, engaki enke yatigaire nintengechie igoro chionsi, na ense, na enyancha, amo nense enyomo.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abanto aba onde tarengeo, nonya noyomo, ase baria Musa na Haroni omokuani babarete agwo ase erooro ya Sinai.
english: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

ekegusii: Nigo akonacha ekina kia boronge ase chintakana, na ase ababoraka; ere nigo anchete omomenyi, amoa endagera ne chianga.
english: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the alien, giving him food and clothing.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto onde bwensi ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,
english: "'If a member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD's commands, he is guilty.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inchuo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.
english: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.

ekegusii: Petero akamoboria, “Naki abete mogancherana goteema Omoika bw’Omonene? Rora, amagoro abo abatindeka omosacha oo nao are agwo gesieri, na barabwo nabakobogorie aye gochia isiko.”
english: Peter said to her, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."

ekegusii: “Korende aye nigo gwasemeretie oboseera bwao, erio ogekora omotayayi, ekiagera kwamanyekanete mono, ogekayayia ase abaeti bonsi, ogechwara ase onde bwensi.
english: "'But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.

ekegusii: Tindi gokwana asemore mwensi; nabamanyire aba nachorire, erinde amariko anyare goikeranigwa, ayagoteba: Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereirie egotingiro kiaye igoro asende.
english: "I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture: 'He who shares my bread has lifted up his heel against me.'

ekegusii: Kera omonto asibore abasomba baye Abaibirania, abasacha na abakungu, erinde monto onde tabaisa gokora Omoyahudi, omonto omwabo, abe omosomba.
english: Everyone was to free his Hebrew slaves, both male and female; no one was to hold a fellow Jew in bondage.

ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Yeremia, ninki ekio oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, “Namako amaya, ee namaya mono, na ayande amabe, ee, namabe mono atanyare koriegwa.”
english: Then the LORD asked me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "Figs," I answered. "The good ones are very good, but the poor ones are so bad they cannot be eaten."

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamogoteba ng’a, omote noro iso, ne rigena nario nyoko, nigo morasookigwe. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwantigire na kong’a amagega; timong’onchorereti amasio aino. Korende ekero more nemechando mwabora: Inchuo ototoorie.
english: They say to wood, 'You are my father,' and to stone, 'You gave me birth.' They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, 'Come and save us!'

ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo.
english: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;
english: As for man, his days are like grass, he flourishes like a flower of the field;

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akabomba na koroisia omonto korwa ase orotu rw’amaroba, akamoutera omoika bw’obogima ase chimioro chiaye, na igo omonto akaba ore nobomoyo.
english: the LORD God formed the man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

ekegusii: Yakobo akababoria, “Baminto, ng’ai seino?” Bakamoiraneria, “Seito naiga Harani.”
english: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We're from Haran," they replied.

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia na Sebuna, na Yoa, bagatebia Rabi‐Sake oria, “Koranche kwana naintwe, abasomba bao, ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaik, ekiagera ntoyomanyete; tobaisa gokwana naintwe ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ekero abanto bare ase orwaki igoro bategererete.”
english: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don't speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."

ekegusii: Omoruoti nabe okweumia, na abagambi mbatubwe nomoichano; amaboko ’abanto b’ense eye nabe akoiguswa ase obwoba. Nimbakorere koreng’ana nogokora kwabo; nimbagambie koreng’ana buna barenge kogamba. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

ekegusii: Gaki bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simion, oyokorokwa Petero.
english: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao, na ase obosio bwao abe ekeinyorio kegokoinyoria, erinde ogenderere gokwana amachiko Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nakong’anyetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.
english: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the law of the LORD is to be on your lips. For the LORD brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”
english: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?"

ekegusii: Inchuo morwanie ense eyio korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, moigore ebiage biaye; mobeke ebinto bire imeo amo, bibe buna chitui chi’endagera. Mosirie ense eyio kegima; timobaisa gotigaria nonya negento ekemo.
english: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.

ekegusii: Yeremia akamotebia, “Obwo noborimo, tinkogenda kobwatana n’Abakalidayo.” Korende Iriya tancha koigwa amang’ana a Yeremia. Akamobwata akamoira ase abagambi.
english: "That's not true!" Jeremiah said. "I am not deserting to the Babylonians." But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

ekegusii: gose tare kobatebia ring’ana otatiga ase omoreng’anio, korende agatebereria aborokigwa baye amang’ana onsi bobisi.
english: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo nayaroche ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane kwegera aya onsi agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba, ekero omonto oyomo akogambera omonto onde na komokorera bobe ase okomochanda.
english: All this I saw, as I applied my mind to everything done under the sun. There is a time when a man lords it over others to his own hurt.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase Eleazari, omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abatang’ani abanene, bakabora, “Omonene nachigete Musa ng’a intwe toegwe orogongo ororabe omwando oito ase egati y’abaminto.” Ase ayio bakaegwa omwando ase egati y’abamwabo ise, buna Omonene achigete.
english: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the LORD's command.

ekegusii: Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.
english: Again and again he bursts upon me; he rushes at me like a warrior.

ekegusii: Ning’o asemore ore omong’aini na omomanyi? Ere aorokie ogokora kwaye ase orogendo rwaye oruya, ase obwororo bokorwa ase obong’aini.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

ekegusii: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.
english: na onde bwensi orakune eng’iti ekwagura, eye eramokore abe oyotachenegeti, gose akune omonto oragere abe oyotachenegeti, ogotacheneka kwaye gakorabe okw’engencho ende yonsi.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakagenda bakaroota ense eria, bagachakera korwa ase erooro ya Sini bagaika Rehobu ase enchera ekogenda Hamati.
english: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe mwensi, ngoika ririri moragenderere korwania omonto ore bweka, erinde momoakere inse, inwe mwensi amo, buna nigo are enyasi ere ang’e kogwa na orwaki rwatandokire?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down-- this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

ekegusii: agasemania nabanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abanto baye chituoni batiche chintuboka na batange amache korwa ase chinsoko chiarenge isiko y’omochie, nabarabwo bakamokonya.
english: he consulted with his officials and military staff about blocking off the water from the springs outside the city, and they helped him.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria araike, tibagokwana iga nonya ng’ake: “Abaise babo barire amasabibu amaroro, na amaino ’abana babo abeire nobokang’iti.
english: "In those days people will no longer say, 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge.'

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabatebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?
english: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more important than food, and the body more important than clothes?

ekegusii: Otebie abanto bamenyete ase ense eye ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba igoro y’abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu ase ense y’Abaisraeli: Barabwo mbarie endagera yabo bare nomoichano na mbanywe amache abo bare nobwoba, ekiagera ense yabo nesakorwe na ebinto bionsi bireo, etigwe ere bosa ase engencho y’obobe obwo abanto bareo bakorire.
english: Say to the people of the land: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.

ekegusii: Misiri nigo ekoimokerera igoro buna orooche rwa Naili. Nigo ekoimokerera igoro buna chindooche chiaichoire amache. Misiri eria egateba,” “Ninyimokerere igoro ntube ense, ninsarie na gosiria emechie na abanto bamenyeteo.
english: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, 'I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.'

ekegusii: Petero akamoboria, “Ntebia, igo mwaoonetie omogondo ase rigori erio?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ase rigori erio.”
english: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."

ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a momanye obonene bw’okobua kwaye botari nekerengo, obo bwatoikeire intwe abatwegenire koreng’ana nogokora gw’okobua kwaye okonene.
english: and his incomparably great power for us who believe. That power is like the working of his mighty strength,

ekegusii: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses
english: ne chiganchwa chi’emeyega, ne chigoti chi’okwambara, na ebiambaro bi’amareko, na emebuko ya koboko,

ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabatebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”
english: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."

ekegusii: Narorire ng’a ring’ana eri nerigiya ase engencho y’emechando eye tore nero, ng’a mbuya omonto abe buna are.
english: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for you to remain as you are.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya kobeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.
english: But the LORD said to my father David, 'Because it was in your heart to build a temple for my Name, you did well to have this in your heart.

ekegusii: Omonene agatoma Musa, omosomba oye, na Haroni, oyio konya achorire.
english: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

ekegusii: Korende ase Abaisraeli, nonya nesese tegokogera omonto gose etugo. Erio momanye ng’a Omonene okorire ogwatananeka ase Abamisiri na Abaisraeli.
english: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any man or animal.' Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omoruoti nigo aangete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bakamotebia, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
english: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse's son? To your tents, O Israel! Look after your own house, O David!" So the Israelites went home.

ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonyuomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.
english: which is like a bridegroom coming forth from his pavilion, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

ekegusii: Emegondo negorwe chibesa, na okobwatana gw’okoyegora korikwe, erinde amarieta arikwe na kobekwa ekemanyererio, na okobwatana koria komumekerigwe ase birori bare. Ayio nigo arakoreke ase orogongo rwa Benjamin, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, na ase emechie y’Abayuda, na ase emechie ere ase ense y’ebigoro na ase ense omweya, na ase emechie ya Negebu. Ning’iranie abanto boosetwe bache ase ense yabo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Fields will be bought for silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed and witnessed in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, because I will restore their fortunes, declares the LORD."

ekegusii: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.
english: Bakarua Tera, bakagenda bagaika Mitika, bagatoora aroro.

ekegusii: ab’eamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;
english: From the descendants of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui and Manasseh.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia ase omwaka o ikomi bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Omwaka oyio nigo orenge omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, amo noyominto Timotheo nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto amo nabachenu bonsi abare ase ense yonsi y’Akaya.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:

ekegusii: Sulemani konya oroisirie egetenenero korwa ase etaai; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atano, na konya okebekire gati y’eraaro enene; agatenena igoro ase kerokio. Erio agatung’ama namaru aye bosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,
english: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

ekegusii: Chiise koriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio inakebe okogechia, tikegwancherwa.
english: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, enkoro yane nigo ekoreera Abamoabu neriogi buna eri’obokano, nkoreera nde aba Kiri‐Heresi ase omoyo one ime.
english: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakonagoetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.
english: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

ekegusii: Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Ibrahimu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.
english: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

ekegusii: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.
english: Nonya naboigo gwatotigire na gotosookia, tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

ekegusii: “Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achikire,
english: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the LORD has commanded:

ekegusii: Erio nyuma y’emiaka etato ngatiira kogenda Yerusalemu gokwania Kefa, nkamenya amo nere amatuko ikomi na atano.
english: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Peter and stayed with him fifteen days.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akana‐kogenderera korera asare ase amatuko aria atano na abere omoyega ogendererete. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Samison akamotebia engencho y’omobayeno oria, ekiagera omokungu oria amobetereretie bokong’u. Erio omokungu oria agatebia abanto baria ba sobo engencho yaye.
english: She cried the whole seven days of the feast. So on the seventh day he finally told her, because she continued to press him. She in turn explained the riddle to her people.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.
english: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, you are looking for me, not because you saw miraculous signs but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

ekegusii: Omwana oria gakinire, ekaba rituko erimo akagenda ase ise ase abanto barenge kogesa,
english: The child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the reapers.

ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiko, na emeroberio echikire, Omonene, Nyasae oino, anchigete imborokererie, erinde moyaigwere na koyakora ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
english: These are the commands, decrees and laws the LORD your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba bane: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel-- four in all.

ekegusii: Bakaria, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere.
english: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna ase engencho y’omonto oyomo ebibe bigasoa ase ense, na ase engencho y’ebibe amakweri, naboigo amakweri agaikera abanto bonsi, ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe.
english: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all men, because all sinned--

ekegusii: Buucha amache oyagache, ekiagera noche koboerwa, okong’ie chiburi chiao. Soa ase engoro, otiringe esike, bwebeke ang’e obombe amatabori.
english: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

ekegusii: Ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane komanya obong’aini na korora emeremo emekong’u abanto bagokora aiga ase ense, batari korara chitoro omobaso gose obotuko.
english: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe man's labor on earth-- his eyes not seeing sleep day or night--

ekegusii: Rora, rituko ria rero nkorusia nde chingataare echio ase amaboko ao, nagosiboire. Korarore ng’a mbuya ogende amo nainche Babeli, inchuo togende, nainche ninkorende buya mono. Korende korarore ng’a tari buya kogenda amo nainche Babeli, tobaisa kogenda. Rigereria ense yonsi nigo ere ase obosio bwao; genda aase orarore are buya na boronge asore.”
english: But today I am freeing you from the chains on your wrists. Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don't come. Look, the whole country lies before you; go wherever you please."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarenta chifeta ne chitahabu chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena; ne chibao chi’emecharake chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
english: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

ekegusii: Ekero Farao abeire ang’e kobaikeera, Abaisraeli bakerigereria, bakarora Abamisiri bakobabwatia korwa nyuma. Erio agwo barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene, bakarera ase Omonene.
english: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Baasa aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatiga kogita omochie o Rama, na emeremo yaye aroro egatenena.
english: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

ekegusii: Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amache.
english: He bestows rain on the earth; he sends water upon the countryside.

ekegusii: Akamorentera echio chionsi, agatandora kera eyemo chimbaara ibere, akabeka kera orobaara rogachikana norwamwabo, korende chinyoni chirochio tachitandora.
english: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.

ekegusii: “Enyomba eye ere nogosikwa na obonene, korende ekero ekio kera omonto orabe ogoeta naichanigwe na gokumia, naende aborie: Nase ki Omonene akorire aya ase ense eye, na ase enyomba eye?
english: And though this temple is now so imposing, all who pass by will be appalled and say, 'Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?'

ekegusii: Reuben akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokaanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”
english: Reuben replied, "Didn't I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn't listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."

ekegusii: Nigo barenge buna chibarasi chiaragerigwe buya chire nokogania, kera omonto akaba okogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oye.”
english: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man's wife.

ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y’amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: But you have turned from the way and by your teaching have caused many to stumble; you have violated the covenant with Levi," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Sara akabora, “Nyasae onkoreire amaseko, na onde bwensi orayaigwe nansegisie.”
english: Sarah said, "God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me."

ekegusii: Naboigo enyomba yaye y’okomenya yaagachetwe magega y’enyomba eria y’ebina, egwekaine neyio. Naende Sulemani akaagachera mokaye, mosubati o Farao, enyomba egwekaine eria yaye.
english: And the palace in which he was to live, set farther back, was similar in design. Solomon also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had married.

ekegusii: Yoshua konya oeire Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, na kera oyomo akagenda koira omwando oye ase ense eria.
english: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.

ekegusii: Korwa ase rituko erio Daudi agakora ring’ana erio rikaba ogochika ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo rire nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.

ekegusii: “Oegwe ebiegwa korwa ase Helidai na Tobia, na Yedaya, abanto abwo bairane korwa Babeli ase barenge abasomba. Ase rituko erio erio ogende ase enyomba ya Yosia, mosinto o Sefania, ase basoete.
english: "Take [silver and gold] from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

ekegusii: Ekero barabwo baikire ase ekeooreri kia Nakoni, chiombe chiarenge kong’usa egari eria chikarichanigwa. Ase igo Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae.
english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okomeka‐meka oichire nobonene kogocha korwa ase ebitunwa bi’ababisa kwabuire.
english: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

ekegusii: "Be careful," Jesus said to them. "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.
english: He went on: "What comes out of a man is what makes him 'unclean.'

ekegusii: Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari nokomanya?
english: Of what use is money in the hand of a fool, since he has no desire to get wisdom?

ekegusii: Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.
english: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,

ekegusii: Nonya ayio onsi abete, Yeroboamu taonchogete korwa ase chinchera chiaye chimbe, korende akagenderera kobeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa korwa ase egati y’abanto bande bonsi. Omonto onde bwensi arigetie, nigo amwatananete koba omokuani bw’aase aria aimokererete igoro.
english: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.

ekegusii: Abanto bagatebia Daudi ng’a Uria tagendete bwoye. Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Tikwarwete ase orogendo? Nase ki otagendete bwoo?”
english: When David was told, "Uriah did not go home," he asked him, "Haven't you just come from a distance? Why didn't you go home?"

ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”
english: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, "I tell you the truth, one of you is going to betray me."

ekegusii: erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”
english: They say, "The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed."

ekegusii: Naboigo Saitani karaatananeke ere omonyene, oboruoti bwaye naki boratenene? Naki inwe iga mogoteba ng’a nigo ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli.
english: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebub.

ekegusii: erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekina ki’ogokwa.
english: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."

ekegusii: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
english: Gose karamosabe enswe, namoe eng’iti?

ekegusii: Tomera omogambi bw’ense ebango ye chimanwa chie ching’ondi korwa ase omochie o Sela, goetera ase erooro, gochia ase egetunwa ki’omochie o Sayoni.
english: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of the Daughter of Zion.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.
english: You armed me with strength for battle; you made my adversaries bow at my feet.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akagenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani, gati ya Beteli na Ai,
english: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Omonene one, ntegerera! Oboremo obwo bwe rigori rie chisekeli chi’efeta amagana ane, ngento ki toengereranie inche naye? Tindeka mokao agwo.”
english: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between me and you? Bury your dead."

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
english: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

ekegusii: “Ribebe ria irianyi richakere korwa Tamari, rigenderere goikera ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba; korwa agwo rigenderere kobwatia akarooche ka Misiri, ritwomere Enyancha Enene. Erio nario rirabe ribebe ria irianyi.
english: "On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi [of Egypt] to the Great Sea. This will be the south boundary.

ekegusii: Nyasae ekero abogetie Omosomba oye, akamotoma asemore ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”
english: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti konya aremigwe nyuma y’ogokwa kw’Amunoni, akaba namaiga korora Abisalomu.
english: And the spirit of the king longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon's death.

ekegusii: Omwando oito oeirwe abanto abaao, chinyomba chiaito chiaeirwe abamenyi.
english: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, our homes to foreigners.

ekegusii: na nkaba ngechete Esau na ngasaria ense yaye y’ebitunwa ekaba erooro, na omwando oye nkaa chisese chi’orosana chikamenyao.”
english: but Esau I have hated, and I have turned his mountains into a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Buna omote bw’omosabibu ore ase egati y’emete ende ere ase rinani orauterwe omorero oyie, naboigo ndatugute abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.
english: For in his own eyes he flatters himself too much to detect or hate his sin.

ekegusii: Nabaake noborwaire borakoore obogima, na obw’esosera, na obw’okobimbia omobere; narente riberera ri’egurugura entindi, na oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino. Amaakwa ayio nababwatie goika abasirie kegima.
english: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, with blight and mildew, which will plague you until you perish.

ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie enyomba eye obotuko na omobaso aase aiga aye gwatebete igoro yaye: Erieta riane naribeere aroro. Ase ayio oigwe ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, ngosaba ndigereretie aase aiga.
english: May your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, this place of which you said, 'My Name shall be there,' so that you will hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete oboronge, na kogechete ogosaria; ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo, ogoakire amaguta, korenteire omogoko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteba ng’a engaki teraika ang’e tokoagacha chinyomba; omochie oyo nenyanyeni ekoiyeka, na intwe nechinyama.
english: They say, 'Will it not soon be time to build houses? This city is a cooking pot, and we are the meat.'

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire: “Inche nigo inde amo nainwe mbatoorie, ninsirie kegima ebisaku bionsi, ebio ase nabasiarerete gochia, korende inwe tinkobasiria kegima. Nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia ase oboronge, tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake timbaa egesusuro.”
english: I am with you and will save you,' declares the LORD. 'Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only with justice; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.'

ekegusii: Na ekero engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba yaigete, nkaimoka korwa aase aria naikaransete inyekeetie, imbegete chianga na omwambaro one otandogete, erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarambora amaboko aane gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae one,
english: Then, at the evening sacrifice, I rose from my self-abasement, with my tunic and cloak torn, and fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the LORD my God

ekegusii: goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.
english: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand offered them a kiss of homage,

ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng’ake.
english: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.

ekegusii: Abande ase okomoteema bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
english: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

ekegusii: Korende ase obokong’u bwao na ankoro yao etari nokoonchoka, kwegacheire endamwamu ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu, ekero ekina kia boronge kia Nyasae kerache koorokigwa,
english: But because of your stubbornness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of God's wrath, when his righteous judgment will be revealed.

ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteba, “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.”
english: Some, however, made fun of them and said, "They have had too much wine."

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamotebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”
english: "Take away the stone," he said. "But, Lord," said Martha, the sister of the dead man, "by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days."

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tebia omoruoti o Turo ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Enkoro yao yeimokereirie igoro, aye nigo ogoteba: Inche nigo inde Nyasae, nigo ing’ikaransete ase ekerogo kia Nyasae ase egati y’enyancha. Korende aye nigo ore mwanyabanto rioka, tori Nyasae, nonya kwarengereirie ase enkoro yao ng’a nigo ore Nyasae.
english: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'In the pride of your heart you say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas." But you are a man and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.

ekegusii: Inche nabeereire ang’e kogwa, na obororo bwane nigo bogendererete kobeera asende.
english: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

ekegusii: Naende omokungu oye o sere‐sere, ore korokwa Reuma, akamoiborera Teba, na Gahamu, na Tahasi, na Maaka.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maacah.

ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”
english: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me."

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria abasomba ba Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu, bakanaaria omochie bwonsi,
english: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,

ekegusii: Aye okabaa Omoika oo omuya koborokereria; tikwabarinete mana baare koria, naende nigo kwabaete amache baare konywa ekero barenge nerang’o.
english: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.

ekegusii: Ng’ai chinyasae chia Hamati na Aripadi chire? Inee! Chinyasae chia Sefariwaimu, ng’ai chire? Chiatooririe ense ya Samaria korwa ase okoboko kwane?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

ekegusii: Abanto abaare abaango bakaegwa amarube korwa ase omoruoti na abagambi b’oboruoti, bakayaira ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli na ey’Abayuda, bagateba buna bachigetwe nomoruoti, bagateba, “Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere Omonene, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli, erio nere nabairanere inwe aba more abatigari mwatoorekire korwa ase amaboko ’abaruoti b’Abaasuri.
english: At the king's command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: "People of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiko.
english: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth--

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mokourereria chinyomba chi’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria mwasaba ogosaba ogotambe. Ase ayio, inamonyore ekina ekere ekenene kobua.]
english: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You take advantage of widows and rob them of their homes, and then make a show of saying long prayers! Because of this your punishment will be all the worse! [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Mark 12:40.]

ekegusii: Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abamentekanie ara elifu, mobe abange goetania buna more bono, naende abasesenie buna abarierete eira.
english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times and bless you as he has promised!

ekegusii: Erio Abalawi aba bakaimoka: Mahati, mosinto bw’Amasai, na Yoeli, mosinto bw’Asaria, be chiamate chi’Abakohati; na korwa ase chiamate chia Merari: Kisi, mosinto bw’Abidi, na Asaria, mosinto o Yehaleleli; na korwa ase chiamate chia Gerisoni: Yoah, mosinto o Sima, na Edeni, mosinto o Yoa.
english: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;

ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo kera omonto akarusia eanga yaye akayiaara ase ebiriinero, ayetache. Erio bakabugia ebitureri biabo, bakararia, “Yehu nere omoruoti!”
english: They hurried and took their cloaks and spread them under him on the bare steps. Then they blew the trumpet and shouted, "Jehu is king!"

ekegusii: Nonya mwasiareretwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabasangererie korwao,
english: Even if you have been banished to the most distant land under the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you and bring you back.

ekegusii: “Aye ense, toiroka! Aye orogongo, goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.
english: Be not afraid, O land; be glad and rejoice. Surely the LORD has done great things.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire ng’a ase omenyete abanto nigo bagokora oborianania ase oborianania bonde. Na obong’ainereria ase obong’ainereria bonde, bangire konyigwera.
english: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
english: Ninkore ab’enyomba y’Ahabu buna ab’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, na buna ab’enyomba ya Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya.

ekegusii: Yakobo akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria, akarora Esau ogocha amo nabanto amagana ane. Erio agaatanana abana, akaa kera omokungu abaye, Lea, na Raeli, na abakungu baria babere abasomba.
english: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two maidservants.

ekegusii: Inche ninkoe ebigorero bi’oboruoti bwa igoro, na ande onsi orasibe ase ense nabe asibirwe na igoro, na ande onsi orasibore ase ense nabe asiboirwe na igoro.”
english: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."

ekegusii: Hamu, ise Kanani, akamorora ore getirianda, agatebia bamura bamwabo babere barenge isiko amang’ana aya aroche.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae, oyore Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: “Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya, erio moyararie ase ororeria rwa Yakobo.
english: "Hear this and testify against the house of Jacob," declares the Lord, the LORD God Almighty.

ekegusii: Rigena neririto na omokenye nomorito, korende okogechigwa kw’omonto omoriri nigo kore okorito kobua ebinto ebio bibere.
english: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but provocation by a fool is heavier than both.

ekegusii: na amo na kera emanwa emingichi, obosie ebimunu bibere. Ebing’wanso ebio bi’ogosambwa nigo bire okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.
english: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Ninde nokobua gw’okogokorera amabe, korende Nyasae o iso nakwanete nainche ase obotuko bwaetete, agantebia: Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.
english: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, 'Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.'

ekegusii: onye titori abegenwa, ere nigo are omwegenwa, ekiagera takonyara gwekana ere omonyene.
english: if we are faithless, he will remain faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotanga omokungu buna oyio, okwo nigo konga ogotangwa kw’omwaga gose okobwata amaguta nokoboko gw’okorio.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.

ekegusii: Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
english: I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende babe aberendete ase onsi, abachenu, abagokora emeremo ase chinka chiabo, abaya, abaigwerete abasacha babo abanyene, erinde ring’ana ria Nyasae tiriramwa.
english: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo twarengerererie ng’a: Kerabe babe bagokwana igo asetore, gose ase abana b’ororeria rwaito, nabanyare kobairaneria: Rora, chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagachete egesasimero keng’ana buna eki’Omonene. Eke tikeri ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende, otatiga kere kirori egati yaito nainwe.
english: "And we said, 'If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the LORD's altar, which our fathers built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.'

ekegusii: na timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria nakorete nainwe. Timobaisa koiroka chinyasae chinde ching’ao,
english: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene ndiigugwe bosio bw’omoganda oye bw’esegi, ekiagera omoganda oye bw’esegi nigo ore omonene mono; echio chigoikerania amang’ana aye, nigo chire ne chinguru. Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ning’o oranyare koriremereria?
english: The LORD thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty are those who obey his command. The day of the LORD is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

ekegusii: Korwa Egiloni Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira, bagaika Heburoni bayorwanie.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aba ng’ina rome bagakwana amang’ana ayio ase abanto ba Sekemu ase ogokonya Abimeleki, na bonsi bakang’uswa bakaba ase ensemo yaye, naende bagateba ng’a ere nere orenge oyomwabo.
english: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."

ekegusii: Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”
english: If a person carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, oil or other food, does it become consecrated?'" The priests answered, "No."

ekegusii: Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe natogwekane nere, ekiagera natomorore buna are.
english: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when he appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

ekegusii: Oyore egetare kiabo natame ore nomoondoko omonge; na abakogamba amo nere mbatame ase okogoswa ekero bararore ebendera y’esegi.” Omonene, oyio omorero oye ore ase Sayoni, na ekebemberi kiaye ki’omorero kere Yerusalemu, otebire amang’ana ayio.
english: Their stronghold will fall because of terror; at sight of the battle standard their commanders will panic," declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nomoerio; korende koborabeo obobani, nabosire; kerabe emenwa, neere; gochirabe chisemi, nachisire.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

ekegusii: bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na ebikorero ebichenu bionsi biarenge ime ase Eema eria; abakuani Abalawi nabwo babirentete.
english: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests, who were Levites, carried them up;

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nabe buna obwebiso ekero omwaga okogusa, na buna ekeigamero ekero embura y’omoubera egotwa; boigo mbabe buna chindooche chire ase ense enyomo, na buna ekiriri ki’egetare ekenene ase ense etari namache.
english: Each man will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.

ekegusii: Bwatia enchera; rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana.
english: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

ekegusii: Naende ochore omoraai oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku agokonye gwatanana ense eria.”
english: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.

ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.
english: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ekero oyomo bw’abanto aba, gose omobani, gose omokuani, arakoborie: Egurube y’Omonene nereri? Obairanerie, obatebie: Ninwe egurube yaye, ere nabaserie morueo.
english: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, 'What is the oracle of the LORD?' say to them, 'What oracle? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.'

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia emanwa y’eng’ondi ekogonka, akayerua ase Omonene ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ekegima, agasabera Abaisraeli ase Omonene, na Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye.
english: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it up as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on Israel's behalf, and the LORD answered him.

ekegusii: Tinabachorete inwe korwa ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli mobe abakuani baane, na morue ebing’wanso ase egesasimero kiane, naende mosambe ubani na mobe mokobeka egesibao ki’obokuani komogocha ase obosio bwane? Tinaete abanto b’ororeria rwa sokororia yao baire ebing’wanso bionsi Abaisraeli baare gosamba nomorero?
english: I chose your father out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your father's house all the offerings made with fire by the Israelites.

ekegusii: Omonene akaanga chinderia chionsi chi’Abaisraeli, akabaa egesusuro, akababeka ase amaboko ’abasakori goika akabaseria korwa ase obosio bwaye kegima.
english: Therefore the LORD rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.

ekegusii: Goetera asare twaigoreirwe enchera ase okwegena goikera ase obuya obo toteneine ime yaye, naende nigo tokogoka ase ogosemeria kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.
english: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.

ekegusii: goika chianga na ebitambaa ebiakunete omobere oye bikairwa ase abarwaire, na igo bakagwenigwa amarwaire abo, na ebirecha ebibe bikarua asebare.
english: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

ekegusii: Ninsirie kegima omogoko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echikire.
english: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days-- all her appointed feasts.

ekegusii: ab’egesaku gi’Aseri chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Nafutali chilifu ikomi na ibere. Ab’egesaku kia Manase chilifu ikomi na ibere,
english: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,

ekegusii: “Ase ayio omocharake oria ogakina, Ogatambea ogaetania emete yonsi ye rinani, chinsagia chiaye chikamentekana, na ebisagia biaye bigatambea, ase engencho y’amache amange arengeo akayokinia.
english: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu na Asuri, Arifakisadi na Ludi, Aramu na Usi, Huli na Geteri, na Mesheki.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshech.

ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.
english: He makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Onye moganetie gotooria obogima bwaino, mwerende, timobaisa kobogoria egurube ende yonsi ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose koyesoyia ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase rituko erio.
english: This is what the LORD says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’abwo Benjamin na Hasubu bakaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yabo. Oyobwatetie abwo, n’Asaria, mosinto o Maaseya bw’Anania; ere akaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yaye.
english: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.

ekegusii: “Nabe aase aria barabwo batebetigwe: Inwe timori abanto baane, abwo babarije ababa ba Nyasae ore moyo.”
english: and, "It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' they will be called 'sons of the living God.'"

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato arente ebinto ebio bi’ogochenwa kwaye ase omokuani, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: "On the eighth day he must bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene, rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; inamorie emegati etabekiri memera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: On the fifteenth day of that month the LORD's Feast of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

ekegusii: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
english: ne chingamia chiare gokamwa emerongo etato, amo ne chimori chiabo, ne chiombe chiaberi emerongo ene, ne chintang’ana ikomi, ne chitigere chiaberi emerongo ebere, ne chitigere chinsacha ikomi.

ekegusii: Abwo bamenyete ang’e naye, na abwo bare aare, mbagochecherie aye otari nerieta rigiya, oichire neburuburu.
english: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yuda, chinyasae chiaino nigo chire chinyinge buna emechie yaino ere emenge, na buna chinchera chia Yerusalemu chire chinyinge, naboigo nebisasimero bi’obosooku bire, biria mwaroiseretie Baali, enyasae eria mogosambera ubani.
english: You have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.'

ekegusii: Ayio naro amachiko na emeroberio Omonene achigete Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa, agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ang’e na Yorodan, Kororia Yeriko.
english: These are the commands and regulations the LORD gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

ekegusii: What can I say for you? With what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may comfort you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? Your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can heal you?
english: Aye omochie o Yerusalemu, ninki ndagotebie? Ninki ndakoreng’anie? Mang’ana ki anga buna ayao ndagotebie, erinde nkoremie, aye Sayoni ore buna omoiseke omwekungi? Ogosarigwa kwao nokonene buna enyancha ere enene, ning’o oranyare gokogwenia?

ekegusii: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one."
english: Bonsi bachiire bogeka, bonsi babeire bosa; onde tari oyogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

ekegusii: Na omokungu oria atancheti moche komo, rirorio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eye okoria asende, korende tobaisa koira omwana one gochia aroro.”
english: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there."

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwao bwonsi, omonto tari orakobue. Buna narenge amo na Musa, naboigo ndabe amo naye, tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake.
english: No one will be able to stand up against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

ekegusii: Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.
english: From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.

ekegusii: Naki amariko nigo agoteba ase Farao, “Nigo nagotenenetie, erinde nyorokie okobua kwane asore, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.”
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."

ekegusii: Endagera chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.
english: What the locust swarm has left the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left other locusts have eaten.

ekegusii: (Bakamotebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).
english: "'Sir,' they said, 'he already has ten!'

ekegusii: Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.
english: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia Beteli, bakaba bakorera ase obosio bw’Omonene goika mogoroba, bakamoboria, “Natonyare naende kogenda korwana n’Ababenjamin abanto baminto?” Omonene akairaneria, “Genda, mobarwanie!”
english: The Israelites went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and they inquired of the LORD. They said, "Shall we go up again to battle against the Benjamites, our brothers?" The LORD answered, "Go up against them."

ekegusii: bagoteba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui, oyoreo na oyokwarengeo, twagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwabogoirie okobua kwao okonene, na gwachakire kogamba.
english: saying: "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.

ekegusii: Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni, nabeire nkona‐gotererera emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

ekegusii: Twaigure igoro y’oboenenu bw’Abamoabu; nigo bare abaenenu mono. Twaigure buna beimokereirie igoro, na buna bagwekaga na koba nobomwenu, na buna bare ne chinkoro chi’obwerori.
english: "We have heard of Moab's pride-- her overweening pride and conceit, her pride and arrogance and the haughtiness of her heart.

ekegusii: Tiga chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare asende, ase obuya bwao inyorokererie amachiko ao.
english: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me through your law.

ekegusii: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth
english: Beti‐Peori amo nebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga, na Beti‐Yesimoti;

ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Disoni: Hemudani, na Esibani, na Itirani, na Kerani.
english: The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

ekegusii: Yoashi agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi, ekiagera Yehoyada omokuani abete okomosemia.
english: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, na ebere, ekero abete omoruoti, akagamba emiaka etano na etato, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

ekegusii: Korende timobaboria borokie omobaro bwe chibesa chirabekwe ase amaboko abo, ekiagera nigo barachikorere emeremo ase obwegenwa.”
english: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are acting faithfully."

ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde ase ensemo yaino, nimbairanere, inwe namoremwe na kobusurwa.
english: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,

ekegusii: Onde bwensi moraabere inwe, nainche nimwabere. Eke naabeire omonto, onye namwabeire egento igo namwabeire ase engencho yaino ase obosio bwa Kristo,
english: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And what I have forgiven-- if there was anything to forgive-- I have forgiven in the sight of Christ for your sake,

ekegusii: Naboigo bagoosa Loti, omwana omomura omwabo Aburamu, oyomenyete agwo Sodomu, bakamoira amo nenibo yaye.
english: They also carried off Abram's nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakoumora chitahabu korwa emebuko yabo na korenga chifeta nekerengero, erio baakanera omoturi bw’etahabu, nere oyeroisia yaba enyasae, na abanto abwo batung’ama bosio bw’enyasae eyio bayesasima.
english: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.

ekegusii: Yeso konya omanyire aya, akarua aroro. Abanto abange bakamotunyana, akabagwenia bonsi.
english: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Many followed him, and he healed all their sick,

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo barenge abanene naende abatambe buna Abaanaki; boigo nigo barenge abange. Korende Omonene akabasiria, na Abaamoni bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.
english: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamoboria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabatebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”
english: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."

ekegusii: Bagatiira, bakagenda ritang’ani ase ensemo ya irianyi y’ense eria, na bagaika Heburoni, agwo ase Ahimani, na Sesai, na Talimai, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki, bamenyete. (Heburoni konya oagachirwe emiaka etano na ebere ritang’ani omochie o Soani o Misiri otaraagachwa.)
english: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Egetare kiane na Omobooria one, anchera amang’ana aane na ebirengererio bire ase enkoro yane.
english: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

ekegusii: Omoruoti ogokora ay’oboronge nigo akogera ense yaye yagenderera gotenena bokong’u, korende oyo okorigia amaaki nigo akoyeiyeria.
english: By justice a king gives a country stability, but one who is greedy for bribes tears it down.

ekegusii: Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b’abanto aba buna nakorerete ab’amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past," declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chi’Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora amabe.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I have not done evil by turning from my God.

Korende enchiri ngoteba ere. Nonya ne miaka chiribu nyuma yebikoro ebio bigotebererwa (sirika AD 30–33), genda magega ase amangana a kare gose ase ogobwatia ogokoro.3 Naboigo amangana aya a kare tabwati amangana amange ayio are rirube riengencho ria Paulo. Ekio naki gekogera twateba nga ngogenda ere magega mono ogochaka ogotangani okuo kwabwatetu nakogachwa.4 “Ringana rio okobokigwa gwa kristo ne ringana rie engencho mono gochi ase abakeresito:Kobokigwa gotaiyo,Nto bwati gosemeria gwo okoborigwa kwe ebibe biaito (1 Abakorinto 15:12–18)”. Ekanisa entangani Okobokigwa ngoteberera kore ase chinchera inye (gwachagete AD 67–855) ngotebwa bire buna nigo bire ebiogotantania, korende ebinge bioogatantani mbirio ao nainde buna torakagere ase chingencho echi inye chingao chie egento emaiaka emenge nyuma yo okoba. Nigo bire ne binto ebinge buna nongo orosetie omoganda bwa abakungu abwo bachiete ase rikuruma, nga amaraika na abere arenge ao gose nerimo nakogenderera. Ebinge bie ebi mbiri bio ogotantani, buna bitamentiri aroro, ase ekio orokererio; ekemo ngetebe rimo nga riraika riakwanete, naboigo ekeorokererio ekende getebe nga’ amaraika nonsi akwanete. Nebe ogotantania onye ekeo rokererio gegoteba riraika erimo rioka. Nkorenta ere engencho nga abasacha baarigete baarigete amangana aya nabo barainyore amangana amangao nonya gakororekana amangana amange ase otebia kwabo kwe ebinto biakorekanete. Teri korenta engencho goteba nga’ ase engencho ya abakungu bare ase erisiti, Kobokigwa ngokorekaneti bi.6 Naboigo, okobokigwa kwo obobui ngaange kware koba ase enchera etakageire ase emeganda emetangani ya abayaudi bare gocha goteba rikuruma ritabwati kende. Abayaudi abatangani mbaegenete mono igoro yo obogima nyuma yobonde, abande mbaegenete okobokigwa, nabende tibaegenete (buna abasadusesi (Mathayo 22:23). Nabande mbaegenete nga mbande babo bara bokigwe; korende onde tari ase abayuda baegenete nga’omonto oyomo narenge gochi kobokigwa nyuma ya onde bwensi. Eke nakio kiagerete abaorokigwa batabwate bomanyi bonde bwenshi igoro yeki yeso are goteba ekero abanete ogokwa kwaye naboigo nokobokig. Ebimanyererio bio okobokigwa gwa kristo gochia ase aba orokigwa baye Ebimanyererio mbireo nga,krwa omochakano bwe orogendo rwa abakristo, Okobokigwa gwa kristo ngwatumegete gosomia keria abaorokigwa baye baraetere ase okobokigwa. Ase 1 Abathesaloniki 4:13–18, Paulo nkorwa are ekemanyererio igoro yo okobokigwa; Ntwegenete nga yeso nakwete naboigo akaboka naende naboigo ntwegenete nga nyasae narente na yeso baria bakwete amo nere. Igo okobokigwa kwa yeso nkoba kore engencho yo okobokigwa kwa abakeresto ekero arache. Ase abaibiribi Philippians 3:20–21, nkomanya tore nga okobokigwa kwe emebere yaito nebe buna oria o yeso kristo. english: While we wait for the blessed hope—the glorious appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ (Titus 2:13)—let us also be eager, with a great expectation, for the fulfillment of the Christian faith.1 The basis for this waiting is the promise of resurrection, which is central to Christianity: Resurrection guarantees that we will not experience permanent death because of our sins (1 Corinthians 15:12–18). Important background information This waiting is based on certainty, and it involves understanding certain things, namely, how the beliefs of Christians were established during the time of this waiting. This matter is discussed in 1 Thessalonians; specifically, Paul's account of his visit, which occurred around AD 50.2 Several years after the crucifixion of Christ. The purpose was to encourage believers who were being persecuted and to remind them of the promises; and also to ensure that those promises remain valid. Continue reading this chapter to understand more. After about three years following these events (approximately AD 30–33), there began to spread the teachings of the earlier apostles.3 However, these earlier teachings did not contradict the later teachings of Paul. This is why we can confidently say that they both convey the same message regarding the essential truths.4 “The foundation of the hope of Christ and the foundation of everything else for Christians: Resurrection guarantees that we will not experience permanent death because of our sins (1 Corinthians 15:12–18).” The early church This waiting was understood by the leaders (who lived from approximately AD 67–855) to mean that some things would happen, while others would not occur until much later, and these latter matters were often misunderstood. These things included the persecution of rulers, along with angels and messengers who claimed to have revelations. Some of these claims were true, but most were false; and the false revelations often lacked credibility. Nevertheless, the truth remained clear despite these distortions. Therefore, let us diligently examine what the teachers teach, ensuring that their teachings align with the fundamental principles and do not introduce innovations that contradict established doctrines. There should be no teaching that contradicts the teachings of the apostles, for the resurrection is at the heart of our faith.6 Moreover, this waiting has been likened to a man who entrusted his property to servants while he traveled abroad, expecting them to manage it responsibly during his absence. The Jewish leaders questioned John the Baptist about his identity and authority, seeking confirmation that he was indeed the expected messenger. They also debated whether they should believe in Jesus, questioning whether He had come to fulfill their expectations (as suggested by the Sadducees – Matthew 22:23). And they questioned whether they should accept Him based on His own merits, because the Jews did not recognize Him as the Messiah until after the events unfolded. But now, let those who are resurrected testify to the abundance of life that Jesus offers, and let this testimony lead others to believe in Him. The beliefs surrounding Christ's return concern those who are awaiting it. These beliefs include the hope of reunion with loved ones who have passed away, and the expectation that Christ's return will bring comfort and joy to believers. As Paul wrote in 1 Thessalonians 4:13–18, he shared his understanding of the resurrection; explaining that when Jesus returns, those who have died in Christ will rise first, and then those who are still alive will join them in the air to meet the Lord. Therefore, the resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of the Christian hope, surpassing all earthly expectations. In Philippians 3:20–21, we find assurance that our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await the coming of our Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ. [Ed.: This translation is incomplete. ekegusii: Nabo agatebia emeganda eyachete, erinde ebatiswe nere, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?
english: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

ekegusii: Ere obekeire eganchwa etobekire ase amanyinga, na erieta riaye are korokwa Ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.

ekegusii: Erio asoke agende ase egesasimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero ekio,
english: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.
english: But you even undermine piety and hinder devotion to God.

ekegusii: Erio Sihoni amo nabanto baye bonsi bagacha gotorwania esegi, ekero twarenge ase omochie o Yahasi,
english: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,

ekegusii: Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka nebinto bire ebiya.
english: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

ekegusii: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
english: na Diliani, na Misipe, na Yokiteli,

ekegusii: Nabo ngakorwa koba omosomba bw’enchili eye koreng’ana nekeegwa ki’obuya bwa Nyasae obo naetwe ase ogokora gw’okobua kwaye.
english: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God's grace given me through the working of his power.

ekegusii: “Naende omonyaboronge karaonchoke atige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, inche nimobekere ekegocha ase enchera yaye goika akwe. Onye tikwamokurerete, ere nakwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na ogokora kwaye kw’oboronge akorete ritang’ani tigokoinyorwa, korende amanyinga aye ninyaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. Since you did not warn him, he will die for his sin. The righteous things he did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nakwo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na okoboko kwane gw’okorio gokarambora igoro chionsi; ekero nkorangeria igoro na ense, nigo chigotenena amo.”
english: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.
english: "But Abraham replied, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.

ekegusii: “Nigo narenge korigigwa buna enyoni nabwo barenge ababisa baane engencho ende etaiyo.
english: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omoruoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.
english: The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sodomu nigo barenge ababe, barenge gokora ebibe ebinge ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Now the men of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the LORD.

ekegusii: ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo nenchara, nabagoye inchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”
english: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance."

ekegusii: Ogochika okwo nakwo Omonene aete Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko riria achigete Abaisraeli bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso biabo.
english: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the LORD, in the Desert of Sinai.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakagenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.
