english: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the desert extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

ekegusii: Nkarora ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano na rimo omotengecho omonene okaba ase ense, erioba rikaba rimwamu buna egetambaa ki’egunia ekemwamu, omotienyi bwonsi okaba buna amanyinga.
english: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,

ekegusii: Ekero orabe ase amaboko abanto abwo, bakogoita, Inee, nogenderere gokwana ase amasio abo ng’a aye Nyasae ore? Aye nigo ore mwanyabanto, orabe ase amaboko ay’abwo bakogoita, tori Nyasae.
english: Will you then say, "I am a god," in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a man, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.

ekegusii: Ase omogo o kera emesa ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, ebigobanio mbiarengeo; obotambe bwa kera ekemo nigo bwarenge buna obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko; na igoro ye chimesa echio nao chinyama chi’ebing’wanso chiarenge kobekererwa.
english: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.

ekegusii: Musa, na Haroni, na abaraai b’Abaisraeli nigo babarete Abalawi bonsi eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
english: So Moses, Aaron and the leaders of Israel counted all the Levites by their clans and families.

ekegusii: Sulemani akabara na korika abasacha abamenyi bonsi barenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli buna Daudi ise akorete, akanyora ng’a nigo barenge abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na isato, na amagana atano na rimo (153,600).
english: Solomon took a census of all the aliens who were in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.

ekegusii: Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Saafu, ise Madimana, na Sheva, ise abanto ba Makibena na aba Gibea. Omoiseke o Kalebu nigo arenge korokwa Asika.
english: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Macbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Acsah.

ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe nomorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.
english: He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom tree.

ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.
english: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomochanda bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komorosia,
english: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

ekegusii: Korwa Mileto Paulo agatoma abanto kogenda Efeso barangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa.
english: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.

ekegusii: na korwa agwo bakairwa nemeeri ase enyancha, bagaika Antiokia. Agwo nao babekeretwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae ase emeremo eria banyarete goikerania.
english: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

ekegusii: And the man got up and went home.
english: Akaimoka, akagenda bwoye.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”
english: The men were amazed and asked, "What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!"

ekegusii: korende barabwo bakarua Perga, bakagenda Antiokia, omochie o Pisidia. Rituko ri’Esabato bagasoa ase esinagogi, bagaikaransa aroro.
english: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri na Onani, na Sela. Aba batato nabwo Batisua, omosubati orwete Kanani, aiborerete Yuda. Eri, omwana omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo arenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omonene akamoita.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the LORD's sight; so the LORD put him to death.

ekegusii: na amache akagenderera gokea korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amache agachaka gokeana.
english: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,

ekegusii: Omonto okoa omoriri amasikani, nigo anga buna oyokoruta omobuko ore nebinto bie rigori rinene ase etui y’amagena.
english: Like tying a stone in a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.

ekegusii: Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye na abobeke ang’e.
english: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

ekegusii: Chinsoko echio nigo chikoa ching’iti chionsi amache chianywa, ne chitigere chi’orosana nigo chikoyanywa, na erang’o yasira.
english: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande namang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge mbatoorigwe.
english: With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’erieta riaye Omonene takobaanga inwe abanto baye, ekiagera nigo anchete kobakora mobe abaye.
english: For the sake of his great name the LORD will not reject his people, because the LORD was pleased to make you his own.

ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.
english: Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene nenkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

ekegusii: “Kae ense ya Moabu chimbaba, eirurukere etame; emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe, ebe amaturi atamenyiri na monto.
english: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.

ekegusii: Inee! Ching’ondi chiane nigo chirabe chikorisia obonyansi mwatiringire namagoro aino, naende chinywe amache ayio mwaturubanirie namagoro aino?
english: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?

ekegusii: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
english: na Asareli, Selemia na Semaria,

ekegusii: Mwerende timobaisa koria amanyinga, ekiagera obomoyo nigo bore ase amanyinga ime, timoria, obomoyo amo nenyama.
english: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoayerera, tingotebana koigwera amachiko ao.
english: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abanto abanyabibe.
english: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.

ekegusii: naki ense eye yonsi oroche ninkoyee aye na ororeria rwao kare na kare.
english: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.

ekegusii: Etaya y’omobere oo neriso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.
english: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body also is full of darkness.

ekegusii: Naende nkagania komanya igoro ye chingunchara chiria ikomi chiarenge ase omotwe oye, na igoro y’orogunchara roria ronde oroke rwamerete korwa nyuma, orwo bosio bwaye isato ase chiria ikomi chiagweteo. Orogunchara orwo nigo rwabwate amaiso, na omonwa orenge gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu, naende rokarorekana nigo rore oronene kobua echinde chiamwabo.
english: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and about the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell-- the horn that looked more imposing than the others and that had eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, noro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.
english: The lamp of the LORD searches the spirit of a man; it searches out his inmost being.

ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b’oboruoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana b’oria omobe.
english: The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

ekegusii: Erio nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, nagosoroire, tiga tobaisa gokora ayio. Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo ekero bare abake iga?”
english: Then I cried out, "Sovereign LORD, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"

ekegusii: Naende Amasia agatebia Amosi, “Aye omorori, tama ogende ase ense y’Abayuda; aroro agwo nonyore endagera okoria, na obe gokobanera aroro.
english: Then Amaziah said to Amos, "Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

ekegusii: Hezekia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.

ekegusii: na ebikone biaye, na ogokora kwaye okwo akorete agwo Misiri ase Farao omoruoti, na ase abanto b’ense yaye.
english: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagatebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”
english: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let's go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about."

ekegusii: Nigo ngokorangeria ase erieta riao ase engencho ya Yakobo, omosomba one, ee, ase engencho ya Israeli, omochore one. Nakoeire erieta ri’amasikani, nonya aye tomanyeti inche.”
english: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane yasionoirwe namaiga, chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya ebina biao.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita na bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.
english: Amon's officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.

ekegusii: “Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
english: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions-- the work of a skilled craftsman. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

ekegusii: korende omwaga oyio ninyotome obe omotindi mono goetania. Bono ninche ndabanachere ekina.”
english: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them."

ekegusii: Ekaba rituko erimo, ekero Yusufu asoete nyomba gokora emeremo yaye, gose monto onde bw’abanto b’enyomba eria tarengeo,
english: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.

ekegusii: Onsibie kegima korwa ase obobe bwane, na onchene korwa ase ebibe biane.
english: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ontongere enkoro endabu, okore omoika ore ime yane obe omoyia na oyokong’ie.
english: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

ekegusii: Naki Yohana nigo achete, tare koria gose tare konywa: bagateba; Nare nekerecha.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, 'He has a demon.'

ekegusii: Nigo boboete Abakalidayo, ekiagera Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, konya oitire Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, oyio omoruoti o Babeli konya abekire koba omogambi ase ense eria.
english: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

ekegusii: Omotwe oye na etukia yaye nigo biarenge ebirabu se buna amarionya amarabu, ebirabu se buna amagena ’embura; na amaiso aye nigo arenge buna ekebemberi ki’omorero.
english: His head and hair were white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.

ekegusii: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
english: Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakinire, biarenta amakweri.

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a omonto onde bwensi ase eamate yao oratigare ore moyo nagende gotung’ama ase obosio bw’omokuani oyio, amosabe amoe ebesa gose omogati, ogoteba: Nagosabire ombeke nainche nkonye ase emeremo gete y’obokuani, erinde inyore omogati nkoria.”
english: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a crust of bread and plead, "Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat."'"

ekegusii: Omonene nabasiarere ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku binde, nainwe abamoratigare nabake ase omobaro, namomenye ase egati y’abanto baria ase Omonene arabaire.
english: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.

ekegusii: Nagwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nomuya nabanto bare isiko, erinde tabaisa kogwa ase ogosoerwa, na ase omoeto o Saitani.
english: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil's trap.

ekegusii: Ababwatetie abwo n’Abakuani babwate ebirombeta, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yonathani, o Semaya, o Matania, o Mikaya, o Sakuri bw’Asafu.
english: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Yerusalemu norokwe Oboikaranso bw’Omonene. Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererekane agwo Yerusalemu, ase obosio bw’Omonene, na tibikogania gotunyana naende oboenenu bwe chinkoro chi’obobe.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD, and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Rora, amang’ana ayio ngocha are, aikeranigwe ase rituko riria nakwanete ng’a ayio nabe.
english: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD. This is the day I have spoken of.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyore obwate ebinyasae biao goika aitwe akwe. Tiga abaminto aba bare aa babe kirori. Rigia! Koranyore kende kiao kere asende, okeire.” Yakobo tamanyete ng’a Raeli obiibire.
english: But if you find anyone who has your gods, he shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.

ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabatebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyo achorire aike ang’e nere.
english: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the LORD will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba bw’Omonene, Omonene tanchete gosiria enyomba ya Yuda, ekiagera ariete eira ng’a Daudi abe etaya kogenderera botambe, ere amo nororeria rwaye.
english: Nevertheless, for the sake of his servant David, the LORD was not willing to destroy Judah. He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.

ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba kw’Ahaswero, ababisa baria bakarika amang’ana ay’ogosoera abanto bamenyete ase orogongo rw’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu.
english: At the beginning of the reign of Xerxes, they lodged an accusation against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.
english: One generation will commend your works to another; they will tell of your mighty acts.

ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto ore nenkoro y’obong’aini.
english: He who brings trouble on his family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.
english: He springs up like a flower and withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.

ekegusii: Omonto karateemwe, tateba, “Nateemirwe na Nyasae,” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.
english: When tempted, no one should say, "God is tempting me." For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;

ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.
english: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, the ruthless through all the years stored up for him.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eria yachigetwe nomoruoti Nebukadinesaro ng’a abamura baria bonsi barentwe asare yaigete, omoteneneri oria omonene akabaira ase omoruoti oria.
english: At the end of the time set by the king to bring them in, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Ase igo abanene bonsi be chingongo chiria, na abagavuna, na abagambi abanene bonsi b’oboruoti, baria baare gokora emeremo y’omoruoti, bagakonya Abayahudi, ekiagera boboete Moredekai.
english: And all the nobles of the provinces, the satraps, the governors and the king's administrators helped the Jews, because fear of Mordecai had seized them.

ekegusii: Naende mbarabi abwo are agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?
english: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the desert?

ekegusii: Korabe gokobachanda abana baane abasubati, gose gokonyuoma abakungu bande abaao goetania barabwo, manya ng’a nonya monto onde taiyo oyaroche, rora, Nyasae nere kirori egati yao nainche.”
english: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me."

ekegusii: Korende nigo basang’ananete nabanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.
english: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

ekegusii: Okwo nakwo korabe ogoakanwa kwabo ase engencho y’oboenenu bwabo, ekiagera bachecheretie na gwetogia igoro y’abanto b’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Amasia, mosinto o Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenderera koba moyo emiaka ikomi na etano nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Yehoasi mosinto o Yehoahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agatebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,
english: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, "If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.
english: The LORD upholds all those who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

ekegusii: Naboigo Yoshua akaira ense eria engima. Akabua na goita abaruoti bonsi b’ense y’ebitunwa, na eye Negebu, na ey’omwenya, na ey’ebitirimboko. Agaita abanto bonsi pi, tatigaretie nonya noyomo, buna achigetwe n’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.

ekegusii: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
english: Seraya, na Asaria, na Yeremia;

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera obuya bwa Nyasae?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Ee, nareo omonto oyomo, mosinto o Yonathani, ore ekerema.”
english: The king asked, "Is there no one still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show God's kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in both feet."

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo asebare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.
english: So I will come upon them like a lion, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na isano, na amagana ane (35,400).
english: The number from the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.

ekegusii: Martha akamotebia, “Namanyire ng’a nache kobokigwa ase okobokigwa rituko ri’omoerio.”
english: Martha answered, "I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."

ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria, “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”
english: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."

ekegusii: Oroisie ne chinterekerero chie chifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere ase kera ebao ase okobwaterania chintamang’o chiaye ibere.
english: and make forty silver bases to go under them-- two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

ekegusii: Ande nebe ng’a Abayuda mbaigwe amang’ana aria amabe naganirie gokora asebare, kera omonto nabaise koonchoka atige chinchera chiaye chimbe, na ase ayio, inche nimbaabere ogosaria kwabo na ebibe biabo.”
english: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, each of them will turn from his wicked way; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin."

ekegusii: Naki titori kwerandia intwe abanyene, korende Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, na intwe abanyene buna abasomba baino ase engencho ya Yeso.
english: For we do not preach ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Nimbwate egento ngokwana naye.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Kwana.”
english: Then he added, "I have something to say to you." "You may say it," she replied.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Ahabu akaimoka, akaria na akanywa, korende Elija agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro, agatung’ama inse akaumama, akabeka obosio bwaye gati‐gati y’amaru aye.
english: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.

ekegusii: Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye akabora:
english: And Job continued his discourse:

ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oyo ogeikaranserete.
english: And he who swears by heaven swears by God's throne and by the one who sits on it.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.
english: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The ordinances of the LORD are sure and altogether righteous.

ekegusii: Omorero nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, oro nigo ogosamba ababisa baye abwo bamoetanaine.
english: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatoma abanto ase Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, akabora, “Ing’iranerie Mikali mokane, oyio narierete boko, na ngaakana rigori ri’amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha ay’Abafilisti rigana erimo, erinde imonyuome.”
english: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."

ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, ogambe ebina bi’ekeene, orwanerere oboronge bw’abataka na obaremeire.
english: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy."

ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani, agacha Yerusalemu komoteema ase okomoboria amang’ana amakong’u, agacha amo nabasomba baye abange ne chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari, ne chitahabu chinyinge, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamotebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan-- with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones-- she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.

ekegusii: Bono abanto bane barwarete oborwaire bwa ukoma mbarenge agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita. Barabwo bagatebania, “Ninki gekogera toikaranse aiga goika tokwe?
english: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate. They said to each other, "Why stay here until we die?

ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.
english: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.

ekegusii: Ekero omokori amabe agocha, ogochaywa nigo kogocha boigo, na ogochaywa okwo nigo gokorenta obosooku.
english: When wickedness comes, so does contempt, and with shame comes disgrace.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rora, nintoorie abanto baane, mbarente korwa ase chinse chia moocha na bosongo.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Musa akwanete n’Abaisraeli bonsi ekero barenge ase erooro, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan. Nigo barenge ase Ekerubo Ekiomo kororia Sufu, gati gati y’omochie o Parani ase ensemo eyemo, na emechie ya Tofeli na Labani, na Haseroti, na Disahabu ase ensemo ende. (
english: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the desert east of the Jordan-- that is, in the Arabah-- opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwwa ase abakure,
english: but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness-- for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

ekegusii: Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”
english: But we know where this man is from; when the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from."

ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omokungu omotayayi nigo ore eirima entambe, na omonto onde bwensi Omonene agechigwe nere goika agwe ase eirima eyio.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the LORD's wrath will fall into it.

ekegusii: Nabo bakamoboria, “Naye ng’o rende? Toe abatotomete okoiraneria. Naki ogweteba?”
english: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

ekegusii: “Ekero kia mogoroba, esibie omobere namache, na ekero bwairiire kegima asoe ase egetwori.
english: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

ekegusii: Ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, moyiate ase chinsemo isato, na moroisie chinchera chikogenda ase emechie eyio etato, erio omonto karaite oyonde mosiabano, abe ogotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
english: Build roads to them and divide into three parts the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that anyone who kills a man may flee there.

ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
english: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

ekegusii: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.
english: Yonathani akarusia egetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara agakea Daudi, akamoa nebirwanero biaye, na omoyio o birende, na obota, na orokini.

ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.
english: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.

ekegusii: Oyio tari oro omoroberio oito, korende omonto oyomo bw’ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, oimokire koba mamincha y’omoruoti Daudi. Mosokie, nainche indue aa ase omochie oyo!” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, noruterwe omotwe oye ase orwaki igoro.”
english: That is not the case. A man named Sheba son of Bicri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Hand over this one man, and I'll withdraw from the city." The woman said to Joab, "His head will be thrown to you from the wall."

ekegusii: Bakanyuomeria abamura babo abaiseke b’abanto baria b’ebisaku, na bagasokia abaiseke babo ase abanto abwo naende bagakorera chinyasae chiabo.
english: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n’Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe.
english: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out his love into our hearts by the Holy Spirit, whom he has given us.

ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.
english: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

ekegusii: Korende chinyama chi’eeri eyio, ne risankwa, na eubi yonsi y’enda obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
english: But burn the bull's flesh and its hide and its offal outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio onsi, bono nigo togokora okobwatana gotari koonchoka na tokorike, erinde abanene baito amo n’Abalawi baito, na abakuani baito, babeke ebimanyererio biabo ase korokwo.
english: "In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it."

ekegusii: Agachika omosomba oria bwe ritang’ani, akamotebia, “Esau ominto, ekero araumerane naye, na gokoboria: Noyo ng’o ore? Ng’ai ogochia? Etugo eye otang’anetie, neya ng’o?
english: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, 'To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?'

ekegusii: Iga yarorekanete buya ase Omoika Omochenu amo naintwe, titobatweka egurube ende otatiga eyio egwenerete:
english: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:

ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda. Na rora, ekero are inchera, akarora omonto bw’Etiopia, omogomba, oyobegetwe igoro y’enibo yonsi ya Kandake, eting’ana ya Etiopia. Ere nigo agendete Yerusalemu gosasima.
english: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

ekegusii: Segubu akaibora Yairi, oyio obwate emechie emerongo ebere, na etato, ase ense ya Gileadi.
english: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.

ekegusii: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are firs.
english: Ebisigisa bi’enyomba yaito nebi’emecharake, ne chindote nechi’emetarakwa.

ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie emanwa y’eng’ondi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, amo namaguta aria egetuba ekemo, abinduere inche Omonene bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa.
english: The priest is to take the lamb for the guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.
english: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. A song. May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

ekegusii: Yusufu agatiania abana ba Israeli agwo, akabora, “Bono, ekero Nyasae arabachere abakonye, goika moire amauga aane; mogende naro.”
english: And Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."

ekegusii: Akeonchorera omokungu oria, agatebia Simion, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.
english: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

ekegusii: Korende baria baikire konyuomana nabachikire, gose tari inche, korende Omonene, ng’a omokungu tatiga omosacha oye,
english: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Abigaeli, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ogotoma gwacha koumerana nainche ase rituko ria rero.
english: David said to Abigail, "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba igoro y’Abaedomu: “Inee! Obong’aini mbwaerire korwa Temani? Ogosemia ngwasirire korwa ase abanyasemi? Obong’aini bwabo mbwasirire kegima?
english: Concerning Edom: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

ekegusii: Now his father went down to see the woman. And Samson made a feast there, as was customary for bridegrooms.
english: Ise Samison akagenda gochia korora omoiseke oria, na Samison agakora omoyega aroro aaria. Nabo yarenge engencho y’abamura gokora.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naoroke nabamalaika baye ore nobonene bwa Ise, na ekero ekio ng’ae kera omonto koreng’ana buna are gokora.
english: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father's glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what he has done.

ekegusii: Baali akaibora Beera oria Tiligati‐Pileseri omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, oosete, akamoira ase obosomba. Beera orenge omoteneneri bw’abanto ba Reuben.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.
english: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.
english: Nevertheless, some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather it, but they found none.

ekegusii: Ekiagera aase enibo yao ere, nao nenkoro yao ekoba.”
english: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

ekegusii: ekero togokwanwa bobe, intwe twaebereria. Twakorirwe buna eogoto y’ense na eubi y’ebinto bionsi goika bono.
english: when we are slandered, we answer kindly. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakogenda orogendo, Eema y’Omosangererekano nebe ekobogorigwa n’Abalawi, na barabwo babe gati‐gati y’ebiombe binde. Ase omoroberio oyo abanto mbabe bagotoora, naboigo barabe kobakogenda orogendo. Kera omonto abe ensemo yaye inse y’ebendera yaye.
english: Then the Tent of Meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in his own place under his standard.

ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bakoirogete bache asende. Abwo bamanyete oborori bwao.
english: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omonyene oboronge ase amang’ana aya onsi abeire agotonyora; aye nigo ore omwegenwa, korende intwe twakorire ayare amabe.
english: In all that has happened to us, you have been just; you have acted faithfully, while we did wrong.

ekegusii: Eyio nigo ere bosa, nesekererwe, ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe.
english: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abaisraeli gocha ase obomenyo bwabo naende. Nabarabwo nabarie chindagera chiabo agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli, na ase orogongo rwa Basani, na okogania kwabo nagoisanekigwe agwo ase ebigoro bi’Efraimu, na ase Gileadi.
english: But I will bring Israel back to his own pasture and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

ekegusii: Onye eriso riao ria borio rikogera okore ebibe, rirusie, oritugute are, ekiagera mbuya asore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
english: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.

ekegusii: Omonene nabaakane koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore. Nabe nendamwamu ase abwo bakomoengereria, naakane ababisa baye koreng’ana nogokora kwabo; abanto b’ebisinka na abe chinse chire ang’e ne chinyancha nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
english: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.

ekegusii: Bagakwana igoro ya Nyasae o Yerusalemu, buna bakwanete igoro ye chinyasae chi’abanto b’ebisaku b’ense eye, chiria chiaroisetigwe namaboko a mwanyabanto.
english: They spoke about the God of Jerusalem as they did about the gods of the other peoples of the world-- the work of men's hands.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero Doegi Omoedomu achierete Saulo komotebia ng’a Daudi ochire mw’Abimeleki) Aye omonto ore nokobua, nase ki ogwetogeria amabe aya ogokora? Obwanchani bwa Nyasae nigo bogendererete kare na kare.
english: For the director of music. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite had gone to Saul and told him: "David has gone to the house of Ahimelech." Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

ekegusii: Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.
english: You would even cast lots for the fatherless and barter away your friend.

ekegusii: Amo nayio, ondoiserie aase ngocha komenya, naki nsemeretie ng’a goetera ase ogosaba kwaino nimbe nainwe.
english: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

ekegusii: Akamosesenia, akabora, “Aburamu asesenigwe na Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense;
english: and he blessed Abram, saying, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti nigo arenge gokwana na Gehasi, omosomba bw’omonto oria o Nyasae, akamoboria amotebie amang’ana amanene Elisha konya akorire.
english: The king was talking to Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, and had said, "Tell me about all the great things Elisha has done."

ekegusii: Abamura bamwabo amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate yaye bagatirimboka kwoyia omobere oye. Bakamoira, bakamotindeka ase egati ya Sora na Esitaoli, ase embeera ya Manoa ise. Samison konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere.
english: Then his brothers and his father's whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.

ekegusii: Ebisaku binde mbikonye Abaisraeli koirana ase ense yabo, na Abaisraeli mbabakore babe abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, mbabe bakobakorera agwo ase ense y’Omonene. Abaisraeli mboose abwo baboosete kare, na bagambere abwo barenge kobakorera bobe.
english: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD's land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.

ekegusii: Abakanani na abanto bande bonsi b’ense eye baise koigwa ring’ana eri nigo barache gotoetanana na korusia amarieta aito korwa ase ense, titoinyorwa. Inki rende otagete okore, erinde erieta riao rinene ritogigwe?”
english: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?"

ekegusii: Ere nasesenie bonsi abamoirogete, nasesenie abake na abanene.
english: he will bless those who fear the LORD-- small and great alike.

ekegusii: Amariogi ’okwoga akaigugwa korwa agwo, na amo nabanto barengeo batari namasikani; abande abagotinda bakarentwa korwa ase erooro, na barabwo bakabekera abakungu ebigera ase amaboko abo, ne chigutwa chingiya ase emetwe yabo.
english: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; Sabeans were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the arms of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.

ekegusii: Ekero oraigwe eriogi ri’ebititiro bigoeta igoro ase emete eyio, erio bwebeke ang’e, omanye ng’a inche Omonene nasokire, nagotang’anire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”
english: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because that will mean the LORD has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ngento ki barora nyomba mwao?” Hezekia akairaneria, “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire nyomba mwane; tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”
english: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

ekegusii: Omote oyio okaba okonyora amache na gokina; chinsoko chia inse chikayotambeyia. Chindooche nigo chiaetanaine ase osimekire, nyuma yaye chindooche echio chikaba chikonyosia emete yonsi ye rinani amache.
english: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.

ekegusii: Yehoramu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, na ebere, ekero abete omoruoti; akagamba emiaka etano na etato, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi nache igoro ase ekegori eke.
english: I tell you the truth, all this will come upon this generation.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, abagaaka bande b’ense eria bagatenena, bagakwana nabanto basangererekanete agwo, bakabatebia,
english: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, engoma nebugigwe, na abanto abwo basirerete ase ense y’Abaasuri, na baria baseretigwe gochia ase ense ya Misiri, mbache gosasima Omonene ase egetunwa egechenu agwo Yerusalemu.
english: And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Ampiliato, omwanchwa one ase Omonene.
english: Greet Ampliatus, whom I love in the Lord.

ekegusii: Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: After they set out from Rephidim, they entered the Desert of Sinai, and Israel camped there in the desert in front of the mountain.

ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana aye chisemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora ay’oboriri.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

ekegusii: Abamalaika baria babere bakagenda, bagaika Sodomu mogoroba, na Loti nigo arenge oikaransete geita gia Sodomu. Ekero Loti abaroche, akaimoka kobarotota, agatung’ama inse, akaumama,
english: The two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When he saw them, he got up to meet them and bowed down with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng’ana nogokora kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge koranche orusie endamwamu yao, na ekeririanda kiao, korwa ase Yerusalemu, omochie oo, ee, korwa ase egetunwa kiao egechenu. Ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na ebie chisokoro chiaito, Yerusalemu amo nabanto bao babeire bagokwanwa bobe, ase egati y’abanto baria bonsi batoetanaine.
english: O Lord, in keeping with all your righteous acts, turn away your anger and your wrath from Jerusalem, your city, your holy hill. Our sins and the iniquities of our fathers have made Jerusalem and your people an object of scorn to all those around us.

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo moroche ng’a negento egesinini asemore ng’a Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli obaatananire inwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, na kobarenta mobe ang’e nere, na komokorera Omonene ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, na gotenenera omoganda bw’abanto, na kobakorera?
english: Isn't it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the LORD's tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?

ekegusii: Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.
english: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

ekegusii: Naki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri ’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, nyuma gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;
english: For if, when we were God's enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

ekegusii: Tinkwoboa abanto abwo basemeretie obotenenku bwabo; barabwo nigo bare bakoenenera obonda bwabo bore obonge.
english: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

ekegusii: Gose ninche bweka na Barnaba totari ne ribaga ri’ogotiga emeremo ya kera rituko?
english: Or is it only I and Barnabas who must work for a living?

ekegusii: Naki omochie oyo otigaire bosa, oyio orenge oichire nabanto! Naki otigaire buna omoboraka, oyio orenge omonene ase egati y’ebisaku! Oyio orenge buna eting’ana ase egati y’emechie, bono obeire omosomba.
english: How deserted lies the city, once so full of people! How like a widow is she, who once was great among the nations! She who was queen among the provinces has now become a slave.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao araikeranigwe na obe gokogenda korara ase chisokoro chiao chiararete, nimbeke oyomo bw’ororeria rwao, oyorarue ase oyomo bw’abamura bao, agambe; nainche ninkong’ie oboruoti bwaye.
english: When your days are over and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

ekegusii: Ayio tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,
english: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa asende biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.
english: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, 'Whatever help you might otherwise have received from me is a gift devoted to God,'

ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonyuomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.
english: "But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.

ekegusii: "But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, 'I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.'
english: Bagachaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akamotebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.

ekegusii: Inee! Ninche naiborete abanto aba bonsi? Gose ninche nabatongete? Naki rende ogontebia ng’a mbabogorie na kobarera ase egekuba kiane, buna omoreri akobogoria omwana ekeng’werere okogonka, goika imbaikie ase ense eria kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nobayee?”
english: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their forefathers?

ekegusii: “Omonto obeire oyotachenegeti, nere tancheti gwesibia, arusigwe ase omosangererekano bw’abanto. Ere okorire Aase Aachenu y’Omonene babeire atachenegeti, ekiagera amache aria ay’okomochena tanyororokeretigwe asare; ere nigo are oyotachenegeti.
english: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he must be cut off from the community, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on him, and he is unclean.

ekegusii: Rituko riria narusetie chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, tinabatebetie gose tinabachigete igoro ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde.
english: For when I brought your forefathers out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

ekegusii: Naende ekaba ng’a rituko erimo, ekero abana ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase barenge kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakabwata omokungu oria, bakamoetia gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti na bakamoira aroro ase Egeita gie Chibarasi, bakamoitera aroro agakwa.
english: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

ekegusii: Inche tinkonyara kweba amachiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

ekegusii: na abatang’ani b’abarwani emerongo etano, na abanto abasike, na abasemia, na abaroisia abang’aini, na abaragori bamanyete oborogi mono.
english: the captain of fifty and man of rank, the counselor, skilled craftsman and clever enchanter.

ekegusii: Tokaira chitugo chionsi na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.
english: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

ekegusii: ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twararete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chibesa chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chibesa chionsi pi. Bono chibesa echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.
english: But at the place where we stopped for the night we opened our sacks and each of us found his silver-- the exact weight-- in the mouth of his sack. So we have brought it back with us.

ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateba, “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.
english: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.

ekegusii: Inee! Takomotebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na nyuma yaye, naye orie na konywa?
english: Would he not rather say, 'Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink'?

ekegusii: Amasa teritete korwa ase omoyio oria Yoabu abwate koboko kwaye. Ase igo Yoabu akamobeta omoyio oria enda, na amara akagwa inse. Erio agwo Amasa agakwa, na Yoabu tamoaka eria kabere. Nyuma y’ayio Yoabu na Abisai, momura omwabo, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
english: Amasa was not on his guard against the dagger in Joab's hand, and Joab plunged it into his belly, and his intestines spilled out on the ground. Without being stabbed again, Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bicri.

ekegusii: Chimbeera chiabo nigo chikare inse aatambe, na emeganda yabo nigo eetanaine chimbeera chiabo ase chinsemo chionsi. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakure; abanto abwo kare barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.
english: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.

ekegusii: Ng’ai are oria okoboko kwaye kw’obonene kwarenge ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Musa, oria bwatananete amache ’enyancha ase amasio ’abanto, erinde akenyorera erieta rigotogigwa kare na kare?
english: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses' right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,

ekegusii: Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konuchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.
english: You snatch me up and drive me before the wind; you toss me about in the storm.

ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.
english: I was appointed from eternity, from the beginning, before the world began.

ekegusii: Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane! Nabo Nyasae oino atebire.
english: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

ekegusii: Naki amanyekane asemore ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.” [
english: "Therefore I want you to know that God's salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!"

ekegusii: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?" They said, "Rabbi" (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
english: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamotebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”

ekegusii: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
english: Kobakoorire gotera Ogotera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.

ekegusii: Bagaita abana ba Zedekia agwo ase amaiso aye, erio bakamokonora amaiso, bakamosiba ne chingatare, bakamoira Babeli.
english: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Omobani tari oranyare gwanchwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
english: "I tell you the truth," he continued, "no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaba okogambera amaruoti onsi, gochakera orooche rw’Eufarati na goikera ense y’Abafilisti, na goikera orobebe rwa Misiri. Abanto bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye nigo barenge komorentera ebango na bakaba bakomokorera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon's subjects all his life.

ekegusii: oyorenge kobatang’ana botambe na kobarigeria aase mware gochia gotoora. Ase obotuko nigo arenge kobaraa nomorero, na ase omobaso obaraa ne riire, koborokia aase mware goetera.”
english: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo aichire ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, korende chinguru echio nigo chirarare nere ase riroba.
english: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie with him in the dust.

ekegusii: Abamura ba Oni, na aba Pi‐Beseti, mbaitwe nemioro, na abanto bande babo bairwe ase obosomba.
english: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.

ekegusii: Bagakwana ring’ana ri’Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.
english: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.

ekegusii: Samoti korwa Harodi na Helesi korwa Peleti;
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

ekegusii: “Omosacha, gose omokungu, orarigie ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose oyore omorogi, goika aitwe akwe. Abanto abwo baakwe amagena bakwe; okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nakobe okwabo.”
english: "'A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.'"

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, erio arwanie ababisa baino na kobarentera obobui.
english: For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene naende, na Omonene akamoiraneria, “Imoka, ogende Keila, ekiagera nimbeke Abafilisti ase okoboko kwao.”
english: Once again David inquired of the LORD, and the LORD answered him, "Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand."

ekegusii: na ase obong’ainereria bwonsi bw’ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.
english: and in every sort of evil that deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetie gosiria obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gotantanigwa, na abwo baganetie ng’a obobe bonyore inche, tiga bairanigwe nyuma na gochaywa.
english: May those who seek my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro y’Asaria, mosinto bw’Odedi.
english: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded.

ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chibesa ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

ekegusii: Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.
english: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews, for already the Jews had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Elija akagenda, agakora buna ring’ana ri’Omonene riamochigete; akagenda akamenya agwo ase akarooche ga Keriti, moocha ya Yorodan.
english: So he did what the LORD had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.

ekegusii: Then God said to Noah,
english: Erio Nyasae agatebia Nuhu,

ekegusii: “Bwata rituko ri’Esabato, oriatanane ribe richenu, buna Omonene Nyasae oo, agochigete.
english: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

ekegusii: Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba nomoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba nomogoko.
english: To have a fool for a son brings grief; there is no joy for the father of a fool.

ekegusii: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"
english: Gose tigokari ng’umbu y’enyancha, erinde moborie: Ning’o oranyare kwamboka gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha agotorentere, erinde tokoigwe na togokore?

ekegusii: Yoabu akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya, rero tokonyara koba omonto okoira amang’ana amaya. Rituko rinde nonyare koira amang’ana amaya, korende tari rero, ekiagera omwana bw’omoruoti okure.”
english: "You are not the one to take the news today," Joab told him. "You may take the news another time, but you must not do so today, because the king's son is dead."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebirie: “Genda ogore orokini rw’egatani orobeke kenema kiao, korende tobaisa korotobeka ase amache.”
english: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."

ekegusii: Erio akaimokia enyimbo yaye ase okoboko kwaye, agachora amagena atano amaterere korwa ase akarooche, akayabeka ase esaro yaye y’oborisia, na enduruche akabogoria koboko kwaye. Na bono agasuka gochia ang’e n’Omofilisti oria.
english: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd's bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.

ekegusii: Nabo mwanyabanto ore ne chingencho chia kare, takonyora ebiegwa bi’Omoika o Nyasae, naki asare ere ebi nebiriri, gose takonyara kobimanya, ekiagera nigo bikomanyekana ase chinguru chi’Omoika.
english: The man without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.

ekegusii: Na inche narorire, naende naorokirie ng’a oyo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: I have seen and I testify that this is the Son of God."

ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteba: Ngambera boronge ase omosira one.
english: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, 'Grant me justice against my adversary.'

ekegusii: Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.
english: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out-- until the day it lifted.

ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwachakerete Mahanaimu, na nigo rwabwateranetie Basani engima oboruoti bwonsi bw’Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, amo nemechie yonsi emerongo etano nomo ya Yairi agwo Basani.
english: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan-- all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bare isiko mbaitwe nemioro, ekero bare ime ase chinyomba obwoba mbobaite; ebio mbiite abamura, na abaiseke, na abana bakogonka, amo nabanto abagotu.
english: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. Young men and young women will perish, infants and gray-haired men.

ekegusii: Na buna ebiara bi’amagoro biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba, naboigo oboruoti boria borabe obokong’u ensemo eyemo, na ensemo ende obworo.
english: As the toes were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

ekegusii: Erio nario inwe amo na abana baino moramenye amatuko amange ase ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee ebe eyabo. Nigo moragenderere komenyao ase engaki koreng’ana buna igoro egendererete koba igoro y’ense.
english: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land that the LORD swore to give your forefathers, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

ekegusii: Embusuro eria ekamera, ekaba omosabibu omweng’e orandete mono; emerande yaye ekaranda gochia ase ekeongo keria nemeri yaye, ekabeera ase giateneine. Ase igo ekaba omosabibu ore ne chinsagia na ebisebo.
english: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.

ekegusii: bono omwaga bwe chinguru ocha korwa ase erooro, onyegeria chikoona inye chi’enyomba eria, erinde yagwera abana abwo abasae, bakure bonsi; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogotebia.”
english: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

ekegusii: na Oholibama akaibora Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora. Aba nabwo abana abamura Esau aiboreretwe ase ense ya Kanani.
english: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

ekegusii: Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etaai.
english: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow pierces him.

ekegusii: "'Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.
english: Tobaisa korara na nyoko. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku. Torentera nyoko obosooku.

ekegusii: Korende moka Loti nigo arenge korwa nyuma, akarigereria magega, akaonchoka, akooma, akaba buna rigena ri’omonyo.
english: But Lot's wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

ekegusii: Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.
english: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Ahasi naende, akamotebia,
english: Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz,

ekegusii: Aye notoiranere, otororere amabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.
english: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.
english: Omokuani, omomura o Haroni, oyio orabe okorua amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe amo nebitinya, nere oraire ekenama keria kia borio kebe egetari kiaye.

ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana asemore nonya ng’ake.
english: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.

ekegusii: Nonya nebinto bitari nobogima, buna ekeroria, gose obokano, onye tibikorua eriogi rire nogwatananekana, naki eramanyekane ngotera ki gokobugigwa ase ekeroria gose obokano?
english: Even in the case of lifeless things that make sounds, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone know what tune is being played unless there is a distinction in the notes?

ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”
english: Will it go down to the gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?"

ekegusii: tell us what the future holds, so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.
english: Totebie aya agochi‐gocha, erinde tomanye ng’a inwe ne chinyasae; kora amang’ana amaya, gose amabe erinde tokorora ayio tokumie.

ekegusii: Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.
english: "Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.

ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
english: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y’ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudas atigete, akagenda aase aye.”
english: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs."

ekegusii: Omokuani oyoakire amaguta aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eria, ayarente ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull's blood and carry it into the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Bono omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi oikire ang’e. Ase ayio, mobe nobong’aini na kwerita ase ogosaba.
english: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear minded and self-controlled so that you can pray.

ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,
english: Have you never questioned those who travel? Have you paid no regard to their accounts--

ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y’ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abakorererete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.
english: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by miraculous signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.
english: "Look at the behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

ekegusii: Nigo natengechetie ebisaku ase okogwa kwaye, ekero nayogechete nkayotuguta gochia aase abakure, ase abwo bagendete ase chimbeera. Erio emete yonsi ya Edeni, na eyechorire ere emiya mono ya Lebanoni, yonsi eye ekonywa amache, ekaba ekweremia emenyene agwo inse ye riroba.
english: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the grave with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the trees that were well-watered, were consoled in the earth below.

ekegusii: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
english: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, komoranche amonyuome.

ekegusii: Yeso agacha, akabatebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.
english: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

ekegusii: Buna aase abakure na embeera bitari goisaneka, naboigo namaiso a mwanyabanto atari goisaneka.
english: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are the eyes of man.

ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.
english: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

ekegusii: Erio Abineri akaba nendamwamu enene ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio a Isi‐Boseti, akabora, “Inee! Inche nigo inde omotwe bw’esese korwa ase ense ya Yuda? Goika rituko ria rero ngendererete koba omwegenwa ase abanto b’eamate ya Saulo iso, na ase abamwabo, na ase abasani baye, ko tinakobeka ase okoboko gwa Daudi, na bono aye gwansoeire na gonkora koba nokomocha ase engencho y’omokungu oyo.
english: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said and he answered, "Am I a dog's head-- on Judah's side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven't handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!

ekegusii: Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.
english: But when it is torn from its spot, that place disowns it and says, 'I never saw you.'

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia, “Akanyomba aka karochie irianyi nak’abakuani bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu,
english: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who have charge of the temple,

ekegusii: Omonto nigo agokora emeremo emekong’u nobong’aini bwaye, ne chisemi, na okomanya kwaye, konyora ebinto, korende nyuma yaye atigera omonto omoao otabiechanderete okwegokia nabirobio. Ayio boigo mbosa, naende mbobe mono.
english: For a man may do his work with wisdom, knowledge and skill, and then he must leave all he owns to someone who has not worked for it. This too is meaningless and a great misfortune.

ekegusii: Okogamba ebina bi’ekeene gwatugutirwe gochia nyuma, na oboronge nigo bobeerete aare. Ekeene, giatiringeirwe inse, giatugutirwe ase amakoori, oboronge tibori konyora ribaga bosoe.
english: So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika oko goika okorende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echikire.”
english: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.

ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?
english: With what shall I come before the LORD and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

ekegusii: Ing’iranerie, aye Omonene, ing’iranerie, erio abanto aba bamanye ng’a naye Omonene ore Nyasae, oranyare koonchora chinkoro chiabo chikoiranere.”
english: Answer me, O LORD, answer me, so these people will know that you, O LORD, are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."

ekegusii: Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakonya.
english: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

ekegusii: Israeli na abana baye bakaba bakomenya ase ense ya Misiri, ensemo ya Goseni, bakayeira ekaba eyabo, bakamenteka na kobucha mono.
english: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abimeleki na Pikoli, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bagatebia Ibrahimu, “Nyasae nigo are amo naye ase ande onsi ogokora.
english: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything you do.

ekegusii: naende Yokimu na abanto ba Koseba, Yoashi na Sarafu, abwo barenge kogambera Abamoabu, naende Yasubi‐Lehemu. (Korende amang’ana aya namakoro.)
english: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)

ekegusii: Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yabo, naende orageria amage ’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.
english: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

ekegusii: Nindusie amarieta e chinyasae Baali korwa ase omonwa bw’omokungu oyio, tichiatorwa nonya ng’ake ase amarieta abo.
english: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

ekegusii: Na bono nabatebirie, eatanane korwa ase abanto aba, batige, ekiagera onye ring’ana eri, gose emeremo eye, neya mwanyabanto, nesarigwe,
english: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.

ekegusii: Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere enene, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo biichire nemechando.
english: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.

ekegusii: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
english: Inee! Nabeire omobisa oino, ekiagera nabatebirie ayare ay’ekeene?

ekegusii: Ekero Abayuda bachete ase omorobiri bw’oborendi agwo ase erooro na bakarigereria, bakarora ebitondo birambereretie inse; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo.
english: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.

ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”
english: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."

ekegusii: Omonto ogotiringera inse abasibwa bonsi bare ase ense,
english: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,

ekegusii: Abande b’aborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene nigo gwaseretie abanto b’ebisaku nokoboko kwao, korende chisokoro chiaito okabarenta okabasimeka aroro; nigo kwarentete emechando ase abanto b’ebisaku, korende chisokoro chiaito okabamentekania bakaranda.
english: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our fathers; you crushed the peoples and made our fathers flourish.

ekegusii: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
english: Na Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, taiborete mwana nonya noyomo goika ogokwa kwaye.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bokeria emeganda ya Misiri amagombo, obatugute abanto baye gochia inse, amo nabanto b’ebisaku bire nobonene, bagende aase abakure agwo ase chimbeera, ase abakure bagendete.
english: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: obwa ikomi na kianda bokagwera Petahiya, na obwa emerongo ebere Ezekieli;
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Omochenu oino, ninche omotongi oino inwe Abaisraeli, ninche inde omoruoti oino.”
english: I am the LORD, your Holy One, Israel's Creator, your King."

ekegusii: Ebirero bia abasae- bogirango maate Abasae korwa ensemo yebunge ya bogirango maate ekaunti ya kisii nigo bemurunganirie igoro yechichera chibesa chiechibursary chikorwegwa ase ensemo eyuo. bakoragwa na samwel botai, abasae abwo nigo bamiragire ekiara omojumbe bwensemo eyuo sylvanus osoro ase ogokeia ekerengo giechibesa chiabegetwe na omojumbe omokoro manson oyongo giechilifu ikomi goika chilifu ibere ase kera omworokigwa egento batebire buna necheche gochia ase aborokigwa abataka abwo bategemeete chibesa echio gosoma. abasae abwo boigo nigo bamochirie osoro ase ogotabwata okoboko abasae bwensemo eyuo erio banyore chigasi egekogera abange babo nigo basomete korende tibaranyora meremo. abasae abwo boigo nigo bemurunganirie buna nyuma yokoborwa emeremo na gosoa bodaboda erio benyorere eng’eria yabo ya kera rituko, oboonchoreria obwo nigo bwasinyire egekogera chipara chinyinge ase ensemo eyuo nigo chisaregete na tichirigoeteka ase engaki eye embura egotwa ime ya gusii. nigo basabire omojumbe osoro koimokerera igoro nakobakorera emeremo bamoete erio ensemo eyuo nero esuke motwe ase ensemo ya amagenderero.
english: The elders have reduced – they are discussing matters. The elders are working on a report regarding the discussion of matters concerning the Kisii account, and they are gathering information about the scholarship funds allocated to students. They were created by Samwel Botai; these elders have appointed a committee led by Sylvanus Osoro to investigate the bursary which was established by the committee chairman Manson Oyongo, who is the head teacher, and to review the previous beneficiaries so that those who deserve it can be identified, and those who were wrongly included can be removed from the list because they did not meet the criteria.
