english: Early the next morning Abimelech summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, enguba yaito, tobaisa kobaita! Abanto baane nigo barabaise kweba. Obaomboganie ase chinguru chiao, erio omanye kobasiria.
english: But do not kill them, O Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might make them wander about, and bring them down.

ekegusii: ekiagera omoganda bw’abanto omotunyanete, ogoaka egeturi, ogateba, “Morusieo oyo!”
english: The crowd that followed kept shouting, "Away with him!"

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Timwana gosoma ase amariko: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?
english: Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: "'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?

ekegusii: Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense, agosesenie korwa Sayoni!
english: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi’amasabibu.
english: Your stature is like that of the palm, and your breasts like clusters of fruit.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Genda motebie Yohana ayamwarora na ayamwaigwa: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
english: So he replied to the messengers, "Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

ekegusii: Naki amariko nigo agoteba, “Erieta ria Nyasae nigo rikoramwa ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase engencho yaino.”
english: As it is written: "God's name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you."

ekegusii: Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, mochokoro o Safani, akariera abachiki baria amo nabanto babo eira na gotiana, akabatebia, “Timobaisa kwoboa gokorera Abakalidayo mobeere ase ense eye, mobe mokomokorera omoruoti o Babeli, nainwe namomenye buya motari na bokong’u.
english: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae akoboria; Inee! Aye nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo ingokirie nogokwa kw’omokori amabe? Yaya, nigo nganetie omokori amabe aonchoke, atige enchera yaye embe abe moyo.
english: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign LORD. Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?

ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Reuben, omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;
english: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, who was chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,

ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng’ana buna twachoretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oyokorete onsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye,
english: In him we were also chosen, having been predestined according to the plan of him who works out everything in conformity with the purpose of his will,

ekegusii: Moise koonchoka moigwe ogokurera kwane, rirorio nimbaiterere omoika one, mbamanyie amang’ana aane.
english: If you had responded to my rebuke, I would have poured out my heart to you and made my thoughts known to you.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: On that same day the LORD told Moses,

ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gotiga Abaisraeli, Abaefraimu aba, bagende amo naye, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nabarabwo.
english: But a man of God came to him and said, "O king, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the LORD is not with Israel-- not with any of the people of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Ekero Elisha arenge noborwaire bw’amakweri Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda komorora. Gaikireo agachaka korera, “Tata ominto! Tata ominto! Aye nigo ore ase Abaisraeli buna chigari na abariini chibarasi.”
english: Now Elisha was suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. "My father! My father!" he cried. "The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"

ekegusii: “Rora, naramboire okoboko kwane kogoaka, nakeeirie endagera yao, naende nakorure nakobekire ase abakungu b’Abafilisti, abwo bakogechete naende barorire obosooku ase ogokora kwao kw’obonyaka, erinde bagokore buna banchete.
english: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.

ekegusii: Naki moranyare kwegena, inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe ase inwe, na obonene boria bokorwa ase Nyasae ore bweka, timori koborigia?
english: How can you believe if you accept praise from one another, yet make no effort to obtain the praise that comes from the only God?

ekegusii: Korende ekero ndakwane naye, nimaanore omonwa oo, na aye obatebie iga: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba. Omonto oganetie koigwera, tiga aigwere, na oyo otaganeti koigwera, tiga aange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.
english: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says.' Whoever will listen let him listen, and whoever will refuse let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.

ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
english: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

ekegusii: na akarera neriogi rinene ringa buna eri’endo ekoruma. Ekero achia korera chinkoba isano na ibere chigakwana neriogi riabo.
english: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.

ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.
english: Those who live according to the sinful nature have their minds set on what that nature desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

ekegusii: Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.
english: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, having obtained eternal redemption.

ekegusii: Na omokori amabe karaonchoke, atige amabe aye, erio akore ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, nabe moyo ase engencho y’ayio.
english: And if a wicked man turns away from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live by doing so.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria abasomba ba Isaka bagacha, bakamorentera amang’ana igoro y’entuboka eria banyorete, bakamotebia, “Twanyorire amache.”
english: That day Isaac's servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We've found water!"

ekegusii: Engaki erache omwana oo karakoborie: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki? Goika omoiranerie: Ase okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru Omonene agatong’anyia korwa Misiri agwo ase twarenge abasomba.
english: "In days to come, when your son asks you, 'What does this mean?' say to him, 'With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.
english: I still dread all my sufferings, for I know you will not hold me innocent.

ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.
english: You are not to eat any creature that moves about on the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is detestable.

ekegusii: Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.
english: The LORD will keep you from all harm-- he will watch over your life;

ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi tibamanyeti gento, nabariri bare. Naki ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano eyio nemete bosa.
english: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

ekegusii: Korende ebiegwa ebi bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Omoika oyo oyomo, oria oria okogabera kera oyomo buna bwanchete.
english: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he gives them to each one, just as he determines.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria Sayoni otigirwe buna egesa gi’okorendera kere ase omogondo bw’emesabibu giatigirwe bosa; nigo anga buna ekegutu kere ase omogondo bw’amasosa, na buna omochie oboeire.
english: The Daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a city under siege.

ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.
english: These all look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Daudi akarua agwo, agatama korwa ase Saulo, akagenda ase Akisi, omoruoti o Gati,
english: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.
english: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.

ekegusii: Chora omonto omobe agambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.
english: Appoint an evil man to oppose him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then on the eighth day he must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Petero agachia komorora oyio, akaboria Yeso, “Omonene, noyo rende?”
english: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.
english: I, even I, am the LORD, and apart from me there is no savior.

ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende Rebeka nere nabogoretie oborito ase omosacha oyomo, nere Isaka sokoro yaito.
english: Not only that, but Rebekah's children had one and the same father, our father Isaac.

ekegusii: When he returned, he said to his father and mother, "I have seen a Philistine woman in Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."
english: Erio akairana nka, akamotebia ise na ng’ina, “Narora omoiseke oyomo Omofilisti agwo Timuna bono monyorere oria, imonyuome abe mokane.”

ekegusii: chiira chiria nakwanete nomonwa one, echio nariete ekero narenge ase emechando.
english: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Nebarimo ore!” Korende akaamereria mono, agateba ng’a naboigo are. Bakabora, “Nomomalaika oye!”
english: "You're out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."

ekegusii: Omonene obibekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.
english: He set them in place for ever and ever; he gave a decree that will never pass away.

ekegusii: Abarusia ebango bagacha erinde babatiswe, bakamoboria, “Omworokia, inki rende naintwe torakore?”
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Simeoni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abanemweli, abarwete ase Nemweli, na Abayamini, abarwete ase Yamini, na Abayakini, abarwete ase Yakini,
english: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;

ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Nomonto oboyirie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chingiya mono, na koria obwansu bw’omogoko, nigo bare ase chinyomba chi’abaruoti.
english: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear expensive clothes and indulge in luxury are in palaces.

ekegusii: Aya nigo aganetigwe nabaminto b’oborimo, abasoetigwe bobisi, banyare kounia obosibore bwaito tore nabwo ase Kristo Yeso, erinde batobeke ase obosibwa.
english: [This matter arose] because some false brothers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

ekegusii: Naki onye ngokora emeremo eye ase ogwancha kwane, ninde neng’eria; korende onye tari ase ogwancha kwane, nonya nabo negenirwe noborendi.
english: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.

ekegusii: Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa.
english: "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nare namaakwa amange, korende oyomosemeretie Omonene, Omonene nigo amoetananeretie nobwanchani botari koera.
english: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the LORD's unfailing love surrounds the man who trusts in him.

ekegusii: Naende mwarorire na koigwa ng’a Paulo, oyio oebereirie abanto na kobaonchora, tari ase Efeso oka, korende nonya nase Asia yonsi pi, okobatebia ng’a chinyasae chigokorwa namaboko tari chirochio chinyasae.
english: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto abwate oborwaire bwa ukoma ararentwe ase omokuani,
english: "When anyone has an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

ekegusii: goika inchiche imbarusie agwo mbaire ase ense egwekaine buna ense eyio yaino, ense ere ne chindagera, na edivai, ense ere nemegati na emegondo y’emesabibu.
english: until I come and take you to a land like your own-- a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.
english: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" And immediately the leprosy left him.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Yonathani, “Ntebie amang’ana gwakorire.” Yonathani agateba, “Nigo nachobia mesia y’enyimbo yarenge koboko kwane ase eriana rire nobooke, nkariria; ase ayio, nao inde aa, bono goika nkwe.”
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." So Jonathan told him, "I merely tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now must I die?"

ekegusii: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
english: Yairi agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Kamoni.

ekegusii: Abwo nabwo bare enchera ensemo; aase ring’ana rikobusurwa, na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.
english: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi tagendete igoro, korende ere omonyenye nigo agoteba: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
english: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

ekegusii: Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogoko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”
english: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

ekegusii: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
english: Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”

ekegusii: Chinyang’au nchibe chikwamuma ase emerobiri yabo, ne chisese chi’orosana nchibe chikorera ase chinyomba chiabo chi’obonene. Engaki yaye yaikire ang’e; amatuko aye tagotambeeigwa.
english: Hyenas will howl in her strongholds, jackals in her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.

ekegusii: Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio:
english: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

ekegusii: Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye
english: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

ekegusii: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana asebare aya Ise.
english: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.

ekegusii: goika rituko riria abogoretigwe gochia igoro. Ritang’ani ri’ayio agachika goetera ase Omoika Omochenu abatomwa baria achorete.
english: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

ekegusii: Abanto aba batoire ase amarieta abo bagacha ekero Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, arenge kogamba. Barabwo bagasaria chiema chi’abanto b’aroro na bagasiria Abameuni, abanto banyorekanete aroro; bakabasiria kegima na tibaiyo nonya goika rero iga. Erio bakamenya agwo ribaga riabo, ekiagera oborisia mbwarengeo ase chitugo chiabo.
english: The men whose names were listed came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings and also the Meunites who were there and completely destroyed them, as is evident to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.

ekegusii: Imorie ebitinya goika moigote kegima, naende monywe amanyinga goika motinde; ekiagera oyio nomoyega bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie.
english: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.

ekegusii: goika abe oiraneirie Yerusalemu amaya aye na koyokora obe ogotogigwa ase ense.
english: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

ekegusii: Esteri akamoiraneria, “Omoruoti korarore mbuya, Abayahudi aba bare agwo Susa baegwe ribaga ankio boigo bakore koreng’ana nogochika kwa rero; tiga abamura ba Hamani ikomi batongwe ase chimbambo igoro.”
english: "If it pleases the king," Esther answered, "give the Jews in Susa permission to carry out this day's edict tomorrow also, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged on gallows."

ekegusii: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
english: Filipo akagenda, agatebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagatebia Yeso.

ekegusii: Korende omosabibu oyio konya osimekirwe ase riroba ritobu, ase amache amange arenge, erinde onyare gosokia chinsagia, bwame amasabibu na obe omosabibu omuya.
english: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.'

ekegusii: For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
english: Naki ekina mokonacha, nakio morache konacherwa. Na ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa.

ekegusii: Ase igo, nyuma Aburamu kamenyire ense ya Kanani emiaka ikomi, Sarai akaimokia Hagari, omosomba oye Omomisiri, akamomoa Aburamu, omosacha oye, ng’a abe mokaye o sere‐sere.
english: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.

ekegusii: Korende omoika nore ime ase mwanyabanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.
english: But it is the spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba ase abanto bakorera gose kobokia amagombo, na tobaisa koreera onde bwensi, gose kobaichanera. Inche narusirie omorembe one na obwanchani bwane bwa botambe, na amabera aane korwa ase abanto aba.
english: For this is what the LORD says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ere nigo atogonyeretwe ase ogosaria kwaye omonyene, ekero etigere etari gokwana egakwana ase eriogi ria mwanyabanto, egatanga obobarimo bw’omobani oria.
english: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey-- a beast without speech-- who spoke with a man's voice and restrained the prophet's madness.

ekegusii: Samula nere agakwa, na Sauli, oyo orwete Rehoboti, omochie orenge orooche ensemo, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Emegano Ya Mwanyagetinge LXXXV: Abagaka Babere Banchaine Ekianda Gia Ikomi Aaria Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County Aya amwabo aya: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com Amaridadi y' amaiso. Tokare goika ase abanto baito abaya kogora ebiragwati aaria Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Abwo kare kare ase ekenyoro kia Motonto, abagaka babere mbarengeo. Bono abagaka aba nigo banchaine ekianda gia ikomi, naende nigo babwate obosani obonene kerage. Bono emaambia eyemo, omwana bw’ omogaka oyomo agasaria ebirangwati bio omosani oise. Omonyene ebirangwati ekero anyorete omwana oyo bw’ omogisangio oye, nigo amoitete na komotigera enda y’ obokima !! Omwana oyo akaigwa bobe, korende ise ere taigwa bobe. Bono amatuko make ekero aetire, omogaka ori oitete omwana ori ore gosari ebirangwati akabatarera. "Tanga n' omoro gwantoma" Ritang'ani, embori egaitwa n' endagera koroisigwa buya, erinde omogeni aragere. Korwa abwo, amarwa agaterekwa inse n' egetono. Bono riria amarwa aterekwa inse, ise agatebia omwana arentere omogisangi oise orokore, erinde banywere amaru. Gotebigwa iga, omwana oyo akaigwa bobe pi na gotebia ise buna "Tata nanga n’ omoro gwantoma, tomoitere. Nang’itete bobe"
english: The 85th Story of Mwanyagetinge: The Doctors Were Called to Investigate a Strange Incident in Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County These are the details: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com Beauty of the eyes. It happened that people went to investigate strange things in Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Long ago in the village of Motonto, the doctors were called. But these doctors were investigating a strange incident, and they found a very big problem. This story is true, a child whose father is a doctor was seeing strange things about this problem. Someone saw those strange things and told the child who was with the doctor, and he started being afraid!! That child was very scared, so he also became scared. But his friends said that the doctor was taking the child to see strange things and scaring him. "Give me my money" Reportedly, a business person who was being cheated was crying, fearing for their property. Because of this, debts were paid with force. But after the debts were paid with force, they began to threaten the child so that he would not tell anyone, lest the thieves be caught. It is said that the child was very scared and also threatened saying "Father give me my money back, please. I beg you."

ekegusii: Gaki, onye mwabokire amo na Kristo, rigia ayare igoro aase Kristo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon's temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.

ekegusii: Nabo ekero achia goika Galili, Abagalili bakamoroisia, ekiagera baroche amang’ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene; naki nabarabwo boigo mbagendete ase rituko rinene.
english: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, for they also had been there.

ekegusii: Akabwatia omoroberio o Daudi ise, akabeka ebiombe bi’abakuani ase ogokora emeremo yabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo y’ogokonya abakuani na ase ogotera amatera ’ogotogia, na emeremo ende buna yaganeirie kera rituko. Boigo akabeka ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita gokora emeremo yabo ase kera egeita buna yaganeirie kera rituko, buna Daudi, omonto oria o Nyasae, achigete ekorwe.
english: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day's requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.

ekegusii: Na ebimeri ebibese bionsi nabirure bibe endagera ye ching’iti chionsi chire moyo ase ense”; akaba boigo.
english: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds of the air and all the creatures that move on the ground-- everything that has the breath of life in it-- I give every green plant for food." And it was so.

ekegusii: Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,
english: "The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.

ekegusii: Rora, nabaeire okobua gotindacha ching’iti chionsi, na ebiuge, ne chinguru chionsi chi’oria omobisa; gose gento kende tikeri kerabaite.
english: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

ekegusii: “Omonene agakwana agantebia: Sulemani, omomura oo, nere oraagache enyomba yaane ne chiraaro chiane, ekiagera namochorire abe omwana one, na inche nimbe ise.
english: He said to me: 'Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

ekegusii: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
english: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ritombe.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin, Elidadi, mosinto o Kisiloni;
english: Elidad son of Kislon, from the tribe of Benjamin;

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba ng’a ase enchera eyio Abaisraeli tibakorua asende bachie gosira, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nonya ng’ake ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo gwonsi, korende mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.”
english: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Minto FM: Abasae babeke omokia ase oboremi amo nebiasara ribaga rio okorigia emeremo ya obisi Omoteneneri omonene bwa amang’ana ya abasae ase abisi yo omokonyi bwo omorai bwense omosike Anthony Kibagendi otebire buna abasae nigo bagwenerete kobeka ebirengererio biabo mono ase ensemo yo oboremi amo nebiasara ribaga rio okorigia emeremo ya obisi. Gokwana na Minto Fm ase emambia yerituko ria rero chingaki asanga no omoraria Wycliffe Nyabuto ime yo omoroberio o Minto bwakire, Kibagendi nigo boigo atebire buna amang’ana aare ase eropoti ya BBI tabwaatie engencho enene gochia ase omosae o Kenya. Anene mono nigo akwanera igoro ya amapendekezo yemiaka 7 yo ogotaakaana ebango na gokwana egetambokero ekio koba keria kerachie koremaria uchumi yense.
english: Minto FM: The leaders have said that they will discuss this matter further because of the ongoing issues regarding the station. The large discussion about the leaders and the station's management, where Anthony Kibagendi spoke, was that the leaders need to come together and address their concerns, due to the ongoing issues regarding the station. However, on Minto Fm, he mentioned several points, stating that the report by Wycliffe Nyabuto during the review at Minto was incorrect; Kibagendi also stated that the leaders did not read the BBI report carefully enough to understand its impact on the people of Kenya. He added that it is necessary to consider the seven-year recommendations and that this initiative could help improve the economy.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amang’ana aane ayio ndachike omobani oyio ayakwane ase erieta riane, inche bweka omonyene ning’ee omonto oyio egesusuro.
english: If anyone does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name, I myself will call him to account.

ekegusii: Tiga ensoko yao esesenigwe, naye ogokere omokungu bw’oboke bwao,
english: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotanga amaiso aane takonyora chitoro. Nigo nchandegete mono, tinkonyara gokwana.
english: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

ekegusii: Togaeta ase obokong’u engegu ase engegu, togaika aase akorokwa Ebiambokero Ebiya. Ang’e nagwo norengeo omochie ore korokwa Lasaya.
english: We moved along the coast with difficulty and came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio tokabeera ase rikura riarochie omochie o Beti‐Peori.”
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia omokungu oria “Genda bwoo, ninkoroiserie amang’ana ayio.”
english: The king said to the woman, "Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf."

ekegusii: “Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekina ekio ki’abanto abwo babere nigo kerarentwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae. Ere oyo Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.
english: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, 'This is mine,' both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka orogendo rw’omonto omoronge chinguru, na kogokigwa narororwo.
english: If the LORD delights in a man's way, he makes his steps firm;

ekegusii: Nigo nakorete bo, ekiagera tibabwatete amachiko aane na tibayakorete, korende nigo baangete koigwera emeroberio yane echikire, na bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti, na amaiso abo nigo arigereretie emegwekano eyio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge gosasima.
english: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes [lusted] after their fathers' idols.

ekegusii: korende oyorankane ase mwanyabanto, nainche nimokane ase Tata one ore igoro.
english: But whoever disowns me before men, I will disown him before my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: Korende bono mwantigire inche na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao; ase ayio tintageti kobatooria naende.
english: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otebire ng’a amatuko ngocha are, ekero abanto batakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: "So then, the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

ekegusii: Na omokungu ore nomosacha otegeneti, na omosacha oyo bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.
english: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.

ekegusii: Erio akang’iraneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamoiraneria, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”
english: He answered, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I replied.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko erio omote oria ogendete aase abakure ngachika ebirero birerwe; nigo natubete chindiba ase engencho yaye, ngatanga chindooche chiaye, nkaochania amache amanene. Nigo nachigete egetunwa kia Lebanoni keyobokerie amagombo, na emete yonsi y’orosana egasusana ase engencho yaye.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day it was brought down to the grave I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.

ekegusii: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
english: Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.

ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namabera asebare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namabera ase abwo bamoirogete.
english: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him;

ekegusii: Ere igo obeire omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omoroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.
english: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

ekegusii: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel Beth Maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
english: Seba agaeta egati ye chingongo chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, agaika omochie o Abeli Beti‐Maaka, na Ababeri bonsi bagasangererekana amo, bakamotunyana.

ekegusii: Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora ay’obong’ainereria.
english: Deliver me and rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

ekegusii: “Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.
english: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness-- and I will not lie to David--

ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana aya nigo arikire ase obosio bwane, agoteba: “Inche tingokira, goika mbaakane, ee, goika mbaakane ogokora kwabo kobe ase ebikuba biabo.
english: "See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps--

ekegusii: Orogendo korwa Horebu goetera ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Seiri goika Kadeshi‐Barinea nigo rwarenge orw’amatuko ikomi na rimo.)
english: (It takes eleven days to go from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by the Mount Seir road.)

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.

ekegusii: Can you make a pet of him like a bird or put him on a leash for your girls?
english: Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?

ekegusii: Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”
english: You go to the Feast. I am not yet going up to this Feast, because for me the right time has not yet come."

ekegusii: “Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
english: "The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bane nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Barabwo nigo baitetwe na Daudi na abanto baye.
english: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

ekegusii: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.
english: ekiagera giachenirwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae na ogosaba.

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a onye abasacha ikomi batigaire ase enyomba eyemo, nabarabwo goika bakwe.
english: If ten men are left in one house, they too will die.

ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi, Maharai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rwa Zera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang’ana amakong’u igoro yane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang’ana ki amakong’u twakwanire igoro yao?
english: "You have said harsh things against me," says the LORD. "Yet you ask, 'What have we said against you?'

ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in to them.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibari konyorwa nobokong’u bonde ase obogima bwabo; emebere yabo nigo ere emiya, naende emenoru.
english: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

ekegusii: Yoabu akaa Daudi omobaro bw’abanto. Ase Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge komanya korwana esegi nemioro nigo barenge abanto emilioni eyemo, ne chilifu rigana erimo (1,100,000), na ase Abayuda abanto chilifu amagana ane na emerongo etano na ebere (470,000).
english: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.

ekegusii: Inyora Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang’e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogoko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”
english: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of trouble come and the years approach when you will say, "I find no pleasure in them"--

ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikama echinde rigana, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, na echinde emerongo etato.
english: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop-- a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.

ekegusii: Nonya nomosani one negenete, tware koragera komo, ong’akire chintacho.
english: Even my close friend, whom I trusted, he who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

ekegusii: Amache amange naiteke korwa ase chinyongo chiabo na oroiboro rwabo nigo rorabe oronge mono. Omoruoti obo nabe omonene goetania Agagi, na oboruoti bwaye inabotogigwe mono.
english: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. "Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku ebio biatigarete bibaetanaine mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene naagachire aase agwo aasaretigwe, naende nasimekire chimbusuro ase emegondo yatigarete ere bosa. Ninche Omonene nakwanire, goika nkore ayio.”
english: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.'

ekegusii: Inkio yaye omoganda oteneine ng’umbu y’enyancha bakarora ng’a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, otatiga boria obomo bwoka, naende ng’a Yeso tasoete ase obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye, korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka.
english: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.

ekegusii: Isaka agakwana na Ibrahimu ise, agateba, “Tata!” Ise akamoitabera, “Nao inde aa, omwana one.” Isaka akamoboria, “Rora, omorero ne chinko ntobwate, korende ng’ai emanwa y’engondi ere togochia gokorera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa?”
english: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"

ekegusii: Korende akabatebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.”
english: He replied, "My mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and put it into practice."

ekegusii: “Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye aase aatananire.
english: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Subaeli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana igoro chiragenderere kobeera ase obosio bwane, naboigo ne chinderia chiaino chiragenderere kobao amo nerieta riaino boigo.” Nabo Omonene atebire. Naende otebire iga:
english: "As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me," declares the LORD, "so will your name and descendants endure.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo akoimokererigwa igoro goetera ase ekina gi’ekeene, na Nyasae ore Omochenu bweorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase oboronge bwaye.
english: But the LORD Almighty will be exalted by his justice, and the holy God will show himself holy by his righteousness.

ekegusii: Tori koigwera eriogi rinde rionsi, tori gwancha korongeigwa; tori komosemeria Omonene, gose komoika Nyasae oye ang’e.
english: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the LORD, she does not draw near to her God.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotebia omokori amabe, “Naye mboronge ki obwate okonagwatora amachiko aane? Gose kona‐gokwana‐kwana okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania?
english: But to the wicked, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

ekegusii: “Eri nario rirabe ribebe riaino: Ribebe ria sugusu richakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rietere emechie ya Heteloni, na Sedadi,
english: "This is to be the boundary of the land: "On the north side it will run from the Great Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,

ekegusii: na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakabora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amabera!”
english: and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"

ekegusii: Bakarigia komobwata, korende bakairoka omoganda, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo ogoteba; bakamotiga, bakagenda.
english: Then they looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.

ekegusii: Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.
english: His snorting throws out flashes of light; his eyes are like the rays of dawn.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omwana omomura bw’omokungu oria omoboraka, omwarigania bw’Elija, akarwara. Oborwaire bw’omwana oria bokaba obonene goika bokamoita,
english: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa abataka ebiegwa ore nomoyo omorabu; oboronge bwaye mbogenderere kobao kare na kare; orogunchara rwaye ndokine ase ogosikwa.
english: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor, his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

ekegusii: Buna ase rituko ri’omoyega omonene okarangeria ababisa baane bakanyoboyia korwa chinsemo chionsi; ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene onde tatooregete, gose gotigara, ase abwo nabogoretie na kobarera. Ababisa baane babasiririe.
english: "As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the LORD's anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared, my enemy has destroyed."

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase ense y’Abaamori.
english: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

ekegusii: Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo nabana baye abamura, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye, ase ogwetooria korwa ase etoigo eria.
english: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Abineri, “Genda oborie omanye gose omosae oyo noyo ng’o?”
english: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakababwatia goika Yorodan, bakarora chianga na ebinto binde Abasiiria batugutete inchera ekero barenge gotama. Abanto baria batometwe bakairana, bagatebia omoruoti amang’ana ayio.
english: They followed them as far as the Jordan, and they found the whole road strewn with the clothing and equipment the Arameans had thrown away in their headlong flight. So the messengers returned and reported to the king.

ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nkona‐koraria obuya bw’Omonene kogenderera botambe; nimbe nkona‐gotera ogotera gw’okomotogia Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amabera naende, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.
english: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.

ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y’abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.
english: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.

ekegusii: Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.
english: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

ekegusii: Erio egoree eria egakora amang’ana amanene mono. Ekero yabete ne chinguru chinyinge, orogunchara rwaye oronene rokabuneka, na ase ribaga riaye chingunchara inye chi’ogokumia chikamerao chiarochie gochia ase chinsemo inye chia igoro.
english: The goat became very great, but at the height of his power his large horn was broken off, and in its place four prominent horns grew up toward the four winds of heaven.

ekegusii: Riembe ria Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) rimanyire buna Kasturi srire rotunda rie chitripiki ang’e chimita 10–30 ase obotambe erigotoka ase asinine ase akorokwa Banjarmasin ase Borneo ya maate (Indonesia). Amatuko aya riasire gosira ekiagera rikonachwa mono. Korende, nabo rikonya gosimekwa aiga asengencho y’amatunda aye agwansa. Okoren’gana kwe riembe ria Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) nkori konene mono ekero okoreng’ania n’amatunda ande ye chimbego chia amaembe. Oborito bwaye ebore ang’e chigiramu 50 goika 84. Ekero ritaratoba, nigo rire machani – ekero riatobire – erangi yaye ere maraba gose gochia bure-emwamu naende ribwate risabo rikomesa. Gocherera erangi ya buru. Ogoonchoreria chirangi oko nakwo gokomanyia igoro y’amatunda a M. Casturi. Chikabira isato chia Mangifera casturi- Kasturi,Mangga Cuban na Pelipisan. Erimanyire mono Kasturi eseng’encho ye rimisu riaye. Mangga Cuban na Pelipisan nigo akororwa buna chimbego ching’ao. Pelipisan nigo ribwate rimisu rigiya buna Kasturi eyio ekoorokia buna erirwete korwa Kasturi. Oborigia obonge mbogendererete korimanya mono. Ime ye ritunda eri nigo rikomachia koarira ase erangi naende rikwara akeigo ne rimisu riansu. Etokobwekani Kasturi me riembe(Mangifera indica),kasturi ndiri gwansa mono rakini ndibwate obwansu obokong’u ne rimisu rikeigo. Ime ye rotunda ria Kasturi eribwate emerande emenge emiya. Kasturi erianchire mono ase abanto ba Borneo ya maate am one chiamate chiabo. Rimisu riaye erikogokia goika ogotera ogokoro gokarosigwa igoro yaye “Seharum kasturi, seindah pelangi, semuanya bermula.” komineti “O, rimisu rigiya buna Kasturi, rigiya mono buna omokobi nyongo. Obwanchani obo bwachakire esabari.” Okonacha kw’emete gotaancheri kwagerire omote oyo ngosira okare korwa orosana. Emete emekoro y’amaembe a Kalimantan igo arasire korwa okonacha gotaancheri ekiagere emete yabo ekorwa emenge naende emiya. Emete eye egosimekwa ase ake ake ase emechi ya abanto nyuma y’ebiticha biabo gose emegondo yabo emeke. Riembe ria Kalimantan ndiri gosimekwa ase emegondo emenene gose ase obonge ime ya Indonesia buna amatunda ande agosimekwa ase chitropiki ekiagera akwama ng’ora. Emegondo emenene ya Kalimantani nigo ekoratoka ase ensemo enke ya Banjar (ensemo enke ya Banjar teri eyemo buna ensemo enke ya Banjarmasin). Abanto ba Mataraman mbatemete gosimeka ase emegondo emeke ase omwaka o 1980 korende rigesa ritang’ani eriarenge omwaka o 2005. Nonye rotunda eri rigotoka ase oboraisi, teri goisaneki banto ekiagere rianchire mono. Amatumisi y’amatunda n’omote nigo are amake. Nonye emete emekoro kegotwara ritina rietaneti emita eyemo, abanto ba Banjar (egesaku ki’abanto baime na ab’enyancha batorete Borneo ya maate) ebagotumia amatunda oka akiagera omote oye okwama egeka. Eseigo, abanto ba Banjar nigo bagotumia emete emeng’ao gokora ebinto binde. Konyora amatunda nkori raisi ekiagere omote o Kasturi nigo okwama oba omotambe mono naende goika omonto arine ase anene mono konyoikera – amatunda akogwa inse tari amaya mono. Amatunda aya nabo akoriegwa amatobu gose arosiri buna echamu. Tari koonigwa mono ase chichiro ekiagera abaremi abanyene nigo bakonyaria ataraika chichiro. Ebinto binde bikorosigwa korwa ase amaembe nigo are chipurii,chichamu, echuisi, gose obosuguti (ebisuguti bi’abakoro). Ebinto ebi korende ebire ebikong’u gotoka ekiagera amatunda aya akoriegwa mono naende anchire mono n’abanto ba Banjar. Amatunda aya naende are rigori rinene korende ase abanto ba Banjar, mbari gpkumia ekiagera y’obwansu obonene.
english: The fruit of Kalimantan (Mangifera casturi) is commonly known as Kasturi, a round fruit that belongs to the cashew family and grows around 10–30 years old, found in areas like Banjaramasin and Borneo Island (Indonesia). Its wood is used for making various tools and furniture. Currently, this tree is cultivated because its fruits are delicious. Kalimantan mango (Mangifera casturi) trees are large and produce fruits similar to ordinary mangoes. The height can reach 50 to 84 meters. It flowers twice a year – flowering – which yields fruit approximately six months later, resulting in abundant harvests. The skin color is yellowish. To improve the quality of the fruit of M. Casturi, grafting techniques are employed. Several varieties of Mangifera casturi - Kasturi, Cuban Mango and Pelipisan - are recognized. Kasturi is widely cultivated for its sweet taste. Cuban Mango and Pelipisan are also known as superior varieties. Pelipisan is considered a good type of mango similar to Kasturi, which is often sold as Kasturi mango. This origin has been extensively researched. The flesh of the fruit is yellow and slightly sour, with a unique aroma and flavor. Kasturi is related to mango (Mangifera indica), but it differs significantly in terms of shape and texture. The roundness of the Kasturi fruit resembles an emerald green color. Kasturi is loved by the people of Borneo Island who give it a special name. Its fragrance is said to be reminiscent of the following phrase: "As fragrant as Kasturi, as beautiful as a rainbow, everything begins." They comment, "Oh, the good mango of Kasturi, truly a delightful mango. The sweetness is unparalleled." In conclusion, further research is needed to understand the potential benefits of this fruit. Research on Kalimantan mangoes shows promise for future studies regarding their nutritional value and economic impact. This research is being conducted by researchers and communities after previous efforts were unsuccessful. Kalimantan mangoes are widely grown throughout Indonesia, especially in tropical regions where they thrive. The vast lands of Kalimantan are suitable for growing these mangoes due to the fertile soil and favorable climate (the fertile soil of Kalimantan is also known as the soil of Banjaramasin). People from Mataraman began cultivating them in the 1980s, and production increased significantly around 2005. However, this round fruit is still relatively unknown to many people. The quality of the fruit depends on its origin. Moreover, the people of Banjar (who are often referred to as the inhabitants of Borneo Island) utilize the mangoes to create various products for sale. Therefore, the people of Banjar use these mangoes to make diverse items. Remember that mango trees provide shade which makes the area cool and comfortable - mangoes fall without causing harm. These mangoes are also processed into various snacks and preserved foods. It's said that those who taste the deliciousness of these mangoes will always remember them fondly. Various products are made from mangoes such as chips, preserves, sweets, and pickles (pickles made by elders). These products and others are derived from these mangoes and are enjoyed by the people of Banjar. These mangoes have great significance for the people of Banjar, contributing to their economy and prosperity.

english: After they came down from the high place to the town, Samuel talked with Saul on the roof of his house.

english: I will surely raise my hand against them so that their slaves will plunder them. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me.

english: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.

ekegusii: Ning’o okoraa Omoika bw’Omonene, gose ning’o okomosemia na komotebereria?
english: Who has understood the mind of the LORD, or instructed him as his counselor?

ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”
english: "Why wasn't this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year's wages."

english: He cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD: "O altar, altar! This is what the LORD says: 'A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who now make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.'"

ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe! Ebirage bigocha. Riroroche ri’omoganda omonene riaigurwe rigocha korwa sugusu, gocha gosaria emechie y’Abayuda ebe amaturi, ase chisese chi’orosana chiramenye.”
english: Listen! The report is coming-- a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.
english: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Mariamu oyokorete emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino.
english: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

english: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

english: The LORD said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: 'A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abimeleki agatianera abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna omonto oyo ore aa, gose mokaye, goika aitwe.”
english: So Abimelech gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who molests this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."

ekegusii: Tari ng’a eyio tiyatotungetie, korende igo twekorete abanyene koba ekiorokererio ekiya asemore, erinde motwege.
english: We did this, not because we do not have the right to such help, but in order to make ourselves a model for you to follow.

ekegusii: for John had been saying to him: "It is not lawful for you to have her."
english: ekiagera Yohana amotebetie, “Tai boronge asore komenyana nere.”

ekegusii: Gaki, tokore omokia gosoa ase ogotimoka koria, erinde onde tacha kogwa ase ogotaigwera kogwekaine koria koria.
english: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following their example of disobedience.

ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
english: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agwechandera oboronge bw’abataka, korende omokori amabe tamanyeti kende.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.

ekegusii: Nimbaboorie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakure, na nimbatoorie korwa ase amakweri. Aye amakweri, amaako ao ng’ai are? Aye aase abakure, ng’ai ogosiria kwao kore? Ogweitia gwasirire korwa ase amaiso aane?
english: "I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? "I will have no compassion,

ekegusii: Abaamoni bakagenda bakarobera ase egeita ki’omochie; Abasiiria ba Soba, na abwo ba Rehobu, amo nabanto korwa Tobu na Maaka, barabwo bakarobera ao boka ase egetii.
english: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi, akagenda Raba, akayorwania, akayobua na koyoira.
english: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire iga: “Inwe abana baane motari abegenwa, ing’iranere, ekiagera ninche Omonene oino. Nindusie oyomo oino korwa ase kera omochie, na babere korwa ase kera eamate, mbarente ase egetunwa gia Sayoni.
english: "Return, faithless people," declares the LORD, "for I am your husband. I will choose you-- one from a town and two from a clan-- and bring you to Zion.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani-- seven in all.

ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe, karue asende, erinde inyare korenda amachiko a Nyasae one.
english: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”
english: But now we call the arrogant blessed. Certainly the evildoers prosper, and even those who challenge God escape.'"

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na kabere bw’okogamba gwa Peka, mosinto o Remalia, Ahasi mosinto o Yotamu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Nigo bataarete ase chinyancha chinene, na ebitoki biaino nigo biarenge chimbusuro chia Sihori, na okwama kwe riranya ri’Orooche rwa Naili. Ninwe mwarenge abaonchoreria b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.

ekegusii: Omonene takonyara kwabera omonto onga buna oyio, korende endamwamu yaye, ne risemi mbibe igoro y’omonto oyio, na okoragereria okwo gwonsi korikire ase ebuku eye nigo korabeere asare, na Omonene natinyie erieta ri’omonto oyio rirue inse y’erioba, tainyorwa.
english: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him; his wrath and zeal will burn against that man. All the curses written in this book will fall upon him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under heaven.

ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chindooche chiichire namooke na amaguta ’amabeere.
english: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, noro omochakano bwe chisemi. Abariri nigo bagochaya obong’aini na amorokererio.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

english: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father's household, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob's daughter.

ekegusii: Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ritindi ri’ekeririanda na endamwamu egwoka, ndisarie ense ebe bosa na gosiria kegima abanyabibe bamenyeteo.
english: See, the day of the LORD is coming--a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger-- to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.

ekegusii: Monto onde takororerete amabeebe agokorere ring’ana nonya nerimo ase ayio, gose gokororera amabera; korende nigo gwatugutetwe isiko aarabu, ekiagera rituko erio kwaiboretwe nigo kwagechetwe.

english: Then he said, "May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak just once more. What if only ten can be found there?" He answered, "For the sake of ten, I will not destroy it."

english: Then God's temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a great hailstorm.

english: inche tingoseria nonya nomonto oyomo bw’ebisaku ebio Yoshua atasaretie ritang’ani atarakwa.

english: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?

english: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

english: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had married.

english: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

english: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.

english: saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

ekegusii: Simuri agasoa nyomba, akamoaka, akamoiyeria inse na komoita. Ayio igo akorete ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Nyuma y’ayio Simuri akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.

english: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a peaceful and unsuspecting people. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oganetie kobooria ensemo yaye ya ikomi, nigo aramente eyemo ya isano ase rigori riaye.
english: If a man redeems any of his tithe, he must add a fifth of the value to it.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Saulo, “Nase ki okoigwera amang’ana abanto bagoteba ng’a inche Daudi ngokorigia inde ngokore bobe?
english: He said to Saul, "Why do you listen when men say, 'David is bent on harming you'?

english: "Watch me," he told them. "Follow my lead. When I get to the edge of the camp, do exactly as I do.

ekegusii: Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.
english: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the earth.

ekegusii: Ababani bao nigo bakobarorera amaroro ’obong’ainereria are bosa, tibakoorokeretie obobe bwao, erinde nario orairanerigwe amaya ao; korende aya amaroro abo ayakworogetie, nigo arenge ay’oborimo, agerete ogatantanigwa.
english: The visions of your prophets were false and worthless; they did not expose your sin to ward off your captivity. The oracles they gave you were false and misleading.

ekegusii: since you ignored all my advice and would not accept my rebuke,
english: Mwachayire ogosemia kwane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokurera kwane.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’Omonyo ase orooche rwa Yorodan ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa irianyi.
english: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: I despise my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone; my days have no meaning.

ekegusii: Naki nomobere kirori ase abanto bonsi igoro y’amang’ana ayakwarorire na koyaigwa.
english: You will be his witness to all men of what you have seen and heard.

ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Nyasae akorire. Aya akorire ase egati ya mwanyabanto nigo are ay’okwoboyia.
english: Come and see what God has done, how awesome his works in man's behalf!

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!
english: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

ekegusii: Onye mokomoroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.
english: Since you call on a Father who judges each man's work impartially, live your lives as strangers here in reverent fear.

ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachika ng’a ebitondo bi’abanto baria bisungorwe, bitugutwe ase rikuruma riria bebisete, na abanto bagakora bo. Naende bakabeka amagena amanene ase egesoero kie rikuruma, nao are goika rero iga.
english: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.

ekegusii: nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.”
english: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."

ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.
english: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.

ekegusii: Buna erikire ase ebuku y’amang’ana ’omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.
english: As is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio noyo bw’ororeria rwa Kalebu, nigo arenge korokwa Nabali, na mokaye Abigaeli. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge omong’aini mono na omonyakieni, korende omosacha oria nigo arenge omonto omotindi na omonyandamwamu.
