english: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning-- the first day.

ekegusii: Omonyene eng’iti eria takoriga‐rigereria, onye ere engiya gose embe, na takoyeonchoreria. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching’iti echio, erio chionsi ibere nchibe chinchenu, tichikoboorigwa.”
english: He must not pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.'"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae,
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus said to them, "no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, kwabeire gokonyorokereria korwa obwana bwane, goika rero iga ningenderere konakoraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
english: Since my youth, O God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi ba Sekemu, na abwo ba Beti‐Milo, bagasangererekana amo agwo Sekemu ase omote oria onga buna omotontera ang’e nekeinyorio giatenenirieo, na agwo bakabeka Abimeleki akaba omoruoti.
english: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelech king.

ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi b’ense eye goika baire okoruegwa okwo ase omogambi ore ase Abaisraeli.
english: All the people of the land will participate in this special gift for the use of the prince in Israel.

ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, mbitoki ki okorentera oyio okoyobomba? Oyio nomogwekano obombire ore omworokia omong’ainereria? Oyio oyoroisetie nigo asemeretie emeremo y’amaboko aye ere chinyasae chitari gokwana.
english: "Of what value is an idol, since a man has carved it? Or an image that teaches lies? For he who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,
english: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Nyasae omonguru, Nyasae Omonene, nigo agokwana, nigo agokwana na korangeria ense yonsi korwa moocha goika bosongo.
english: A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to the place where it sets.

ekegusii: Abateri nigo batang’aine bosio, nyuma yabo abakobugia amakano, na ase egati yabo abaiseke bakobugia chinchigiri:
english: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the maidens playing tambourines.

ekegusii: na igo bakogera abanto babogorie ebibe biabo, na okomocha kwabo, ase okoria ebinto ebichenu baruete. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
english: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.'"

ekegusii: Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.
english: He was with God in the beginning.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio, otatiga omwana oo omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.
english: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, who is your own flesh and blood-- he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tenena ase chinchera, morigererie, moborie momanye chinchera chia kare, ase enchera engiya ere; moyebwatie, nario moranyore obotoereru ase obogima bwaino. “Korende abanto bakaanga, bagateba: Intwe titorigeti koyebwatia.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, 'We will not walk in it.'

ekegusii: Yusufu agasangereria chibesa chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeka ase ekungo ya Farao.
english: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh's palace.

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagocha gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakorigereria gochia bosio bare nomokia buna omwaga okorwa moocha; nigo bagosangereria abasibwa abange buna omokenye.
english: they all come bent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.

ekegusii: abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;
english: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri agachika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaibirania, akabatebia,
english: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,

ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo bigotengechigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebigoro nigo bikonyititoka. Ense nigo ekonyegerigwa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense amo nebitongwa bionsi bireo.
english: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo batesoetie ase ogotacheneka nabakungu, ekiagera barabwo nabekungi, naende bagotunyana Emanwa y’Eng’ondi kera aase ase akogenda. Aba nababooretigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto buna ogotongorwa ase Nyasae na ase Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,
english: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they kept themselves pure. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among men and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

ekegusii: Omonto ore n’Omoika nigo akomanya onsi, korende ere takomanyigwa na monto onde.
english: The spiritual man makes judgments about all things, but he himself is not subject to any man's judgment:

ekegusii: “Ekero oratebie abanto amang’ana aya onsi, barabwo babe bagokoboria: Nase ki Omonene arentire obobe obo obonene asetore? Obobe bwaito mborobi? Ebibe twakorire ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mbiribi?
english: "When you tell these people all this and they ask you, 'Why has the LORD decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?'

ekegusii: Omworokia bw’amariko oyomo akamochiera, akamotebia, “Omworokia, ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
english: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

ekegusii: Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebina bia botambe. Ebina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.
english: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.

ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete abakure bakaranderigwa enchili, erinde bagambigwe ase omobere koreng’ana buna mwanyabanto bakogambigwa, na babe moyo ase omoika, koreng’ana buna Nyasae are moyo.
english: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to men in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.

ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro y’ababani: Enkoro yane yairianyekire ime yane, amauga aane onsi atengechire; nabeire buna omonto otindire ase okonywa, na buna oyo edivai yabuire, ase engencho y’Omonene na ase amang’ana aye amachenu.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD and his holy words.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene otebire ng’a nagokore obe omwoboyia ase aye omonyene, na ase abasani bao bonsi, na ababisa babo mbabaite nemioro ase obosio bwao. Omonene nabeke Abayuda bonsi ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli, nabaire gochia Babeli ase obosomba na abaite nemioro,
english: For this is what the LORD says: 'I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

ekegusii: Korwa enterekerero inse goika egetambokero kie ritang’ani ki’egesasimero ekenyene nigo kiarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere gochia igoro, na obogare gochia ime okoboko okomo; na korwa ase egetambokero keria egeke gochia ase ekere ekenene, nigo bwarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo.
english: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge it is two cubits high and a cubit wide, and from the smaller ledge up to the larger ledge it is four cubits high and a cubit wide.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase ogokwana amang’ana, gose enkoro yao teba enyango gokwana ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ere nigo are igoro, naye nigo ore inse aa ase ense; ase ayio tiga amang’ana ogokwana abe amake.
english: Do not be quick with your mouth, do not be hasty in your heart to utter anything before God. God is in heaven and you are on earth, so let your words be few.

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni agatiga Sukoti, akagenda gochia Penueli na agwo akaboria abanto amang’ana aria aria, korende abanto ba Penueli bakamoiraneria buna abanto ba Sukoti bamoiraneretie.
english: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Succoth had.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe bionsi biria Yeroboamu akorete; tibeatananete korwa ase birobio.
english: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them

ekegusii: Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane rero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu.
english: In any case, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day-- for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!

ekegusii: Rora, naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.
english: Thus is the man blessed who fears the LORD.

ekegusii: Your silver has become dross, your choice wine is diluted with water.
english: Chifeta chiao chiabeire bosa buna amabiria, na edivai yao yochoganigwe namache.

ekegusii: Timweba koroisia abageni, naki ase enchera eye abande mbaroisetie abamalaika, batamanyete.
english: Do not forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

ekegusii: Chitahabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.
english: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti arengereretie amang’ana ayio, akaroisia korwa ase etahabu emegwekano ebere ye chimori, agatebia abanto, “Igo mogochandeka mono kona kogenda Yerusalemu. Inwe Abaisraeli, rora aiga chinyasae chiaino, echi chiabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

ekegusii: Akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo ase ense y’ebigoro ya Yuda, naende akagera abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu bakaba abategenwa, na akagera Abayuda bagatiga chinchera chindonge.
english: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.

ekegusii: abanto b’Asimaweti: emerongo ene, na babere (42);
english: of Azmaveth 42

ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”
english: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"

ekegusii: Ere na abanto baria barenge komo bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakarara aroro. Mambia kobwachia gokia akabatebia, “Ing’a ribaga ng’irane ase omonene one.”
english: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, "Send me on my way to my master."

ekegusii: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.
english: “Origererie orore omonto ore omoronge, ogokora ayare boronge na ekeene.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agatebia Elija, “Tirimboka, ogende amo nere; tobaisa komwoboa.” Erio Elija akaimoka, agatirimboka, akagenda amo nere ase omoruoti.
english: The angel of the LORD said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.

ekegusii: Nyasae oria omenyete aase aye aachenu, nere ise bwe chintakana, na omorendi bw’ababoraka.
english: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.

ekegusii: akabatebia “Irana chinka chiaino amo nobotenenku obo obonge mwanyorire, chitugo chinyinge amo ne chifeta ne chitahabu ne chitaai, na ebioma, amo ne chianga chinyinge. Ase ayio mwatananere abamino ebisakorwa ebio mwasakorete ababisa baino.”
english: saying, "Return to your homes with your great wealth-- with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing-- and divide with your brothers the plunder from your enemies."

ekegusii: "As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made me taste bitterness of soul,
english: “Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagokonya Daudi korwania ebiombe bi’abasakori. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto chituoni, bakaba abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi.
english: They helped David against raiding bands, for all of them were brave warriors, and they were commanders in his army.

ekegusii: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and lay with her;
english: Aroro Yuda akarora Batisua, omoiseke bw’Omokanani gete, akamonyuoma. Bakaba bakorara amo,

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.
english: "Yet even in those days," declares the LORD, "I will not destroy you completely.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.
english: Our fathers disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, that we may share in his holiness.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa geita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio.”
english: Then he said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.'"

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.
english: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, na mamincha ye chindooche chiao. Ninsarie ense ya Misiri kegima ebe bosa korwa Migidoli goika Siwene ase orobebe rw’Etiopia.
english: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omobani Debora, moka Lapidoti, nigo arenge omogambi bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

ekegusii: goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”
english: till I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

ekegusii: inwe nigo mokoagacha Sayoni ase ogoitera amanyinga, na Yerusalemu ase ogokora okobe.
english: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

ekegusii: Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda korwania Abayuda, akagitera omochie o Rama chindwaki, ng’a nario ribaga ritabaisa gotoka ase omonto onde bwensi gosoka gose gosoa kogenda ase Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogoko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabatebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.
english: When she recognized Peter's voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"

ekegusii: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.
english: Erio agwo akagenda, agachirentera ng’ina, na ere akaroisia endagera engiya, eria ise anchete.

ekegusii: That kind of persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.
english: Okoebereria okwo tikwarwete asare ere oyobarangeretie inwe.

ekegusii: Korende Raeli konya obisire ebinyasae ebio ase egeikaransero kiaye igoro y’engamia, akaba obiikaranserete. Labani akariga‐rigia eema ime, tabinyora.
english: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel's saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.

ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Naki otachete ekero natomete abanto gokorangeria? Nase ki otachete? Nigo gwakagete ng’a tingocha gokoa ogosika kogoisaine?”
english: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn't you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?"

ekegusii: “Erieta ria Nyasae ritogigwe goika kare na kare! Obong’aini na okobua nebiaye.
english: and said: "Praise be to the name of God for ever and ever; wisdom and power are his.

ekegusii: Erio agwo omosaria oria bw’amachiko aorokigwe, na Omonene Yeso namoite nomoika bw’omonwa oye, na komosiria ase amasase ’okoorokigwa kwaye.
english: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?
english: "To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete obonyaka n’Abamisiri, abanto abwo mosinyaine bare nokogania okobe; okamenta obonyaka bwao, na okagera nkagechigwa nkaba nendamwamu.
english: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, and provoked me to anger with your increasing promiscuity.

ekegusii: This is the account of Abraham's son Ishmael, whom Sarah's maidservant, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Isumaeli, omwana o Ibrahimu, oyo Hagari, omosomba o Sara, amoiborerete.

ekegusii: “Genda ase Hilikia, omokuani omonene, omoborie abare chibesa chiarentirwe ase enyomba y’Omonene, echio abarendi b’egesieri basangereirie korwa ase abanto.
english: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

ekegusii: “Otenene ase omonto omogotu ore ne chimbuche, ase okomosika; omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Rise in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?
english: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

ekegusii: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.
english: Lameki agatebia abakungu baye, “Ada na Zila, igwa eriogi riane, inwe abakungu ba Lameki, tegerera ogokwana kwane, igo ndaite omonto karanyate orogoma, naisa koba omwana omomura karang’ake.

ekegusii: Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu, korende amachiko ao namaikeranu.
english: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.

ekegusii: Boigo akamoa emeroberio y’ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi buna barache gokora emeremo yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinto bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the LORD, as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.

ekegusii: Aye ninki ogokora aiga, na monto ki obwate aa? Nase ki ogwekunyera oboina aase are igoro mono? Inee! Nigo okwebaachera oboina aiga ase egetare bobe obomenyo bwao?
english: What are you doing here and who gave you permission to cut out a grave for yourself here, hewing your grave on the height and chiseling your resting place in the rock?

ekegusii: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
english: Onye omobisa oo ore nenchara, moe endagera arie; onye ore nerang’o, moe amache anywe.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omoruoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abarwani. Ase igo Yoabu na abatang’ani bande bakarua ase omoruoti, bakagenda kobara Abaisraeli.
english: The king's word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwanchereria omonto omotaka ase ekina kiaye.
english: and do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.

ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amache aino, nindusie amarwaire asemore.
english: Worship the LORD your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae inyebwate koboko kwane.”
english: Moses said to Joshua, "Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill with the staff of God in my hands."

ekegusii: Emiaka eyio amagana ane, na emerongo etato, koyaerire, ase rituko erio erio emeganda yonsi y’Omonene ekang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the LORD's divisions left Egypt.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa mwanyabanto kwaba bosa.
english: The LORD foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

ekegusii: Manase agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana ne chingencho chi’okogechia chi’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Agakorera Baali, akayesasima, na buna ise akorete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika ere akaba nendamwamu.
english: He served and worshiped Baal and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger, just as his father had done.

ekegusii: Amaroso ’orwaki rw’omochie nigo achabeire namagena e rigori rinene a kera egesaku. Oboroso bwe ritang’ani nigo bwarenge yasipi, na obwa kabere safiro, na obwa gatato kalkedoni, na obwa kane sumaridi,
english: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

ekegusii: With the bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
english: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta: Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

ekegusii: Naende, amang’ana aya amaya ay’oboruoti narandigwe ase ense yonsi koba kirori ase ebisaku bionsi; erio omoerio ochiche.
english: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

ekegusii: Daudi akamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti, rora ritimo riao eri, toma omosae oyomo amboke arioyie.
english: "Here is the king's spear," David answered. "Let one of your young men come over and get it.

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia bamura bamwabo, “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.

ekegusii: Amagoro ayio nigo aroisetigwe buna aye chigari. Amagoro amagima nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase etaai yanyititoire na kobombwa. Boigo amanyongo, ne chingata, na ebitingiro biaroisetigwe.
english: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; the axles, rims, spokes and hubs were all of cast metal.
